title: CROSS-BORDER CONTROL ON E-COMMERCE IMPORTATIONS
subject: Customs clearance, accreditation, and control of cross-border e-Commerce (B2C) importations
date_issued: DEC 11 2024 (Commissioner); approved by the Secretary of Finance JAN 28 2025
effectivity: Thirty (30) days after its complete publication at the Official Gazette or a newspaper of national circulation
related: WCO Framework of Standards on Cross-Border E-Commerce

ai.title: CAO 01-2025: Cross-Border Control on E-Commerce Importations
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CAO 01-2025 ang nagtatakda ng standard na customs clearance process para sa cross-border e-Commerce (B2C) goods na binili sa online trading platforms at e-retailer websites. Naka-align ito sa WCO Framework of Standards on Cross-Border E-Commerce, sa WCO Immediate Release Guidelines, at sa Article 7.8 ng WTO Agreement on Trade Facilitation.

🔍 Breakdown: Intro at Sec. 1-2 (Scope at Objectives). Sec. 3 Definition of Terms (kasama ang Categories 1 hanggang 4, De Minimis, FOB/FCA). Sec. 4 General Provisions (advance electronic data, risk management, simplified clearance, missorted goods, AEO, technology, customs control). Sec. 5 Dedicated e-Commerce Processing System at fees ng EPS Service Provider. Sec. 6 Accreditation at obligasyon ng stakeholders. Sec. 7 Submission of Manifest (e-CIFCM, 23 data elements, supplemental manifest, unmanifested goods, HAWB/HBL). Sec. 8 Clearance Formalities (CMO). Sec. 9 Import Processing Charge. Sec. 10 Exclusions. Sec. 11 Restrictions. Sec. 12 Prepayment Account. Sec. 13 Confidentiality. Sec. 14 Reportorial System. Sec. 15 Penalties. Sec. 16-18 Periodic Review, Separability, Effectivity.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Dumadami ang bumibili online mula abroad, kaya gumawa ang BOC ng hiwalay na 'lane' para dito. Kailangang accredited ang lahat ng kasali (platform, e-retailer, forwarder, broker, VASP). Kailangang maipasa nang maaga ang manifest, at may dedicated system para sa mabilis na release ng low-risk shipments. Hindi nawawala ang kontrol ng BOC: may risk management pa rin, may examination kung kailangan, at may bayad kung dapat may bayad.

📦 Halimbawa: Nag-order si Ana sa isang accredited online marketplace ng item na FOB value ay nasa loob ng De Minimis Threshold. Bago lumapag ang eroplano, nagpasa ang appointed freight forwarder ng e-CIFCM sa BOC. Pagdating, na-process ito bilang Category 2 (Low-Value, Non-Dutiable Goods) sa dedicated system: walang duty at tax pero may Import Processing Charge. Kung regulated ang item, kailangan pa rin ng permit ng kinauukulang ahensya.

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito? Para maiwasan ang revenue leakage, mapabilis ang clearance ng lehitimong e-Commerce goods, at ma-monitor ng BOC ang pagpasok ng mga ito gamit ang ICT. Ito rin ang legal basis ng accreditation at ng account-based (Prepayment Account) na koleksyon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: B2C lang ang scope. De Minimis Threshold: P10,000.00 FOB/FCA (o ayon sa adjustment sa CMTA Sec. 423). Category 2: hindi lalampas sa de minimis. Category 3: higit sa de minimis pero mas mababa sa P50,000.00. Category 4: P50,000.00 pataas. Category 2, 3, at 4 lang ang dadaan sa dedicated system. Supplemental manifest: loob ng 6 na oras mula arrival. Re-export ng missorted/misrouted: 24 oras. EPS provider: hanggang 10% ng Import Processing Fee ang puwedeng singilin, at 10% ng nakolektang fees ang monitoring fee ng BOC. Fee structure: review kada taon. CAO: review kada 3 taon. Effectivity: 30 araw pagkatapos ng kumpletong publication.

🎯 Board Exam Tip: Madalas itanong ang Categories 1 hanggang 4 at ang halaga ng bawat isa, ang 6-hour supplemental manifest (Sec. 7.3), ang mga excluded importations sa Sec. 10, ang 24-hour rule sa missorted o misrouted shipments (Sec. 12), at ang dalawang magkaibang 10% sa Sec. 5.6 at 5.7. Huwag silang paghalu-haluin: ang 5.6 ay cap ng singil ng provider (10% ng Import Processing Fee), ang 5.7 ay monitoring fee ng BOC (10% ng fees na nakolekta ng provider). Tandaan din ang 1-year vs 3-year review (Sec. 5.8 vs Sec. 16).

❓ Madalas Malito ang Students: Tanong: Sakop ba ng CAO na ito ang lahat ng online purchases, kasama ang B2B at C2C? Sagot: Hindi. B2C lang ang scope (Sec. 1). Excluded sa e-Commerce processing ang lahat ng C2C at ang B2B na hindi binili sa accredited online platform (Sec. 10.2 at 10.3).

🔗 Related Topics: CMTA Sec. 102 (definitions), CMTA Sec. 423 (de minimis), CAO 05-2020 (Express Shipments, Sec. 10 para sa missorted goods), CAO 14-2020 (VASP), CAO 02-2024, RA 11967 (Internet Transactions Act of 2023), RA 10173 (Data Privacy Act), RA 9280 (Customs Brokers Act).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo nang simple, sa conversational Tagalog na may English legal terms, ang Customs Administrative Order No. 01-2025 (Cross-Border Control on E-Commerce Importations) ng Bureau of Customs. Magbigay ng praktikal na customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito ginawa, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ibang CAO, at linawin ang common misconceptions ng mga estudyante.

paragraphs.text: This Customs Administrative Order (CAO) establishes a standard customs clearance process for cross-border e-Commerce goods bought via e-Commerce online shopping platform, consistent with the World Customs Organization (WCO) Framework of Standards on Cross-Border e-Commerce, WCO Immediate Release Guidelines and Article 7.8 of the World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Trade Facilitation.

ai.title: Introduction: Layunin at International Basis ng CAO
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Pambungad ito ng CAO. Sinasabi nitong gumagawa ang BOC ng standard na customs clearance process para sa cross-border e-Commerce goods na binili sa online shopping platforms, at naka-base ito sa tatlong international references: WCO Framework of Standards on Cross-Border e-Commerce, WCO Immediate Release Guidelines, at Article 7.8 ng WTO Agreement on Trade Facilitation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Parang 'mission statement' ng CAO. Dumarami ang nag-o-order online mula abroad, kaya imbes na ihalo sa regular na importation, may sariling standard na proseso na kapareho ng international practice. Kaya makikita mo sa buong CAO ang mga tema ng WCO: advance data, risk management, at mabilis na release ng low-risk shipments.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tatlong international references ang binanggit, at 'standard process' ang layunin. Walang detalye ng proseso rito. Nasa Sec. 4 pataas ang mga iyon. Magandang tandaan na 'immediate release' ang diwa ng WCO Guidelines at ng Art. 7.8 ng TFA.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Introduction ng CAO 01-2025. Ano ang WCO Framework of Standards on Cross-Border e-Commerce, ang WCO Immediate Release Guidelines, at ang Article 7.8 ng WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement? Magbigay ng practical example, sabihin kung bakit sila binanggit, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: This CAO shall cover the processing, clearance, and release of imported goods to be brought into the country by means of online trading platforms and e-retailer website encompassing Business-to-Consumer (B2C) transactions as defined in Republic Act No. 11967 or the Internet Transactions Act of 2023.

ai.title: Scope: Online B2C Importations
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sakop ng CAO ang processing, clearance, at release ng imported goods na pumapasok sa bansa sa pamamagitan ng online trading platforms at e-retailer websites, sa ilalim ng B2C transactions ayon sa RA 11967 (Internet Transactions Act of 2023).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kapag business ang nagbebenta at consumer ang bumibili online, at galing abroad ang item, sakop ito ng CAO. Ang depinisyon ng B2C ay hiniram sa ITA, hindi na ginawa ng BOC.

📦 Halimbawa: Bumili si Ana sa website ng isang overseas e-retailer at idinaan ito sa courier papuntang Pilipinas. B2C ito kaya pasok sa CAO. Kung kapwa consumer ang transaksyon (C2C), hindi na.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: B2C lang ang core scope. Tatlong activity ang sakop: processing, clearance, at release. May mga importations pa ring hindi ipo-process bilang e-Commerce goods kahit online binili, kaya basahin kasama ang Sec. 10.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 1 (Scope) ng CAO 01-2025. Ano ang B2C transaction sa ilalim ng Internet Transactions Act of 2023? Magbigay ng customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit B2C lang ang sakop, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: To provide for the procedures in the cargo clearance process of e-Commerce goods;

ai.title: Objective 2.1: Clearance Procedures
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Unang layunin ng CAO na maglatag ng procedures para sa cargo clearance process ng e-Commerce goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May sariling takbo ang online shipments (maraming maliliit na parcel, iba-ibang buyer), kaya hindi bagay sa karaniwang importation flow. Ang CAO ang nagbibigay ng framework, tapos ang detalyadong release procedures ay ilalabas sa CMO (Sec. 8).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Framework lang ito. Ang pinong detalye ng release ay hindi nasa CAO. Basahin ito kasama ng Sec. 4 (general provisions), Sec. 5 (system), at Sec. 8 (CMO).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Objective 2.1 ng CAO 01-2025 tungkol sa cargo clearance procedures ng e-Commerce goods. Magbigay ng practical example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: To provide for the accreditation of all stakeholders involved in e-Commerce transactions with the Bureau;

ai.title: Objective 2.2: Accreditation
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ikalawang layunin: magkaroon ng accreditation ng lahat ng stakeholders na kasali sa e-Commerce transactions sa BOC.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi puwedeng kahit sino ang gumalaw sa e-Commerce lane. Kailangang kilala ng BOC kung sino ang mga platform, e-retailer, forwarder, at broker para may pananagutan sila sa proseso.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 'All stakeholders' ang salita. Ang listahan at obligasyon ay nasa Sec. 6, at ang accreditation guidelines ay ilalabas pa ng BOC (Sec. 6.5).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Objective 2.2 ng CAO 01-2025 tungkol sa accreditation ng e-Commerce stakeholders. Magbigay ng practical example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: To prevent revenue leakage by ensuring the collection of the lawful and correct duties, taxes, and other charges on importations of e-Commerce shipments; and

ai.title: Objective 2.3: Prevent Revenue Leakage
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ikatlong layunin: pigilan ang revenue leakage sa pamamagitan ng pagkolekta ng lawful at correct na duties, taxes, at other charges sa e-Commerce shipments.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang revenue leakage ay ang dapat sanang nakolektang bayarin ng gobyerno na hindi nakuha. Dahil napakaraming maliliit na parcel, madaling mawala ang koleksyon kung walang maayos na sistema. Kaya may advance data, accreditation, at prepayment account.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang goal ay tamang koleksyon, hindi 'lahat may bayad'. May De Minimis Threshold na walang duty at tax (Sec. 3.16), pero may Import Processing Charge pa rin (Sec. 9).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Objective 2.3 ng CAO 01-2025 tungkol sa pag-iwas sa revenue leakage sa e-Commerce shipments. Magbigay ng customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: To implement a dedicated e-Commerce System that will assist the Bureau to efficiently and effectively monitor the entry of e-Commerce goods by optimizing the use of Information and Communication Technology (ICT).

ai.title: Objective 2.4: Dedicated e-Commerce System
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ika-apat na layunin: magpatupad ng dedicated e-Commerce System na tutulong sa BOC na mag-monitor ng pagpasok ng e-Commerce goods gamit ang Information and Communication Technology (ICT).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Imposibleng i-handle nang manual ang dami at bilis ng online shipments. Kaya may hiwalay na ICT system para sa kanila. Ang detalye ng system ay nasa Sec. 5.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Dalawang salita ang susi: 'efficiently' at 'effectively'. Ang system ay para sa monitoring ng entry ng e-Commerce goods.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Objective 2.4 ng CAO 01-2025 tungkol sa dedicated e-Commerce System at paggamit ng ICT. Magbigay ng practical example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Advanced Electronic Manifest — shall refer to the electronic submission to the Bureau of the Inward Foreign Cargo Manifest (IFCM) prior to the arrival of the carrying vessel or aircraft.

ai.title: Advanced Electronic Manifest
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Advanced Electronic Manifest ay ang electronic na pagsusumite sa BOC ng Inward Foreign Cargo Manifest (IFCM) bago dumating ang carrying vessel o aircraft.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Paunang listahan ito ng kargamento para makapag-assess na ang Customs bago pa lumapag o dumaong ang carrier.

📦 Halimbawa: Aalis pa lang ang eroplano mula abroad, naipasa na ng forwarder ang manifest sa BOC system. Advance iyon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Dalawang bagay ang kailangan: electronic at prior to arrival. Sa mismong pagsusumite para sa e-Commerce, e-CIFCM ang hinihingi ng Sec. 7.1.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.1 (Advanced Electronic Manifest) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, sabihin kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Air Waybill (AWB) — shall refer to a transport document for airfreight used by airlines and international freight forwarders which specify the holder or consignee of the bill who has the right to claim delivery of the goods when they arrive at the port of destination. It is a contract of carriage that includes carrier conditions, such as limits of liability and claims procedures. In addition, it contains transport instructions to airlines and carriers, a description of the goods, and applicable transportation charges.

ai.title: Air Waybill (AWB)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Air Waybill (AWB) ay transport document para sa airfreight na ginagamit ng airlines at international freight forwarders. Dito nakasaad kung sino ang holder o consignee na may karapatang kumuha ng goods sa destination. Contract of carriage din ito, may carrier conditions, transport instructions, description ng goods, at transportation charges.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang 'resibo at kontrata' ng kargamentong dumaan sa eroplano.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Para sa air ang AWB. Para sa sea, Bill of Lading ang katumbas (Sec. 3.3). Magkaiba rin ang master AWB at HAWB (Sec. 3.24): ang HAWB ang per-buyer na dokumento.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.2 (Air Waybill) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, sabihin kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions tulad ng AWB vs HAWB.

paragraphs.text: Bill of Lading (BL) — shall refer to a transport document issued by shipping lines, carriers and international freight forwarders or non-vessel operating common carriers for water-borne freight. The holder or consignee of the bill has the right to claim delivery of the goods at the port of destination. It is a contract of carriage that includes carrier conditions, such as limits of liability and claims procedures. In addition, it contains transport instructions to shipping lines and carriers, a description of the goods, and applicable transportation charges.

ai.title: Bill of Lading (BL)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Bill of Lading (BL) ay transport document para sa water-borne freight na inilalabas ng shipping lines, carriers, international freight forwarders, o NVOCC. Ang holder o consignee ang may karapatang kumuha ng goods sa port of destination. Contract of carriage din ito.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Sea version ng AWB.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Para sa dagat ang BL. Ang BL na per-buyer ay HBL (Sec. 3.25), at kasama ito sa data na kailangan sa e-CIFCM (Sec. 7.2).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.3 (Bill of Lading) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, sabihin kung bakit ito mahalaga sa clearance, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions tulad ng BL vs HBL.

paragraphs.text: Bureau — shall refer to the Bureau of Customs.

ai.title: Bureau
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang 'Bureau' sa CAO na ito ay ang Bureau of Customs lang.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kapag nabasa mo ang 'Bureau' kahit saan sa CAO, BOC ang tinutukoy, hindi ibang ahensya.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Mahalaga ito dahil ang ibang government agencies (regulatory agencies) ay hiwalay na binabanggit sa CAO, gaya sa Sec. 10.4 at Sec. 11.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.4 (Bureau) ng CAO 01-2025 at ang papel ng Bureau of Customs sa e-Commerce importations. Magbigay ng practical example, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Business-to-Business (B2B) Transaction — shall refer to internet transactions between businesses, such as between a manufacturer and a wholesaler, or a wholesaler and a retailer, whether the transacting parties are natural or juridical persons.

ai.title: B2B Transaction
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang B2B Transaction ay internet transaction sa pagitan ng mga negosyo (halimbawa manufacturer at wholesaler, o wholesaler at retailer), natural man o juridical persons ang mga partido.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Negosyo ang bumibili at negosyo rin ang nagbebenta.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Hindi sakop ng scope ang B2B, at excluded sa e-Commerce processing ang B2B na hindi binili sa accredited online platform (Sec. 10.2). Dalawang kondisyon iyon, kaya huwag i-generalize na 'lahat ng B2B ay excluded'.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.5 (B2B Transaction) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, sabihin kung bakit may hiwalay na depinisyon, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Business-to-Consumer (B2C) Transaction — shall refer to internet transactions between businesses and end-users or ultimate consignee.

ai.title: B2C Transaction
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang B2C Transaction ay internet transaction sa pagitan ng business at end-user o ultimate consignee.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Business ang seller, consumer ang buyer. Ito ang saklaw ng CAO ayon sa Sec. 1.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ikumpara sa B2B (Sec. 3.5) at C2C (Sec. 3.11). Ang end-user dito ay kaugnay ng 'ultimate consignee' sa Sec. 3.31.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.6 (B2C Transaction) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, sabihin kung bakit ito ang sakop ng CAO, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Clearance — shall refer to the completion of customs and other government formalities necessary to allow goods to enter for consumption, warehousing, transit or transshipment, or to be exported or placed under another customs procedure.

ai.title: Clearance
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Clearance ay ang pagkumpleto ng customs at iba pang government formalities para makapasok ang goods para sa consumption, warehousing, transit o transshipment, o ma-export o mailagay sa ibang customs procedure.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi lang ito pagbabayad ng duties at taxes. Ito ang buong pagtupad sa lahat ng kailangan para payagang gumalaw ang goods.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kasama ang 'other government formalities', kaya puwedeng may kailangan pang permit mula sa ibang ahensya. Kaugnay ito ng depinisyon sa CMTA Sec. 102.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.7 (Clearance) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, sabihin kung bakit mahalaga ang depinisyon, banggitin ang related CMTA Sec. 102(k), at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Clearance Agent — shall refer to the Freight Forwarders and Customs Brokers which are designated by the digital platform providers to process the clearance and release of e-Commerce goods.

ai.title: Clearance Agent
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Clearance Agent ay ang Freight Forwarders at Customs Brokers na dinedesignate ng digital platform providers para i-process ang clearance at release ng e-Commerce goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Sila ang humaharap sa BOC para sa platform. Sila rin ang puwedeng magsumite ng e-CIFCM (Sec. 7.1).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang platform provider ang nagdedesignate sa kanila. Dalawang uri lang ang binabanggit: Freight Forwarders at Customs Brokers.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.8 (Clearance Agent) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, sabihin kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Consolidated Inward Foreign Cargo Manifest (CIFCM) — shall refer to a true and accurate manifest, containing all house air waybills or bills of lading of all the individual shipments in the consolidation destined and intended to be unloaded at a port of entry in the Philippines, de-grouped or split from the master air waybills or bills of lading of shipments the consignees of which are just nominal such as banks, forwarders, and consolidators, submitted as rider to the inward foreign manifest of the carrying vessel or aircraft. In electronic format this also known as the Electronic Consolidated Inward Foreign Cargo Manifest (e-CIFCM).

ai.title: CIFCM / e-CIFCM
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CIFCM ay true at accurate na manifest na naglalaman ng lahat ng house air waybills o bills of lading ng individual shipments sa isang consolidation. Ito ay de-grouped o split mula sa master AWB o BL na nominal lang ang consignee (banks, forwarders, consolidators), at isinusumite bilang rider sa inward foreign manifest ng carrier. Sa electronic format, e-CIFCM ang tawag.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kung isang master bill lang pero maraming parcel ng iba't ibang buyer ang laman, ang CIFCM ang naglilista ng bawat isa sa house level.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: e-CIFCM ang hinihingi ng Sec. 7.1. Mapapansin mong 'e-CICFM' ang spelling sa ilang bahagi ng CAO (Sec. 5.2.1, 7.3), pero ang defined term ay e-CIFCM. Huwag ding ipagpalit sa IFCM (Sec. 3.26) na manifest ng buong sasakyan.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.9 (CIFCM / e-CIFCM) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example ng consolidation shipment, sabihin kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang pagkakaiba ng CIFCM at IFCM.

paragraphs.text: Consolidator — shall refer to a juridical person which procures transport of goods by sea or air and issues house bills of lading or house airway bills to consignors of shipments under its solicitation, to whom it directly assumes the liabilities and responsibilities of a carrier for the transportation of such goods from the point of receipt to the point of destination of such goods, and ships the shipments together in its name consigned to its Deconsolidation Agent in the Philippines.

ai.title: Consolidator
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Consolidator ay juridical person na kumukuha ng transport ng goods sa dagat o hangin, naglalabas ng house bills of lading o house airway bills sa mga consignor, direktang may liabilities ng isang carrier, at nagpapadala ng shipments nang sama-sama sa pangalan nito, consigned sa Deconsolidation Agent nito sa Pilipinas.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Siya ang nag-iipon ng maraming maliliit na shipments sa isang malaking kargamento at nananagot bilang carrier.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Juridical person ito at may liability ng carrier. Isa siya sa mga puwedeng magsumite ng e-CIFCM (Sec. 7.1).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.10 (Consolidator) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, sabihin kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang pagkakaiba ng Consolidator, Freight Forwarder, at NVOCC.

paragraphs.text: Consumer-to-Consumer (C2C) Transaction — shall refer to transactions between end-users done for personal, family, or household purposes and not done in the ordinary course of business, regardless of the platform used.

ai.title: C2C Transaction
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang C2C Transaction ay transaksyon sa pagitan ng mga end-user para sa personal, family, o household purposes at hindi bahagi ng ordinary course of business, anuman ang platform na ginamit.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Consumer sa consumer, parang pre-loved item na ibinenta ng isang tao sa isa pang tao.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Excluded sa e-Commerce processing ang C2C (Sec. 10.3). 'Regardless of the platform used' ang wording, kaya kahit sa malaking platform nangyari, C2C pa rin kung ganito ang katangian.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.11 (C2C Transaction) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, sabihin kung bakit excluded ito, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Correspondence and Documents (Category 1) — shall refer to those shipments which are Business, Inter-office, or Personal (BIP) in character and have no commercial value. Included under this category are diplomatic pouches with official seal.

ai.title: Category 1: Correspondence and Documents
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Category 1 ay mga shipment na Business, Inter-office, o Personal (BIP) ang katangian at walang commercial value. Kasama rito ang diplomatic pouches na may official seal.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mga sulat at dokumentong hindi ibebenta.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang dedicated e-Commerce Processing System ay para sa Category 2, 3, at 4 lang (Sec. 5.1), kaya wala rito ang Category 1. Binabanggit din ito bilang exception sa Sec. 10.1.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.12 (Correspondence and Documents, Category 1) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, sabihin kung bakit hiwalay ang kategoryang ito, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Customs Broker — shall refer to any person who is a bona fide holder of a valid Certificate of Registration/ Professional Identification Card issued by the Professional Regulatory Board and Professional Regulation Commission pursuant to Republic Act No. 9280, as amended, otherwise known as the “Customs Brokers Act of 2004”.

ai.title: Customs Broker
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Customs Broker ay taong bona fide holder ng valid Certificate of Registration/Professional Identification Card na inisyu ng Professional Regulatory Board at PRC ayon sa RA 9280, as amended (Customs Brokers Act of 2004).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Lisensyadong customs broker lang ang kuwalipikado.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Dapat valid ang registration at ID. Ang Customs Broker ay isa sa mga Clearance Agent (Sec. 3.8) at isa sa mga kailangang ma-accredit (Sec. 6.1).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.13 (Customs Broker) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag ang papel ng RA 9280 at CMTA Sec. 102(n), at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Digital Platform — shall refer to information and communication technology-enabled mechanisms that connect and integrate producers and users in online environments where goods and services are requested, developed, and sold, and data is generated and exchanged such as, but not limited to, e-marketplace, mobile application platforms, online delivery platforms, social media platforms, and travel platforms.

ai.title: Digital Platform
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Digital Platform ay ICT-enabled na mekanismo na nagkokonekta sa producers at users sa online environment kung saan nire-request, dine-develop, at ibinebenta ang goods at services, at may data na nagagawa at napapalitan. Halimbawa: e-marketplace, mobile apps, online delivery platforms, social media platforms, at travel platforms.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Malawak ang depinisyon. Hindi lang shopping websites ang sakop.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 'Such as, but not limited to' ang wording, kaya open-ended ang listahan. Ang e-marketplace (Sec. 3.17) ay isang uri lang ng digital platform.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.14 (Digital Platform) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical examples, sabihin kung bakit malawak ang depinisyon, banggitin ang Internet Transactions Act of 2023, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Digital Platform Provider (DPP) — shall refer to juridical entities that provide the platforms for the use of the suppliers and consumers for the exchange of goods and services.

ai.title: Digital Platform Provider (DPP)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Digital Platform Provider (DPP) ay juridical entity na nagbibigay ng platform para magamit ng suppliers at consumers sa palitan ng goods at services.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang may-ari o operator ng platform kung saan nagkikita ang seller at buyer.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Juridical entity ito (hindi natural person). Kailangan silang ma-accredit (Sec. 6.1) at sila ang gumagawa ng data para sa clearance agents (Sec. 6.4).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.15 (Digital Platform Provider) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, sabihin ang papel ng DPP sa clearance, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: De Minimis Threshold — shall refer to the FOB or FCA value not exceeding ten thousand pesos (P10,000.00) or as may be adjusted under Section 423 of the Customs Modernization and Tariff Act (CMTA), for which no duty or tax is collected on the imported goods.

ai.title: De Minimis Threshold
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang De Minimis Threshold ay FOB o FCA value na hindi lalampas sa P10,000.00, o kung ano ang i-adjust sa ilalim ng Sec. 423 ng CMTA, kung saan walang duty o tax na kinokolekta sa imported goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kapag ang FOB/FCA value ay P10,000 o mas mababa, walang duty at tax. Ang basehan ay FOB o FCA value, hindi ang kabuuang binayaran ng buyer.

📦 Halimbawa: May item na FOB value P8,000. Pasok sa de minimis kaya walang duty at tax, pero may processing charge at may regulatory requirements pa rin kung regulated ang item.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Pasok pa rin ang eksaktong P10,000.00 dahil 'not exceeding' ang wording. May Import Processing Charge pa rin sa goods na pasok dito (Sec. 9). Ito ang hangganan ng Category 2 (Sec. 3.29) at Category 3 (Sec. 3.28).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.16 (De Minimis Threshold) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng numerical customs example, ipaliwanag ang CMTA Sec. 423, at linawin ang common misconceptions tulad ng FOB/FCA value vs presyo.

paragraphs.text: E-marketplace — shall refer to digital platforms whose business is to connect online consumers with online merchants, facilitate and conclude the sales, process the payment of the products, goods or services through the platform, or facilitate the shipment of goods or provide logistics services and post-purchase support within such platforms, and otherwise retains oversight over the consummation of the transaction.

ai.title: E-marketplace
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang E-marketplace ay digital platform na nagkokonekta sa online consumers at online merchants, tumutulong magsara ng sales, nagpo-process ng payment, o nag-aasikaso ng shipment, logistics, at post-purchase support, at nagpapanatili ng oversight sa pagkumpleto ng transaksyon.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Platform na may kontrol sa buong transaksyon, hindi lang listahan ng mga produkto.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Iba ito sa e-retailer (Sec. 3.18) na direktang nagbebenta sa sarili niyang website.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.17 (E-marketplace) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical example, sabihin ang pagkakaiba ng e-marketplace at e-retailer, banggitin ang Internet Transactions Act of 2023, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: E-retailer — shall refer to a natural or juridical person selling goods or services directly to online consumers through its own website, webpage or application.

ai.title: E-retailer
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang E-retailer ay natural o juridical person na direktang nagbebenta ng goods o services sa online consumers sa pamamagitan ng sarili niyang website, webpage, o application.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang seller mismo ang may-ari ng online store.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Puwedeng natural o juridical person. Ang pagkakaiba sa e-marketplace: sariling website ng seller ang e-retailer, samantalang ang e-marketplace ay platform na nagkokonekta ng maraming merchant.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.18 (E-retailer) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical example, sabihin ang pagkakaiba nito sa e-marketplace, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Electronic Commerce (E-Commerce) Transactions — shall refer to the sale or purchase of goods or services, conducted over digital platforms or other computer networks by methods specifically designed for the purpose of receiving or placing of orders.

ai.title: E-Commerce Transactions
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang E-Commerce Transactions ay pagbebenta o pagbili ng goods o services sa digital platforms o ibang computer networks gamit ang methods na espesyal na dinisenyo para sa pagtanggap o paglalagay ng orders.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Online order at online sale.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang mahalaga ay ang paraan: dapat dinisenyo para sa pag-order. Hindi sapat na may email lang na pinag-usapan ang bilihan.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.19 (E-Commerce Transactions) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical example, banggitin ang OECD definition at related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Free Carrier (FCA) — shall refer to an international commercial term which means that the seller delivers the goods to the carrier or another person nominated by the buyer at the seller's premises or another named place. The parties of this type of sale should specify clearly as possible the point within the named place of delivery, as the risk passes to the buyer at that point.

ai.title: Free Carrier (FCA)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang FCA ay international commercial term kung saan inihahatid ng seller ang goods sa carrier o sa taong itinalaga ng buyer, sa premises ng seller o sa ibang named place. Dapat malinaw ang eksaktong point of delivery dahil doon lumilipat ang risk sa buyer.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pagkabigay ng seller sa carrier sa napagkasunduang lugar, ang risk ay sa buyer na.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: FCA o FOB ang ginagamit na basehan ng value sa De Minimis at sa Categories 2 hanggang 4. Pang-lahat ng modes ang FCA, samantalang pang-barko ang FOB (Sec. 3.21).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.20 (FCA) ng CAO 01-2025 at ng Incoterms. Magbigay ng practical example, ipaliwanag kung bakit mahalaga ang FCA value sa categories, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Free On-Board (FOB) — shall refer to an international commercial term which means that the seller delivers the goods on board the vessel nominated by the buyer at the named port of shipment or procures the goods already delivered. The risk of loss of or damage to the goods passes when the goods are on board the vessel, and the buyer bears all costs from the moment onwards.

ai.title: Free On-Board (FOB)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang FOB ay international commercial term kung saan inihahatid ng seller ang goods sa barkong itinalaga ng buyer sa named port of shipment, o kumukuha ng goods na naihatid na. Napupunta sa buyer ang risk of loss o damage kapag nasa barko na ang goods, at siya na ang sasagot sa lahat ng costs mula noon.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kapag nasa barko na ang kargamento, ang buyer na ang may risk at gastos.

📦 Halimbawa: Ang item ay P9,500 FOB. Kahit may freight at insurance pa pagdating, ang FOB value pa rin ang tinitingnan para sa threshold.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kasama ang FCA, FOB ang basehan ng value sa thresholds at categories. Ibig sabihin, hindi kasama sa halagang ito ang freight at insurance pagkatapos ng pagkarga.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.21 (FOB) ng CAO 01-2025 at ng Incoterms. Magbigay ng numerical example ng FOB value, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito ang basehan ng thresholds, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Freight Forwarder — shall refer to a local entity that acts as a cargo intermediary and facilitates transport of goods on behalf of its client without assuming the role of a carrier, which can also perform other forwarding services, such as booking cargo space, negotiating freight rates, preparing documents, advancing freight payments, providing packing/crating, trucking and warehousing, engaging as an agent/representative of a foreign non-vessel operating as a common carrier/cargo consolidator named in a master bill of lading as consignee of a consolidated shipment, and other related undertakings. It shall also refer to a local freight forwarder or consolidator's agent or representative situated at the country of importation that provides services to ungroup or deconsolidate shipments, orders, goods, etc. to facilitate distribution.

ai.title: Freight Forwarder
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Freight Forwarder ay local entity na cargo intermediary na tumutulong sa transport ng goods para sa kliyente nang hindi nagiging carrier. Puwede rin itong mag-book ng cargo space, mag-negotiate ng freight rates, maghanda ng documents, mag-advance ng freight payments, mag-packing, trucking, at warehousing, at maging agent ng foreign NVOCC o consolidator na nakapangalang consignee sa master bill of lading. Kasama rin ang local forwarder o agent na nagde-deconsolidate ng shipments sa importing country.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Siya ang middleman na nag-aasikaso ng galaw ng kargamento pero hindi siya ang carrier mismo.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Hindi siya carrier. Kailangang accredited ang forwarder (Sec. 6.1) at siya ang obligadong magbukas ng Prepayment Account sa BOC (Sec. 12). Puwede rin siyang magsumite ng e-CIFCM (Sec. 7.1).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.22 (Freight Forwarder) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag ang pagkakaiba ng Freight Forwarder, Consolidator, at Customs Broker, banggitin ang CMTA Sec. 102(aa), at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: High-Value Goods (Category 4) — shall refer to goods of a commercial nature with FOB or FCA value of Fifty Thousand Pesos (Php50,000.00) or over.

ai.title: High-Value Goods (Category 4)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang High-Value Goods (Category 4) ay goods na commercial ang katangian at may FOB o FCA value na Php50,000.00 o higit pa.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pinakamataas na halaga sa mga category na dadaan sa e-Commerce system.

📦 Halimbawa: FOB value na Php50,000.00: Category 4. Php49,999.00: Category 3.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kasama ang eksaktong Php50,000.00 sa Category 4. Kasama ito sa Category 2, 3, at 4 na puwedeng i-process sa dedicated system (Sec. 5.1).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.23 (High-Value Goods, Category 4) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng numerical example, ihambing sa Category 2 at 3, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions sa boundary na Php50,000.00.

paragraphs.text: House Air Waybill (HAWB) — shall refer to an air waybill covering a single, individual shipment or consignment issued by the freight forwarder or consolidator to a consignor or sender containing the names and addresses, respectively, of both the consignor or sender and the consignee or receiver and the detailed, specific description of good shipped by air.

ai.title: House Air Waybill (HAWB)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang HAWB ay air waybill para sa isang individual shipment o consignment na inilalabas ng freight forwarder o consolidator sa consignor o sender. Nakalagay ang pangalan at address ng consignor at consignee at ang detalyadong description ng goods na dinala sa hangin.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang indibidwal na air waybill ng bawat package sa loob ng consolidated shipment.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: HAWB o HBL ng bawat ultimate consignee ang kailangang isumite sa BOC automated system (Sec. 7.5). Iba ito sa master AWB na nakapangalan sa consolidator o forwarder.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.24 (HAWB) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag ang pagkakaiba ng HAWB at MAWB, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: House Bill of Lading (HBL) — shall refer to a bill of lading covering a single, individual shipment or consignment issued by the international sea freight forwarder, NVOCC or a consolidator to the respective shippers containing the names and addresses, respectively, of both the consignor or sender and the consignee or receiver and the detailed, specific description of the goods shipped through sea.

ai.title: House Bill of Lading (HBL)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang HBL ay bill of lading para sa isang individual shipment o consignment na inilalabas ng international sea freight forwarder, NVOCC, o consolidator sa mga shipper. Nakalagay ang pangalan at address ng consignor at consignee at ang detalyadong description ng goods na dinala sa dagat.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Sea version ng HAWB.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Isa ang HBL number sa data elements ng e-CIFCM (Sec. 7.2), at isinusumite ito per ultimate consignee (Sec. 7.5). Kasama rin sa required data ang MBL (master) number.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.25 (HBL) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag ang pagkakaiba ng HBL at MBL, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Inward Foreign Cargo Manifest (IFCM) — shall refer to the Cargo Manifest of all shipments destined and intended to be unloaded at a port of entry in the Philippines for consumption, admission, or warehousing, and contains a detailed list of cargoes (freight) on board a Vessel or Aircraft giving the commercial particulars of the goods, such as transport document numbers, consignors, consignees, marks and numbers, number and kind of packages, weight, descriptions, quantities of the goods and destination. In electronic format, it is also known as Electronic Inward Foreign Cargo Manifest (e-IFCM).

ai.title: Inward Foreign Cargo Manifest (IFCM)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang IFCM ay cargo manifest ng lahat ng shipments na ia-unload sa port of entry sa Pilipinas para sa consumption, admission, o warehousing. Nakalista rito ang cargoes sa barko o eroplano at ang commercial particulars gaya ng transport document numbers, consignors, consignees, marks and numbers, bilang at uri ng packages, timbang, descriptions, quantities, at destination. Sa electronic format, e-IFCM ang tawag.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kumpletong listahan ng laman ng sasakyang dumating.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang IFCM ang pangunahing manifest ng buong carrier. Ang CIFCM (Sec. 3.9) ay rider na naka-break down sa house level. Ang e-IFCM ay tinatalakay sa Sec. 5.2.1.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.26 (IFCM / e-IFCM) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag ang pagkakaiba ng IFCM at CIFCM, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Intrinsic Value — shall refer to the actual price or value of a particular goods for sale, in Philippine currency, as posted in the digital platform on the date of sale, excluding transport and insurance costs, unless they are included in the price and not separately indicated on the invoice, and any other taxes and charges as ascertainable by the customs authorities from any relevant documents.

ai.title: Intrinsic Value
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Intrinsic Value ay aktuwal na presyo ng goods na ibinebenta, sa Philippine currency, ayon sa naka-post sa digital platform sa petsa ng sale. Hindi kasama ang transport at insurance costs, maliban kung kasama ito sa presyo at hindi hiwalay na nakasaad sa invoice, at pati na ang ibang taxes at charges na maa-ascertain ng customs authorities sa relevant documents.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang presyong nakalista sa platform noong araw ng bilihan, naka-peso, at karaniwang walang shipping at insurance.

📦 Halimbawa: Naka-post ang item sa platform sa halagang P3,000 at may hiwalay na shipping fee na P500. Ang intrinsic value ay P3,000.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Isa ito sa data elements sa e-CIFCM (Sec. 7.2). Magkaiba ito sa Declared Value per Item, na FOB/FCA value, at sa binayarang kabuuan ng buyer.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.27 (Intrinsic Value) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng numerical example (presyo sa platform, shipping, insurance), ipaliwanag kung paano ito naiiba sa FOB/FCA value, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Low-Value, Dutiable Goods (Category 3) — shall refer to goods of a commercial nature with FOB or FCA value of more than the De Minimis Threshold but less than fifty thousand pesos (Php50,000.00).

ai.title: Low-Value, Dutiable Goods (Category 3)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Category 3 ay goods na commercial ang katangian at may FOB o FCA value na higit sa De Minimis Threshold pero mas mababa sa Php50,000.00.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Lampas sa de minimis kaya dutiable, pero hindi pa high-value.

📦 Halimbawa: FOB value na P20,000 ay Category 3.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Higit sa De Minimis at mas mababa sa Php50,000.00. Kapag eksaktong Php50,000.00, Category 4 na (Sec. 3.23). Kapag eksaktong de minimis, Category 2 pa (Sec. 3.29).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.28 (Category 3) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng numerical example, ihambing sa Category 2 at 4, ipaliwanag kung bakit dutiable ito, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Low-Value, Non-Dutiable Goods (Category 2) — shall refer to the goods with an FOB or FCA value not exceeding the De Minimis Threshold.

ai.title: Low-Value, Non-Dutiable Goods (Category 2)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Category 2 ay goods na may FOB o FCA value na hindi lalampas sa De Minimis Threshold.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mababa o pantay sa de minimis ang halaga kaya non-dutiable.

📦 Halimbawa: Item na FOB value P7,000: Category 2, walang duty at tax pero may processing charge.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Non-dutiable pero may Import Processing Charge (Sec. 9), at hindi nawawala ang requirements ng regulatory agencies (Sec. 10.4, Sec. 11). Pasok ito sa dedicated system (Sec. 5.1).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.29 (Category 2) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical example, ipaliwanag kung bakit non-dutiable pero may processing charge, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC) — refers to an entity, which may or may not own or operate a vessel that provides a point-to-point service which may include several modes of transport and/or undertakes groupage of less container load (LCL) shipments and issues the corresponding transport document.

ai.title: NVOCC
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang NVOCC ay entity na puwedeng may-ari o hindi ng vessel, nagbibigay ng point-to-point service na puwedeng sumaklaw sa iba't ibang modes of transport at/o nag-gagroupage ng less container load (LCL) shipments, at naglalabas ng kaukulang transport document.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kumikilos siyang carrier sa mata ng shipper kahit hindi siya laging may sariling barko.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Isa siya sa mga puwedeng magsumite ng e-CIFCM at HBL (Sec. 7.1, 7.5). Ang HBL ay isa sa mga dokumentong inilalabas ng NVOCC (Sec. 3.25).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.30 (NVOCC) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example na may LCL, ipaliwanag ang pagkakaiba ng NVOCC at shipping line, banggitin ang CMTA Sec. 102(ee), at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Ultimate Consignee — For this purpose, shall refer to the individual buyer of the cross-border e-Commerce goods transacted through the online trading platform.

ai.title: Ultimate Consignee
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Para sa CAO na ito, ang Ultimate Consignee ay ang individual buyer ng cross-border e-Commerce goods na binili sa online trading platform.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang tunay na bumili at tatanggap ng package, hindi ang forwarder o consolidator na nominal consignee lang sa master bill.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: HAWB o HBL ng bawat ultimate consignee ang isinusumite (Sec. 7.5), at ang e-CIFCM ay para matukoy ang bawat shipment na naka-consign sa kanila (Sec. 7.2).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.31 (Ultimate Consignee) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag ang pagkakaiba ng nominal consignee at ultimate consignee, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Value Added Service Provider (VASP) — shall refer to any Bureau-accredited ICT company who may provide the services enumerated under Section 4.1 of CAO No. 14-2020 and collect transaction fees as authorized by the Bureau. It shall also refer to an e-Commerce Processing System (EPS) Service Provider which shall provide services related to managing and facilitating customs clearance process for cross-border e-Commerce goods.

ai.title: Value Added Service Provider (VASP)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang VASP ay anumang Bureau-accredited ICT company na puwedeng magbigay ng services na nakalista sa Sec. 4.1 ng CAO 14-2020 at maningil ng transaction fees na pinahintulutan ng Bureau. Kasama rito ang e-Commerce Processing System (EPS) Service Provider na nagma-manage at nagpapadali ng customs clearance process para sa cross-border e-Commerce goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pribadong ICT company na accredited ng BOC para magpatakbo ng system na tumutulong sa clearance.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang EPS Service Provider ay isang uri ng VASP. May cap sa singil nito (Sec. 5.6) at monitoring fee sa BOC (Sec. 5.7). Kailangan ding accredited ang VASP (Sec. 6.1).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 3.32 (VASP at EPS Service Provider) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical example, ipaliwanag ang ugnayan sa CAO 14-2020, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Advance Electronic Data. Consistent with existing laws, rules, and regulations, including mutual arrangements and agreements, there shall be an advanced exchange of electronic data between relevant parties involved in the e-Commerce supply chain, including relevant government agencies to enhance trade facilitation and control measures on cross-border e-Commerce goods, taking into account data security, privacy, protection and ownership. Relevant WCO and other international standards and guidance shall be implemented in an effective and harmonized manner, to facilitate the exchange of advance electronic data. For this purpose, the Bureau shall pursue data-sharing arrangements or advance information exchange with digital platform providers and other e-Commerce stakeholders, to allow risk management evaluation and analysis, as well as data mining and gathering for statistical and post clearance audit purposes.

ai.title: Advance Electronic Data
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Dapat may advanced exchange ng electronic data sa pagitan ng mga partido sa e-Commerce supply chain, kasama ang government agencies, habang isinasaalang-alang ang data security, privacy, protection, at ownership. Magtataguyod ang BOC ng data-sharing arrangements sa digital platform providers at ibang stakeholders para sa risk management evaluation, data mining, statistics, at post-clearance audit.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ibabahagi nang maaga ng platforms ang data ng shipments para makapag-assess ang BOC bago pa dumating ang kargamento.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tatlong gamit ng data: risk management, statistical purposes, at post-clearance audit. Hindi inaalis ang data privacy obligations (tingnan ang Sec. 6.3.3 at Sec. 13).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 4.1 (Advance Electronic Data) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit mahalaga ang advance data sa risk management at post-clearance audit, banggitin ang WCO Standards 1 at 2, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Advance Submission of Manifest. A true and complete copy of the Cargo Manifest shall be electronically sent in advance as provided under existing customs rules and regulations.

ai.title: Advance Submission of Manifest
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang true at complete na kopya ng Cargo Manifest ay ipapadala nang electronic at in advance, ayon sa umiiral na customs rules at regulations.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Bago dumating ang carrier, dapat nasa BOC na ang kumpletong manifest.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tatlong salita: true at complete (nilalaman), electronic (paraan), in advance (timing). Ang mga detalye ng e-CIFCM, cut-off, at supplemental manifest ay nasa Sec. 7.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 4.2 (Advance Submission of Manifest) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit kailangang advance, banggitin ang Sec. 7 at ibang customs rules, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Risk Management. The Bureau shall develop and apply a dynamic risk management structure with advanced technologies that are specific to the e-Commerce context in order to identify goods and shipments that present a risk. The Bureau shall use data analytics and screening methodologies in conjunction with non-intrusive inspection equipment, across all modes of transportation and operators, as part of risk management, with a view to facilitating cross-border e-Commerce flows and strengthening customs controls.

ai.title: Risk Management
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Gagawa at gagamit ang BOC ng dynamic risk management structure na may advanced technologies na akma sa e-Commerce para matukoy ang goods at shipments na may risk. Gagamit ito ng data analytics at screening methodologies kasabay ng non-intrusive inspection equipment sa lahat ng modes of transportation at operators.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi lahat ng package bubuksan. Ang mataas ang risk ang ife-focus, kaya mas mabilis ang low-risk.

📦 Halimbawa: Mula sa advance data, na-flag ng system ang isang shipment dahil kakaiba ang deklarasyon. Ito ang ie-examine, habang ang ibang low-risk na parcel ay mabilis na nare-release.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Dalawa ang layunin: facilitating cross-border e-Commerce flows at strengthening customs controls. Balanse ng bilis at kontrol.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 4.3 (Risk Management) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example gamit ang data analytics at non-intrusive inspection, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang WCO Standards 4 at 5, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: For this purpose, the Bureau shall work with accredited e-Commerce stakeholders and relevant government agencies, as appropriate, to improve the timeliness, completeness, and accuracy of advance electronic data with a view to supporting robust and effective risk management techniques and facilitate legitimate trade of e-Commerce goods.

ai.title: Pakikipagtulungan para sa Mas Magandang Data
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Makikipagtrabaho ang BOC sa accredited e-Commerce stakeholders at kaugnay na government agencies, kung angkop, para pagandahin ang timeliness, completeness, at accuracy ng advance electronic data.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mas maaga, kumpleto, at tama ang data, mas gagana ang risk management at hindi maaantala ang lehitimong kalakal. Kailangan dito ng tulong ng platforms at forwarders dahil sila ang pinagmumulan ng data.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Karugtong ito ng Sec. 4.3. Tatlong qualities ng data: timely, complete, at accurate. Ang layunin: suportahan ang risk management at padaliin ang legitimate trade.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang karugtong na talata ng Section 4.3 ng CAO 01-2025 tungkol sa pakikipagtulungan ng BOC sa accredited stakeholders at government agencies. Magbigay ng practical example, banggitin ang WCO Standard 3, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Simplified Clearance Procedures. The Bureau shall establish and maintain simplified clearance formalities/procedures utilizing the dedicated e-Commerce Processing System for the pre-arrival processing and risk assessment of cross-border e-Commerce goods and provide procedures for the immediate release of low-risk shipments on arrival or departure. Simplified clearance formalities/procedures shall include, as appropriate, an account-based system for collecting duties, taxes and other charges, as well as handling return shipments.

ai.title: Simplified Clearance Procedures
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Magtatatag at magpapanatili ang BOC ng simplified clearance formalities gamit ang dedicated e-Commerce Processing System para sa pre-arrival processing at risk assessment, at may procedures para sa immediate release ng low-risk shipments pagdating o pag-alis. Kasama, kung angkop, ang account-based system sa pagkolekta ng duties, taxes, at charges, at ang paghawak ng return shipments.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mauuna ang processing bago dumating ang goods, kaya mabilis ang low-risk. Account-based ang bayaran at may proseso rin para sa returns.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Apat ang tandaan: pre-arrival processing, immediate release ng low-risk, account-based collection, at return shipments. Kaugnay ng account-based system ang Prepayment Account (Sec. 12).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 4.4 (Simplified Clearance Procedures) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example ng low-risk shipment, ipaliwanag ang account-based system, banggitin ang WCO Standard 6 at Sec. 12, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Missorted or Misrouted e-Commerce Goods. Treatment of missorted or misrouted e-Commerce goods shall follow the procedures under Section 10 of CAO No. 05-2020 with Subject: Customs Clearance Procedures on Express Shipments.

ai.title: Missorted o Misrouted Goods
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang treatment ng missorted o misrouted e-Commerce goods ay susunod sa procedures sa Section 10 ng CAO 05-2020 (Customs Clearance Procedures on Express Shipments).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi gumawa ng bagong proseso ang CAO na ito. Ginagamit ang umiiral na procedure ng express shipments.

📦 Halimbawa: Napunta sa Manila ang parcel na dapat sa ibang bansa. Susundin ang procedure sa CAO 05-2020, at dapat ma-re-export sa loob ng 24 oras ayon sa Sec. 12.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Section 10 ng CAO 05-2020 ang sanggunian. Tingnan din ang Sec. 12 ng CAO na ito: sasagutin ng Prepayment Account ang bayarin kung hindi na-re-export sa loob ng 24 oras o walang proof of landing.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 4.5 (Missorted or Misrouted e-Commerce Goods) ng CAO 01-2025. Ano ang missorted at misrouted? Magbigay ng practical example, banggitin ang Sec. 10 ng CAO 05-2020 at Sec. 12 ng CAO na ito, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Application of Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) Program to Cross-Border e-Commerce. The Bureau shall explore the possibilities of applying AEO Programs and Mutual Recognition Arrangements in the context of cross-border e-Commerce, including leveraging the role of intermediaries, to enable Micro, Small, and Medium-sized Enterprises and individuals to fully benefit from the opportunities of cross-border e-Commerce.

ai.title: AEO Program sa Cross-Border e-Commerce
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Susuriin ng BOC ang posibilidad na ilapat ang Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) Programs at Mutual Recognition Arrangements sa cross-border e-Commerce, kasama ang paggamit sa papel ng intermediaries, para makinabang ang Micro, Small, at Medium-sized Enterprises at individuals.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pinag-aaralan pa lang ito. Ang AEO ay programa kung saan binibigyan ng benepisyo ang mga mapagkakatiwalaang operator. Hindi pa ito obligasyon o final na programa sa CAO na ito.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 'Shall explore' ang wika, ibig sabihin pag-aaral ng posibilidad at hindi garantiya ng implementation. Target beneficiaries: MSMEs at individuals.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 4.6 (AEO Program sa Cross-Border e-Commerce) ng CAO 01-2025. Ano ang AEO at Mutual Recognition Arrangements? Magbigay ng practical example, banggitin ang WCO Standard 7, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Leveraging Transformative Technologies. The Bureau, in collaboration with the private sector and academia, shall explore innovative technological development and consider adopting such developments that can contribute to a more effective and efficient control and facilitation of cross-border e-Commerce.

ai.title: Leveraging Transformative Technologies
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Makikipagtulungan ang BOC sa private sector at academia para galugarin ang mga bagong teknolohiya at pag-isipang gamitin ang mga makakatulong sa mas epektibo at episyenteng control at facilitation ng cross-border e-Commerce.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Bukas ang BOC sa makabagong teknolohiya para mapaganda ang proseso, at hindi lang sariling ideya ang gagamitin dahil kasali ang private sector at academia.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 'Explore' at 'consider adopting' ang wika, kaya hindi mandatory na gamitin ang bawat bagong teknolohiya.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 4.7 (Leveraging Transformative Technologies) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical example ng technology sa customs, ipaliwanag ang papel ng private sector at academia, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The Bureau shall intensify its engagement with other relevant government agencies as appropriate to simplify customs procedures and facilitate customs clearance of e-Commerce goods.

ai.title: Pakikipag-ugnayan sa Ibang Ahensya
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Palalakasin ng BOC ang pakikipag-ugnayan sa ibang kaugnay na government agencies, kung angkop, para mapasimple ang customs procedures at mapabilis ang clearance ng e-Commerce goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Maraming e-Commerce goods ang may requirements mula sa ibang ahensya (permits, clearances). Kapag maayos ang koordinasyon, hindi nagkakabuhol sa release.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Karugtong ito ng Sec. 4.7. Kaugnay ng Sec. 4.8, Sec. 10.4, at Sec. 11 sa regulated at restricted goods.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang karugtong na talata ng Section 4.7 ng CAO 01-2025 tungkol sa pakikipag-ugnayan ng BOC sa ibang ahensya. Magbigay ng practical example, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Customs Control over E-Commerce Goods. Nothing in this CAO shall affect the right of the Bureau to examine, detain, seize, confiscate or refuse entry of goods, or to carry out post-clearance audits, including the use of risk management systems. Further, nothing in this CAO shall prevent the Bureau from requiring, as a condition for release, the submission of additional information and the fulfilment of additional regulatory requirements.

ai.title: Customs Control over E-Commerce Goods
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Walang nakasaad sa CAO na makakaapekto sa karapatan ng BOC na mag-examine, mag-detain, mag-seize, mag-confiscate, o tumangging payagang pumasok ang goods, o magsagawa ng post-clearance audits, kasama ang paggamit ng risk management systems. Hindi rin napipigilan ang BOC na humingi ng karagdagang impormasyon at requirements bilang kondisyon ng release.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kahit pinadadali ang proseso, hawak pa rin ng BOC ang kapangyarihang kontrolin ang goods.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Hindi nangangahulugang wala nang inspeksyon ang simplified clearance. Puwedeng humingi ang BOC ng additional information at regulatory requirements bago mag-release.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 4.8 (Customs Control over E-Commerce Goods) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit nananatili ang kapangyarihan ng BOC, banggitin ang CMTA provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

sections.heading: Section 5. Establishment of a Dedicated Customs e-Commerce Processing System

paragraphs.text: The Bureau shall establish a simplified and dedicated ICT-enabled e-Commerce Processing System that will enable exclusive processing, lodgment, clearance and release of e-Commerce goods classified as Category 2, 3, and 4, of accredited stakeholders.

ai.title: Dedicated e-Commerce Processing System
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Magtatatag ang BOC ng simplified at dedicated ICT-enabled e-Commerce Processing System para sa exclusive processing, lodgment, clearance, at release ng e-Commerce goods na Category 2, 3, at 4 ng accredited stakeholders.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May sariling system para sa e-Commerce goods, at accredited stakeholders lang ang puwedeng gumamit.

📦 Halimbawa: Ang parcel na FOB P30,000 (Category 3) mula sa accredited platform ay idadaan sa dedicated system. Ang parcel na puro dokumento na walang commercial value (Category 1) ay hindi.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Category 2, 3, at 4 lang ang sakop. Wala ang Category 1. Accredited stakeholders lang ang gagamit (Sec. 6.2).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 5.1 (Dedicated e-Commerce Processing System) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit hindi kasama ang Category 1, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The ICT-enabled e-Commerce Processing System shall support the following:

ai.title: Mga Sinusuportahan ng System
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Introduction ito sa listahan ng mga function na dapat suportahan ng ICT-enabled e-Commerce Processing System, na nasa 5.2.1 hanggang 5.2.4.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang 'minimum features' ng system: pagpasa ng manifest data, paghain ng declarations, pakikipag-ugnayan sa platforms, at iba pang services na itatakda ng Commissioner.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Apat ang items: (1) e-IFCM at e-CIFCM data, (2) lodgment ng declarations pagkatapos ng manifest validation, (3) interoperability, (4) iba pang services ng Commissioner.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 5.2 ng CAO 01-2025 at ang mga functions na dapat suportahan ng e-Commerce Processing System. Magbigay ng practical example, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Transmittal of e-IFCM as may be practicable, and submission of e-CICFM data of shipments of registered e-Commerce operators by their appointed freight forwarder, NVOCC, consolidator or Clearance Agent, within the period mandated by existing rules and regulations. Such data shall be used for simplified or consolidated declaration and may qualify for pre-clearance processing.

ai.title: Transmittal ng e-IFCM at e-CIFCM Data
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Susuportahan ng system ang transmittal ng e-IFCM, kung practicable, at ang pagsusumite ng manifest data ng shipments ng registered e-Commerce operators sa pamamagitan ng appointed freight forwarder, NVOCC, consolidator, o Clearance Agent, sa loob ng mandated period. Gagamitin ang data para sa simplified o consolidated declaration at puwedeng mag-qualify sa pre-clearance processing.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang naisumiteng manifest data ang magiging basehan ng mas simpleng declaration at mas maagang processing.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Appointed freight forwarder, NVOCC, consolidator, o Clearance Agent ang nagsusumite. Mapapansin mong 'e-CICFM' ang spelling dito, pero e-CIFCM ang defined term (Sec. 3.9). Ang e-IFCM ay 'as may be practicable' lang.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 5.2.1 ng CAO 01-2025 tungkol sa e-IFCM at e-CICFM data. Magbigay ng practical customs example ng simplified o consolidated declaration, ipaliwanag ang pre-clearance processing, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Lodgment of e-Commerce goods declarations after the validation of the manifest submission.

ai.title: Lodgment ng Declarations
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang paghahain (lodgment) ng e-Commerce goods declarations ay gagawin pagkatapos ma-validate ang manifest submission.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Manifest muna, validation, saka declaration.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang pagkakasunod-sunod ang punto: manifest submission, validation, lodgment ng declaration. Hindi puwedeng mauna ang declaration.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 5.2.2 ng CAO 01-2025 tungkol sa lodgment ng declarations pagkatapos ng manifest validation. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ganito ang pagkakasunod-sunod, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Interoperability with the systems of digital platform providers and other e-Commerce stakeholders, to enable data-sharing and advance information exchange.

ai.title: Interoperability
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Dapat kayang makipag-ugnayan ng system sa mga system ng digital platform providers at ibang e-Commerce stakeholders para sa data-sharing at advance information exchange.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi dapat magkahiwalay ang mga sistema. Dapat nagkakaintindihan ang data ng BOC at ng platforms para hindi na manu-manong ipasa ang impormasyon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Interoperability ang tawag dito. Kaugnay ng Sec. 4.1 (advance electronic data) at Sec. 6.4 (data mula sa platforms).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 5.2.3 (Interoperability) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical example ng data-sharing sa pagitan ng BOC at platform, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito mahalaga, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Other services as may be defined and determined by the Commissioner.

ai.title: Iba pang Services
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Puwedeng magdagdag ng ibang services ang system na idedefine at idedetermina ng Commissioner.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Flexible ang system. Kapag may bagong kailangan, hindi na kailangang baguhin ang buong CAO para idagdag ito.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Nasa discretion ng Commissioner ang karagdagang services. Katulad na 'catch-all' ang Sec. 10.6, na may approval pa ng Secretary of Finance.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 5.2.4 ng CAO 01-2025 tungkol sa ibang services na itatakda ng Commissioner. Magbigay ng practical example, ipaliwanag ang kapangyarihan ng Commissioner, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Pending the establishment of a facility and implementation of an ICT-enabled e-Commerce Processing System, the Bureau may enlist the services of third-party solutions providers, consistent with the guidelines set forth under CAO No. 14-2020 with Subject: Accreditation and Regulation of Bureau of Customs Value-Added Service Providers (VASP).

ai.title: Third-Party Solutions Providers
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Habang hindi pa naitatayo ang facility at ang ICT-enabled e-Commerce Processing System, puwedeng kumuha ang BOC ng third-party solutions providers, alinsunod sa guidelines ng CAO 14-2020 (Accreditation and Regulation of BOC Value-Added Service Providers).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Interim arrangement ito. Habang wala pang sariling system ang BOC, puwedeng gumamit muna ng pribadong provider.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Pansamantala ito ('pending the establishment') at dapat consistent sa CAO 14-2020. Ang provider ay tinatawag na EPS Service Provider sa mga susunod na provisions (Sec. 5.4 hanggang 5.7).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 5.3 ng CAO 01-2025 tungkol sa third-party solutions providers. Magbigay ng practical example, ipaliwanag ang ugnayan sa CAO 14-2020 at VASP, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Each EPS Service Provider will determine its respective fee structures for the use of the System based on several factors such as market conditions and systems sustainability requirements, among others, which shall be submitted in the financial proposal. The schedule of fees, as proposed, shall be one of the bases for accreditation.

ai.title: Fee Structure ng EPS Service Provider
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang bawat EPS Service Provider ang magtatakda ng sarili nitong fee structure para sa paggamit ng System, batay sa mga salik gaya ng market conditions at systems sustainability requirements, at isusumite ito sa financial proposal. Ang proposed schedule of fees ay isa sa mga basehan ng accreditation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang provider ang nagpo-propose ng presyo, pero sinusuri ito ng BOC kapag nag-a-accredit.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Nasa financial proposal ang fees at isa ito sa mga basehan ng accreditation. May cap pa rin ang singil: 10% ng Import Processing Fee (Sec. 5.6).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 5.4 (fee structure ng EPS Service Provider) ng CAO 01-2025. Magbigay ng practical example, ipaliwanag ang papel ng financial proposal sa accreditation, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The Bureau shall not collect any fees on behalf of the EPS Service Provider.

ai.title: BOC Hindi Maniningil para sa EPS
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Hindi maniningil ang BOC ng anumang fees para sa EPS Service Provider.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi collector ang BOC ng bayad ng provider. Ang provider ang maniningil ng sarili nitong fee.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Absolute ang wording ('shall not collect any fees'). Kaya hindi dapat isinisingit ang fees ng provider sa mga bayarin na kinokolekta ng BOC. Iba ito sa Sec. 5.7, kung saan ang BOC ang naniningil ng service fee mula sa provider.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 5.5 ng CAO 01-2025 tungkol sa hindi pangongolekta ng BOC ng fees para sa EPS Service Provider. Magbigay ng practical example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The EPS Service Provider may only charge a processing fee not exceeding ten percent (10%) of the Import Processing Fee imposed by the Bureau for cross-border e-Commerce goods.

ai.title: Cap sa Processing Fee ng EPS
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang EPS Service Provider ay puwede lang maningil ng processing fee na hindi lalampas sa 10% ng Import Processing Fee na ipinapataw ng BOC para sa cross-border e-Commerce goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May upper limit ang singil ng provider: 10% ng Import Processing Fee.

📦 Halimbawa: Kung ang Import Processing Fee ay P100 (halimbawang numero lang), hindi dapat lumampas sa P10 ang processing fee ng provider.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 10% ng Import Processing Fee ang cap, hindi 10% ng value ng goods. Huwag ipagpalit sa Sec. 5.7.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 5.6 ng CAO 01-2025 tungkol sa 10% cap ng processing fee ng EPS Service Provider. Magbigay ng numerical example, ihambing sa Sec. 5.7, banggitin ang CAO 02-2024 Sec. 4.12, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The Bureau shall collect, from the EPS Service Provider, a service fee for monitoring and supervision equivalent to ten percent (10%) of the fees collected in accordance with the published rate for the use of the System.

ai.title: Service Fee ng BOC para sa Monitoring
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang BOC ay maniningil mula sa EPS Service Provider ng service fee para sa monitoring at supervision na katumbas ng 10% ng fees na nakolekta ayon sa published rate para sa paggamit ng System.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mula sa kinita ng provider, 10% ang babayaran nito sa BOC bilang monitoring at supervision fee.

📦 Halimbawa: Kung P1,000,000 ang nakolektang fees ng provider (halimbawang numero lang), P100,000 ang babayaran nito sa BOC.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 10% ng fees collected ng provider ang service fee ng BOC. Magkaiba ito sa Sec. 5.6 (10% ng Import Processing Fee, cap ng singil ng provider sa users).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 5.7 ng CAO 01-2025 tungkol sa 10% monitoring at supervision fee na kokolektahin ng BOC mula sa EPS Service Provider. Magbigay ng numerical example, ihambing sa Sec. 5.6, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The Commissioner shall review the fee structure every year.

ai.title: Taunang Review ng Fee Structure
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ire-review ng Commissioner ang fee structure kada taon.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi permanente ang fees. May annual review para masigurong makatwiran pa rin ito.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Isang taon ang review ng fee structure. Iba ito sa review ng buong CAO na kada tatlong taon (Sec. 16).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 5.8 ng CAO 01-2025 tungkol sa taunang review ng fee structure ng Commissioner. Magbigay ng practical example, ihambing sa 3-year review ng CAO sa Sec. 16, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

sections.heading: Section 6. Accreditation of Customs e-Commerce Stakeholders

paragraphs.text: All stakeholders including e-Commerce operators, digital platform providers, e-retailers, VASPs, freight forwarders, and brokers shall be accredited with the Bureau for e-Commerce transactions.

ai.title: Accreditation ng Lahat ng Stakeholders
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Lahat ng stakeholders, kasama ang e-Commerce operators, digital platform providers, e-retailers, VASPs, freight forwarders, at brokers, ay dapat na accredited sa BOC para sa e-Commerce transactions.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Walang makakasali sa e-Commerce processing kung hindi accredited.

📦 Halimbawa: Kung hindi accredited ang isang forwarder, hindi niya magagamit ang dedicated e-Commerce system para sa mga parcel ng platform.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Anim na uri ang binanggit: operators, DPPs, e-retailers, VASPs, freight forwarders, brokers. Ang detalyadong guidelines ay ilalabas ng BOC (Sec. 6.5).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 6.1 ng CAO 01-2025 tungkol sa accreditation ng lahat ng e-Commerce stakeholders. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit kailangan ng accreditation, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Only accredited e-Commerce stakeholders shall be allowed to use the new dedicated e-Commerce Processing System that will be utilized for clearance and release procedures as well as for implementation of a risk management system. This is to delineate the procedures to be followed exclusively for e-Commerce transactions.

ai.title: Accredited Lang ang Puwedeng Gumamit
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Accredited e-Commerce stakeholders lang ang papayagang gumamit ng bagong dedicated e-Commerce Processing System na gagamitin para sa clearance at release procedures at sa risk management system. Layunin nitong ihiwalay ang mga procedure na para sa e-Commerce lang.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Exclusive ang system. Kailangan ng accreditation para makagamit, at dahil dito malinaw kung alin ang e-Commerce lane at alin ang regular na importation.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ginagamit ang system para sa clearance, release, at risk management. Kaugnay ng Sec. 5.1 at Sec. 10 (mga hindi dadaan sa e-Commerce processing).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 6.2 ng CAO 01-2025 tungkol sa exclusive na paggamit ng e-Commerce Processing System ng mga accredited stakeholders. Magbigay ng practical example, ipaliwanag kung bakit kailangan ang delineation, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: In accordance with Republic Act No. 11967 or the Internet Transactions Act of 2023, the accredited e-Commerce stakeholders shall comply with the following obligations, among others:

ai.title: Mga Obligasyon ng Accredited Stakeholders
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Introduction ito sa mga obligasyon ng accredited e-Commerce stakeholders na nakabase sa RA 11967 (Internet Transactions Act of 2023). Nakalista sa 6.3.1 hanggang 6.3.3 ang ilan sa mga ito.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi lang BOC rules ang sinusunod ng stakeholders. May obligasyon din sila sa ilalim ng ITA, at isinama ito sa CAO para ma-enforce sa accreditation.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 'Among others' ang wording, kaya hindi lang ito ang puwedeng obligasyon. Tatlo ang nakalista: identification, regulated goods, at data privacy.
