paragraphs.text: Certificate of Inspection and Loading (CIL) — shall refer to the document issued by the Bureau certifying the conduct of inspection over the cargo for export and its actual loading on the exporting carrier.

ai.title: Certificate of Inspection and Loading (CIL)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Dokumentong inisyu ng Bureau na nagpapatunay na na-inspect ang cargo para sa export at na-load ito sa exporting carrier.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Katibayang talagang umalis ang kargamento, at mahalaga ito sa proof of exportation para sa liquidation.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Iba ito sa Certificate of Identification (3.13), na nagtutugma sa warehousing entry.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.15 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Certificate of Inspection and Loading (CIL). Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Client-Exporter — shall refer to a natural or juridical person engaged in the manufacture or export of products utilizing goods, raw materials, accessories and packing materials sourced from a CBW and members subject to the condition that finished products shall be exported within the period prescribed by existing laws and regulations.

ai.title: Client-Exporter
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Natural o juridical person na gumagawa o nag-e-export ng products gamit ang goods, raw materials, accessories at packing materials na galing sa CBW at members, sa kondisyong ie-export ang finished products sa loob ng itinakdang panahon.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang kliyente ng CBW na kumukuha ng bonded materials para gawing export products.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang kondisyon ay export sa loob ng prescribed period. Kapag hindi, may kaukulang bayad at penalty.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.16 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Client-Exporter. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Client Profile Registration System (CPRS) — shall refer to the system of registration provided for Bureau stakeholders adopted under Customs Memorandum Order (CMO) No. 39-2008.

ai.title: CPRS
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sistema ng registration para sa mga stakeholder ng Bureau, na ginawa sa ilalim ng CMO No. 39-2008.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Dito nirerehistro ang profile ng mga kliyente ng BOC, kasama ang CBW operators.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ayon sa 4.12.8, kailangang naka-register sa CPRS ang CBW operators at members ng CCBW bilang warehouse operators.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.17 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Client Profile Registration System (CPRS). Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Compliance Rate System (CRS) — shall refer to a procedure to be adopted by the Bureau in assessing the degree of compliance of a warehouse operator with relevant CBW rules and regulations and in taking any action on the CBW's Authority to Operate or any extension thereof. The CRS shall be developed by the Bureau subject to review by the Department of Finance (DOF) and consultation with concerned stakeholders. CRS may be applied to accredited members of CCBWs and accredited subcontractors.

ai.title: Compliance Rate System (CRS)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Procedure ng Bureau para sukatin ang compliance ng warehouse operator sa CBW rules at para gabayan ang aksyon sa Authority to Operate o extension nito. Ginagawa ito ng Bureau, subject sa review ng DOF at consultation sa stakeholders. Puwede rin itong gamitin sa accredited members ng CCBWs at accredited subcontractors.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Parang 'grade' ng operator. Mababa ang compliance, mas mataas ang risk sa Authority niya.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ginawa ng Bureau pero kailangan ng DOF review. Tingnan din ang 4.11.5.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.18 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Compliance Rate System (CRS). Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Customs Bonded Warehouse (CBW) — shall refer to a warehouse authorized/licensed by the Bureau to import, receive, and store, without payment of duties and taxes and under bond, goods, raw materials, accessories and packing materials either for manufacture into finished products for export or storage for the account of accredited exporter/client.

ai.title: Customs Bonded Warehouse (CBW)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Warehouse na awtorisado/lisensyado ng Bureau na mag-import, tumanggap at mag-imbak, nang walang bayad na duties at taxes at under bond, ng goods, raw materials, accessories at packing materials, para i-manufacture bilang finished products na ie-export o i-store para sa account ng accredited exporter/client.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Bodegang bonded kung saan 'naka-pause' ang buwis habang naghihintay ng export.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Duty and tax free lang ito habang under bond at sa loob ng prescribed period (4.11.1).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.19 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Customs Bonded Warehouse (CBW). Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Customs Bonded Warehouse Committee (CBWC) — shall refer to the committee created to act on applications for the establishment and operation of CBW, renewal of Authority to Operate CBWs, application as member of a CCBW, application as subcontractor of a CBW and other related matters pertaining to the operation of a CBW.

ai.title: Customs Bonded Warehouse Committee (CBWC)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Committee na umaaksyon sa applications para sa establishment at operation ng CBW, renewal ng Authority to Operate, application bilang member ng CCBW, application bilang subcontractor ng CBW at iba pang related matters.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang 'review board' ng Bureau para sa lahat ng CBW applications.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ayon sa 5.1.7, ang Deputy Commissioner for AOCG ang head nito, at nagre-recommend ito sa Commissioner.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.20 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Customs Bonded Warehouse Committee (CBWC). Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Customs Bonded Warehouse Operator — shall refer to a natural or juridical person who has a duly approved Authority to Operate a CBW issued by the Bureau. For CCBWs, CBW operator shall refer to the mother warehouse.

ai.title: Customs Bonded Warehouse Operator
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Natural o juridical person na may approved Authority to Operate ng CBW mula sa Bureau. Sa CCBWs, ang CBW operator ay ang mother warehouse.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang may hawak ng lisensya. Sa CCBW, ang 'mother' ang operator at ang members ay accredited sa ilalim niya.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang operator ay jointly and severally liable sa members at subcontractors niya (Sec. 10).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.21 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Customs Bonded Warehouse Operator. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Customs Premises — shall include customs offices, facilities, warehouses, ports, airports, wharves, infrastructure and other premises over which the Bureau shall have exclusive control, direction, and management for customs purposes.

ai.title: Customs Premises
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kasama ang customs offices, facilities, warehouses, ports, airports, wharves, infrastructure at iba pang lugar na may exclusive control, direction at management ang Bureau para sa customs purposes.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Anumang lugar na under ng Bureau ang kontrol para sa customs ay 'customs premises'.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ayon sa 4.2, ang CBWs ay itinuturing na extension ng customs premises basta tungkol sa dutiable goods na nakaimbak doon.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.22 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Customs Premises. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Diversion — shall refer to a violation of customs law committed when an imported material entered through the warehousing scheme and destined for transit to a particular CBW, Free Zone locator/enterprise, or from the CBW to the port or airport for exportation, is brought to some place other than its intended destination.

ai.title: Diversion
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Violation ng customs law kapag ang bonded material na papunta sa isang CBW, Free Zone locator o port/airport para i-export ay dinala sa ibang lugar.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Dapat sa destination na nakasulat sa papeles ang bagsak ng goods. Kapag lumihis, diversion na.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Closure ng CBW ang parusa sa diversion (Sec. 15.1).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.23 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Diversion. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Entry — shall refer to the act, documentation, and process of bringing imported goods into the customs territory, including goods coming from the Free Zones.

ai.title: Entry
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang act, documentation at proseso ng pagpasok ng imported goods sa customs territory, kasama ang galing sa Free Zones.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi lang pisikal na pagdating ng goods; kasama ang papeles at proseso.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.24 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Entry. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Examination and Storage Area — shall refer to an area of a CCBW and ICBW with sufficient space for examination and storage of goods.

ai.title: Examination and Storage Area
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Lugar sa loob ng CCBW at ICBW na may sapat na espasyo para sa examination at storage ng goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Dito iniinspeksyon at pansamantalang itinatago ang goods bago ibigay sa members o client/end-user.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Required ito sa CCBW at ICBW (Sec. 4.5).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.25 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Examination and Storage Area. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Exportation — shall refer to the act, documentation, and process of bringing goods out of Philippine Territory.

ai.title: Exportation
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Act, documentation at proseso ng paglabas ng goods mula sa Philippine Territory.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kabaligtaran ng importation. Ito ang hinihintay ng CBW para ma-liquidate ang bonded raw materials.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.26 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Exportation. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Extension Warehouse — shall refer to a separate warehouse authorized by the Bureau to form part of an already existing CBW to optimize capacity and efficiency in its operations.

ai.title: Extension Warehouse
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Hiwalay na warehouse na pinahintulutan ng Bureau na maging bahagi ng existing CBW para mas maging episyente at lumaki ang kapasidad.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Parang 'annex' ng main CBW. May sariling application at supervision fee.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tingnan ang Sec. 5.6 (application) at Sec. 14 (fee).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.27 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Extension Warehouse. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Free Zone — shall refer to special economic zones registered with the Philippine Economic Zone Authority (PEZA) under Republic Act No. 7916, as amended, duly chartered or legislated special economic zones and freeports such as Clark Freeport Zone; Poro Point Freeport Zone; John Hay Special Economic Zone and Subic Bay Freeport Zone under Republic Act No. 7227, as amended by Republic Act No. 9400; the Aurora Special Economic Zone under Republic Act No. 9490, as amended; the Cagayan Special Economic Zone and Freeport under Republic Act No. 7922; the Zamboanga City Special Economic Zone under Republic Act No. 7903; the Freeport Area of Bataan under Republic Act No. 9728; and such other freeports as established or may be created by law.

ai.title: Free Zone
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Special economic zones na rehistrado sa PEZA (RA 7916), at mga chartered o legislated economic zones at freeports tulad ng Clark, Poro Point, John Hay, Subic Bay, Aurora, Cagayan, Zamboanga City, at Freeport Area of Bataan, pati ang iba pang freeports na itatatag ng batas.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mga ecozone at freeport na may sariling special regime. Puwedeng supplier o locator na kaugnay ng CBW.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kapag Free Zone locator ang subcontractor, coordinated ang supervision sa ahensyang sakop (Sec. 4.2).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.28 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Free Zone. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Formula of Manufacture (FOM) — shall refer to the formula of conversion issued by the Industrial Technology Development Institute (ITDI) to the CBW operator and members, determining the raw material usage and wastages of a particular finished product for export and subsequent liquidation.

ai.title: Formula of Manufacture (FOM)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Formula of conversion na inilalabas ng ITDI sa CBW operator at members, na tumutukoy sa raw material usage at wastages ng isang finished product para sa export at liquidation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Parang 'recipe' ng produkto. Ito ang batayan kung ilang raw materials ang ni-liquidate.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: ITDI ang nag-iisyu nito.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.29 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Formula of Manufacture (FOM). Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Garments and Textile Industry Development Office (GTIDO) — shall refer to the government agency attached to the Department of Trade and Industry mandated to assist the Bureau in granting authority to an operator or to be a member or subcontractor of a warehouse involved in the manufacture of garments or textile for export.

ai.title: GTIDO
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ahensyang nakadikit sa DTI na tumutulong sa Bureau sa pagbibigay ng authority sa operator, member o subcontractor ng warehouse na gumagawa ng garments o textile para sa export.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kasama ng BOC ang GTIDO sa garments industry approvals.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Joint authorization sa GTMBW at sa garments CCBW (Sec. 4.3.2).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.30 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa GTIDO. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Goods — shall refer to articles, wares, merchandise and any other items which are subject of importation or exportation.

ai.title: Goods
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Articles, wares, merchandise at iba pang items na subject ng importation o exportation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Halos lahat ng bagay na dumadaan sa customs ay 'goods'.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.31 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Goods. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Goods Declaration — shall refer to a statement made in the manner prescribed by the Bureau and other appropriate agencies, by which the persons concerned indicate the procedure to be observed in the application for the entry or admission of imported goods and the particulars of which the customs administration shall require.

ai.title: Goods Declaration
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Statement na ginawa sa paraang itinakda ng Bureau at iba pang ahensya, kung saan sinasabi ng kinauukulan ang procedure para sa entry o admission ng imported goods at ang mga particulars na hinihingi ng customs.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang 'declaration form' ng shipment: ano ito, gaano karami, at anong regime (consumption, warehousing, transit).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Para sa CBW, Warehousing Goods Declaration ang gamit (Sec. 8.1).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.32 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Goods Declaration. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Importation — shall refer to the act of bringing in of goods from a foreign territory into Philippine territory, whether for consumption, warehousing, or admission.

ai.title: Importation
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Act ng pagdadala ng goods mula sa foreign territory papasok ng Philippine territory, para sa consumption, warehousing o admission.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Importation pa rin kahit warehousing lang ang regime at hindi pa binabayaran ang buwis.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.33 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Importation. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Liquidation of Raw Materials — shall refer to the process of accounting the usage of bonded raw materials, including wastages, in the manufacture of finished products for export as against the importation by CBWs of raw materials using the FOM.

ai.title: Liquidation of Raw Materials
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Proseso ng pag-account sa gamit ng bonded raw materials, kasama ang wastages, sa paggawa ng export products, laban sa inimport na raw materials, gamit ang FOM.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Tugma dapat ang inimport at ang nagamit sa export plus wastage. Kapag tugma, liquidated na.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: May deadline at penalty ang late liquidation (Sec. 4.11.3 at 15.8).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.34 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Liquidation of Raw Materials. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Lodgement — shall refer to the registration of a goods declaration with the Bureau.

ai.title: Lodgement
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang pagrerehistro ng goods declaration sa Bureau.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kapag nai-lodge na ang declaration, opisyal na itong nasa sistema ng BOC.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Sa Alert Order (3.6), pagkatapos ng lodgement at bago ang release ito inilalabas.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.35 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Lodgement. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Member — shall refer to an entity accredited to operate under an existing CCBW established for the manufacture of products using imported duty and tax-free raw materials or components subject to the condition that finished products shall be exported within the period prescribed by existing laws and regulations.

ai.title: Member
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Entity na accredited mag-operate sa ilalim ng existing CCBW para gumawa ng products gamit ang duty and tax-free imported raw materials, basta ie-export ang finished products sa itinakdang panahon.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mga manufacturer na 'nakikisakay' sa common bonded warehouse.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 3 hanggang 30 members bawat CCBW (Sec. 6.2).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.36 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Member. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Members may either be accredited by the Bureau alone or jointly with the GTIDO in case of entities engaged in the manufacture of garments.

ai.title: Accreditation ng Member
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang members ay accredited ng Bureau lang, o kasama ang GTIDO kung garments ang ginagawa.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Non-garments: BOC lang. Garments: BOC at GTIDO.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang karagdagang talata ng Sec. 3.36 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa accreditation ng Member. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Multinational Regional Bonded Warehouse — shall refer to an Industry-Specific CBW authorized by the Board of Investments (BOI) in proper cases, to serve as the supply depot for the storage, deposit, safe-keeping of spare parts components, semi-finished products and raw materials including the packing, covering, putting-up, marking, labelling, cutting or altering to customer's satisfaction, mounting and/or packaging into kits or marketable lots thereof to fill up transactions and sales made by its officers of parent companies and to serving as a storage of goods purchase locally by the home office of the multinational for export abroad under the supervision of the Bureau.

ai.title: Multinational Regional Bonded Warehouse
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Industry-Specific CBW na pinahintulutan ng BOI sa proper cases, para maging supply depot ng spare parts, semi-finished products at raw materials ng multinational, at storage ng goods na binili locally ng home office para i-export, under supervision ng Bureau.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Regional depot ng multinational company na bonded.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ayon sa Sec. 4.3.2(d), ire-reclassify ito bilang ICBW.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.37 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Multinational Regional Bonded Warehouse. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Multi-Purpose Declaration — shall refer to a customs single administrative document accomplished by the importer, or his duly licensed broker, under oath and submitted to the Bureau for purposes of declaring and identifying among others the nature of the article/s being imported, its value, volume, weight, and any relevant description thereof, whether entered through consumption or through warehousing which will assist the Bureau in assessing the taxes and duties due on the imported article.

ai.title: Multi-Purpose Declaration
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Single administrative document na ginagawa ng importer o ng licensed broker, under oath, at isinusumite sa Bureau para ideklara ang nature, value, volume, weight at description ng imported article, consumption man o warehousing, para matulungan ang Bureau sa assessment ng taxes at duties.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Iisang dokumento para sa iba't ibang regime.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Sa Sec. 8.1, hangga't hindi pa implemented ang MPD, ang existing procedures ang susundin.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.38 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Multi-Purpose Declaration. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Perishable Goods — shall refer to goods liable to perish such as agricultural products, flavorings, chemicals with maximum shelf life of six (6) months or other similar items.

ai.title: Perishable Goods
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Goods na madaling masira tulad ng agricultural products, flavorings, at chemicals na may maximum shelf life na anim (6) na buwan, o iba pang katulad.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mas maikli ang storage period nila sa CBW.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 3 months ang storage ng perishable, extendible ng another 3 months (Sec. 8.11.2).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.39 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Perishable Goods. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Physical Security Feature — shall refer to a system to secure and monitor premises, storage and production areas of CBWs including the safety of personnel.

ai.title: Physical Security Feature
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: System para i-secure at i-monitor ang premises, storage at production areas ng CBWs, pati ang safety ng personnel.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: CCTV, locks, guards at iba pa. Kailangan ito sa application at hindi dapat ma-compromise sa structural changes (Sec. 5.5.1).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.40 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Physical Security Feature. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Raw Material Liquidation System (RMLS) — shall refer to an automated system to be adopted and utilized by the Bureau in determining the volume and value of the raw materials exported and subject for liquidation, including the duties and taxes due on the allowable residues/wastages/by-products and other portion of the imported article/s, entered through warehousing, no longer usable for the manufacture of the goods to be exported.

ai.title: RMLS
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Automated system ng Bureau para malaman ang volume at value ng raw materials na na-export at ili-liquidate, pati ang duties at taxes sa allowable residues, wastages at by-products na hindi na magagamit sa export goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: 'Calculator' ng Bureau sa liquidation. Katuwang nito ang WVDB (3.50).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.41 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Raw Material Liquidation System (RMLS). Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Security — shall refer to any form of guaranty, such as a surety bond, cash bond, standby letter of credit or irrevocable letter of credit, which ensures the satisfaction of an obligation to the Bureau.

ai.title: Security
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Anumang guaranty tulad ng surety bond, cash bond, standby o irrevocable letter of credit na nagsisiguro sa obligasyon sa Bureau.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Garantiyang babayaran ang duties at taxes kapag hindi natupad ang kondisyon ng bonded goods.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.42 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Security. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Semi-finished products — shall refer to imported raw materials or goods that have undergone processing which shall be used in the further manufacture of finished products for export. They are also termed as “intermediate products.”

ai.title: Semi-finished Products
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Imported raw materials o goods na dumaan na sa processing at gagamitin pa sa paggawa ng finished products para i-export. Tinatawag ding 'intermediate products'.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi pa tapos na produkto pero may proseso na.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.43 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Semi-finished products. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Sub-contractor — shall refer to a person or company accredited by the Bureau, and GTIDO in case of garments, to undertake or perform, for a definite period, certain manufacturing operations or activities incidental to the manufacture of bonded raw materials into finished products in behalf of a CBW and members in cases where the latter's facilities are insufficient to address its immediate requirements or due to lack of material time to meet export commitments.

ai.title: Sub-contractor
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Person o company na accredited ng Bureau (at GTIDO sa garments) para gawin, sa definite period, ang ilang manufacturing operations para sa CBW at members kapag kulang ang pasilidad nila o kapos sa oras para sa export commitments.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: 'Katulong' na pabrika kapag hindi kaya ng CBW ang volume. Dapat accredited at may definite period.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang operator ay solidarily liable sa subcontractor (Sec. 10).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.44 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Sub-contractor. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Supplies — shall refer to imported consumable and disposable indirect materials that are needed in the maintenance, operation and production of the MCBW. Such materials are not included in FOM of the finished products and are not duty/tax-free unless authorized by the BOI or exempted by the DOF.

ai.title: Supplies
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Imported consumable at disposable indirect materials para sa maintenance, operation at production ng MCBW. Wala ito sa FOM at hindi duty/tax-free maliban kung awtorisado ng BOI o exempted ng DOF.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi sila bahagi ng produkto, kaya karaniwang may duties maliban sa may BOI authority o DOF exemption.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Iba ito sa accessories (3.1). Tingnan ang Sec. 4.11.2.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.45 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Supplies. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Transfer Note — shall refer to a customs document that accompanies the transfer or transit underguard of bonded imported goods to a Free Zone locator/enterprise or to another CBW and serves as proof of delivery or receipt of the goods at its intended destination duly acknowledged on its face by the Collector of Customs or his duly authorized representative. It is also commonly referred to as a “boatnote”.

ai.title: Transfer Note (Boatnote)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Customs document na kasama ng bonded imported goods na inililipat o ita-transit under guard papunta sa Free Zone locator/enterprise o ibang CBW. Proof ito ng delivery o receipt sa destination, na pinirmahan ng Collector o awtorisadong kinatawan. Tinatawag ding 'boatnote'.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: 'Resibo' na dumating ang goods sa tamang destinasyon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ginagamit sa LCL transfers (Sec. 8.1).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.46 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Transfer Note. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Transit — shall refer to the customs procedure under which goods are transported under customs control from one customs office to another or to a Free Zone locator/enterprise.

ai.title: Transit
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Customs procedure kung saan dinadala ang goods under customs control mula sa isang customs office papunta sa iba, o sa Free Zone locator/enterprise.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: 'Biyahe sa ilalim ng bantay ng customs'. Hindi pa ito released para sa consumption.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.47 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Transit. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Unauthorized Repacking — shall refer to the act of fraudulent concealment, removal, or repacking merchandise in any CBW; or fraudulent alteration, defacement, or obliteration of any markings or numbers placed upon packages deposited in such warehouse, or aiding or abetting any such acts.

ai.title: Unauthorized Repacking
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Fraudulent concealment, removal o repacking ng merchandise sa CBW; o fraudulent na pagbabago, pagsira o pagbura ng markings/numbers sa packages; o pagtulong sa ganitong gawain.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pagtatago o pagpapalit ng packaging o markings para takpan ang tunay na laman o bilang ng goods.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.48 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Unauthorized Repacking. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Unauthorized Withdrawal — shall refer to the withdrawal of any material/goods stored in a CBW without the duly processed withdrawal or requisition slip, or the substitution of materials or finished products with local materials or goods. Unauthorized withdrawal shall also include the act of directly transferring the imported materials to an Accredited Member or Subcontractor without passing through the physical facility of the CBW, or the transfer of such materials to a non-accredited member or subcontractor.

ai.title: Unauthorized Withdrawal
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Pagkuha ng goods sa CBW nang walang duly processed na withdrawal o requisition slip; pagpapalit ng materials o finished products ng local; direktang paglilipat ng imported materials sa member o subcontractor nang hindi dumadaan sa physical facility ng CBW; o paglilipat sa non-accredited na member o subcontractor.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Lahat ng labas ng goods ay dapat may papeles, dumaan sa CBW, at sa accredited lang.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: May graduated penalties sa Sec. 15.2.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.49 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Unauthorized Withdrawal. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Wastage Valuation Data Base (WVDB) — shall refer to a bank of information and reference values which shall be utilized by the Bureau in assessing the taxes and duties due on the allowable residue/wastage/by-products or other portion of the imported article/s which can no longer be used for the manufacture of the goods to be exported.

ai.title: WVDB
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Bank ng impormasyon at reference values na gagamitin ng Bureau sa pag-assess ng taxes at duties sa allowable residue, wastage at by-products na hindi na magagamit sa export goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Presyo-batayan para sa tira-tira ng production. Katuwang ng RMLS (3.41).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 3.50 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Wastage Valuation Data Base (WVDB). Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Establishment of Customs Warehouses. When the business of the port and trade requires such facilities, the District Collector, subject to the approval of the Commissioner, shall designate and establish customs warehouses for the storage of imported goods or for other special purposes.

ai.title: Establishment of Customs Warehouses
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag kailangan ng negosyo ng port at kalakalan, ang District Collector, sa approval ng Commissioner, ang magtatalaga at magtatatag ng customs warehouses para sa imported goods o special purposes.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Sa ilalim ng Commissioner ang pagtatatag, hindi basta-basta.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: District Collector ang nagtatalaga, Commissioner ang nag-a-approve.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.1 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Establishment of Customs Warehouses. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: A CBW includes the surrounding premises within its perimeter fence per approved application, rooms, compartments, and other areas necessary and exclusively used for storing, processing, re-packing, and manufacturing imported raw materials and the finished product, by-products, wastages and rejects incident to such activities as applied for and approved by the Bureau. No other establishment shall be allowed thereat except upon proper approval of the Bureau and under such conditions as may be imposed by the Bureau.

ai.title: Sakop ng CBW
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kasama sa CBW ang premises sa loob ng perimeter fence ayon sa approved application, mga kuwarto, compartments at iba pang areas na kailangan at exclusive para sa storing, processing, re-packing at manufacturing ng imported raw materials at finished product, by-products, wastages at rejects. Bawal ang ibang establishment dito maliban sa approval ng Bureau.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang bonded area ay yung nasa approved application lang, at walang ibang negosyo sa loob nang walang pahintulot.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Exclusive use ang requirement.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang karagdagang talata ng Sec. 4.1 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa sakop ng CBW. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Licensing, Supervision and Control over CBWs. The Bureau is responsible for the licensing of all CBWs. For the protection of government revenue, all CBWs shall be considered as extension of the customs premises insofar as the dutiable goods stored and introduced thereat. CBWs, including their expansion, extensions and additional facilities and the goods stored thereat, shall be subject to the supervision and control of the District Collector. The supervision and control of the District Collector over warehouses shall extend to the warehouse and facilities of duly authorized members, Client/End-Users, Client-Exporters, and sub-contractors of CBWs.

ai.title: Licensing, Supervision and Control
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Bureau ang responsable sa licensing ng lahat ng CBWs. Para protektahan ang revenue, ang CBWs ay extension ng customs premises basta sa dutiable goods na nakaimbak. Sakop ng supervision at control ng District Collector ang CBW, expansion, extensions, additional facilities at goods, pati pasilidad ng members, client/end-users, client-exporters at sub-contractors.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kahit pribado ang bodega, bantay pa rin ng Collector.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Extension ng customs premises ito para sa dutiable goods.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.2 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Licensing, Supervision and Control over CBWs. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: In cases where the Client/End-User, Client-Exporter or sub-contractor is also a Free Zone locator/enterprise, the exercise of supervision and control shall be made in coordination with the government agency concerned.

ai.title: Coordination sa Free Zone Agency
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag ang Client/End-User, Client-Exporter o sub-contractor ay Free Zone locator/enterprise din, ang supervision at control ay gagawin kasama ang ahensyang kinauukulan.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi solo ang BOC dito. Kausap din ang ahensya ng ecozone o freeport (hal. PEZA).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang ikalawang talata ng Sec. 4.2 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa coordination sa Free Zone agency. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The Bureau however, shall not be liable for any loss or damage of the goods stored in any CBW.

ai.title: Walang Liability ang Bureau
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Hindi mananagot ang Bureau sa anumang loss o damage ng goods na nakaimbak sa anumang CBW.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kahit bantay ng Bureau, operator pa rin ang may pasan ng risk.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tugma ito sa Sec. 9.4: walang legal responsibility ang gobyerno sa safekeeping.

paragraphs.text: Types of Customs Bonded Warehouse.

ai.title: Types of CBW
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Heading ng listahan ng mga uri ng CBW: MCBW (kasama ang MMBW, GTMBW, CCBW, ICBW) at NCBW.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Alamin muna ang uri dahil nakadepende dito ang rules, fees at limits.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.3 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Types of Customs Bonded Warehouse. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Manufacturing Customs Bonded Warehouse (MCBW). It is a warehouse established for the manufacture of products utilizing raw materials or components that are imported duty and tax-free conditioned on the exportation of the finished products within the period prescribed herein or withdrawal for domestic consumption upon payment of duties and taxes, provided that raw materials entered for consumption shall not exceed thirty percent (30%) of the volume of raw materials entered for warehousing. Withdrawal for consumption beyond thirty percent (30%) may be allowed by the Bureau under meritorious circumstances such as but not limited to cancelled orders, closure of CBW, or cessation of operations due to a state of calamity.

ai.title: MCBW
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Warehouse para sa paggawa ng products gamit ang duty and tax-free imported raw materials o components, kondisyon na ie-export ang finished products sa itinakdang panahon, o i-withdraw para sa domestic consumption kapag binayaran ang duties at taxes. Hindi dapat lumampas ng 30% ng volume ng raw materials na entered for warehousing ang para sa consumption. Puwedeng lampasan ng Bureau sa meritorious circumstances gaya ng cancelled orders, closure ng CBW o calamity.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pabrika na bonded. Export ang main purpose, may 30% na allowance para sa local.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 30% cap sa consumption, may exceptions.

📦 Halimbawa: Nag-import ng 1,000 kg na materyales. Hanggang 300 kg lang ang puwedeng i-withdraw para sa local consumption.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.3.1 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Manufacturing Customs Bonded Warehouse (MCBW). Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: A MCBW shall include:

ai.title: Mga Kasama sa MCBW
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Panimula sa listahan ng mga uri na sakop ng MCBW: MMBW, GTMBW, CCBW at ICBW.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang MCBW ay umbrella term na may apat na sub-types.

paragraphs.label: a.
paragraphs.text: Miscellaneous Manufacturing Bonded Warehouse (MMBW). It is a warehouse established and duly authorized to import, receive, and store, duty and tax free and under bond, raw materials, except garments and textile, for manufacture into finished products, including accessories, packaging and packing materials for export within a specified period.

ai.title: MMBW
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Warehouse na awtorisadong mag-import, tumanggap at mag-imbak, duty and tax free at under bond, ng raw materials (maliban sa garments at textile) para gawing finished products, kasama ang accessories at packaging materials, para i-export sa specified period.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Bonded factory ng non-garments na produkto, gaya ng electronics o furniture.

paragraphs.label: b.
paragraphs.text: Garments and Textile Manufacturing Bonded Warehouse (GTMBW). It is a warehouse established and jointly authorized by the Bureau and the GTIDO to import, receive, and store duty and tax free and under bond, raw materials and accessories, for the manufacture of garments or textile, including packaging and packing materials for export within a specified period.

ai.title: GTMBW
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Warehouse na itinatag at sabay na inaprubahan ng Bureau at GTIDO para mag-import, tumanggap at mag-imbak ng raw materials at accessories para sa garments o textile, kasama ang packaging materials, para i-export sa specified period.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Katapat ng MMBW pero para sa garments at textile. Dalawang ahensya ang nag-a-authorize.

paragraphs.label: c.
paragraphs.text: Customs Common Bonded Warehouse (CCBW). It is a warehouse established and duly authorized by the Bureau alone or jointly with GTIDO, in case of garments industry, to import, receive, and store, duty free and under bond, raw materials and accessories, for the account of its accredited members for manufacture into finished products for export including packaging and packing materials.

ai.title: CCBW
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Warehouse na itinatag at inaprubahan ng Bureau (o kasama ang GTIDO sa garments) para mag-import at mag-imbak ng raw materials at accessories para sa account ng accredited members, para gawing export products.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Shared bonded warehouse ng maliliit na manufacturer. Ang 'mother warehouse' ang nag-i-import at members ang gumagawa.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 3 hanggang 30 members (Sec. 6.2).

paragraphs.label: d.
paragraphs.text: Industry-Specific Customs Bonded Warehouse (ICBW). It is a warehouse duly authorized by the Bureau to import under bond and under its name and account, goods or raw materials (except fibers, yarns, fabrics and accessories for the manufacture of garments) for storage and subsequent sale and transfer to its accredited Client/End User either for export of the bonded goods or for manufacturing into export products, in case of raw materials.

ai.title: ICBW
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Warehouse na awtorisado ng Bureau na mag-import under bond at sa sariling pangalan at account ng goods o raw materials (maliban sa fibers, yarns, fabrics at accessories para sa garments) para sa storage at subsequent sale o transfer sa accredited Client/End User, para i-export o gawing export products.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Bonded na 'supplier' bodega para sa isang industriya, tulad ng aviation.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Sariling name at account ang import ng ICBW. Hindi kasama ang garments materials.

paragraphs.text: CBWs previously granted Authority to Operate either as Multinational Regional Bonded Warehouse, Airlines Customs Bonded Warehouse or Airlines Catering Customs Bonded Warehouse shall be re-classified as ICBWs pursuant to this CAO.

ai.title: Re-classification bilang ICBW
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang dating Multinational Regional Bonded Warehouse, Airlines CBW at Airlines Catering CBW ay ire-reclassify bilang ICBWs.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pinag-isa na sa ICBW ang tatlong dating uri.

🎯 Board Exam Tip: Tatlong uri ang napunta sa ICBW.

paragraphs.text: The Bureau shall provide for the guidelines and parameters for the accreditation of end-user/clients of ICBWs, such as those engaged in international aviation, etc.

ai.content:

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May hiwalay pang guidelines para sa kung sino ang puwedeng maging client ng ICBW.

paragraphs.text: Nonmanufacturing Customs Bonded Warehouse (NCBW). It is a warehouse where goods are stored duty-and-tax-free conditioned on the eventual withdrawal of the goods for consumption and shall only be withdrawn within the period prescribed upon payment of the corresponding duties, taxes and other charges whether or not the goods are in the same state as imported.

ai.title: NCBW
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Warehouse kung saan nakaimbak ang goods nang duty-and-tax-free, kondisyon na ma-withdraw para sa consumption sa loob ng prescribed period matapos bayaran ang duties, taxes at charges, kahit pareho pa o hindi ang estado ng goods noong in-import.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Storage lang, hindi manufacturing. Pambenta sa local market, kaya bayad ang buwis sa paglabas.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Bawal ang extension warehouse sa NCBW (Sec. 5.6.5).

paragraphs.text: Example of an NCBW are Private Customs Bonded Warehouses (PCBWs) which are authorized by the Bureau to import, receive and store goods for their own accounts intended for domestic consumption.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng NCBW: PCBW
ai.content:

paragraphs.text: Reclassification of Public Bonded Warehouse in Airports. To ensure compliance with the requirements and conditions specified in CAO No. 9-2019, all existing public bonded customs warehouses are hereby reclassified as Customs Facilities and Warehouse (CFW) without prejudice to all the rights, conditions, and obligations already acquired or vested prior to the effectivity of this CAO.

ai.title: Reclassification ng Public Bonded Warehouse sa Airports
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Para masunod ang CAO 9-2019, lahat ng existing public bonded customs warehouses ay ire-reclassify bilang Customs Facilities and Warehouse (CFW), nang hindi naaapektuhan ang rights, conditions at obligations na na-acquire o vested na bago ang effectivity ng CAO na ito.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pinalitan ang tawag at status nila bilang CFW, pero hindi nawawala ang mga karapatang hawak na nila.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kaugnay ito ng CAO 9-2019.

paragraphs.text: Examination and Storage Area. A CCBW or an ICBW operator shall likewise have an examination and storage area which is secured and with sufficient space for the inspection and subsequent storage and safekeeping of imported goods prior to their delivery to Accredited Members or Client/End-User, as the case may be. It shall also have the necessary logistical support needed for the proper handling of such imported goods.

ai.title: Examination and Storage Area

paragraphs.text: Non-Transferability of Authority. The Authority to Operate a CBW is personal to the warehouse operator and shall not be transferred or assigned for whatever reason.

ai.title: Non-Transferability of Authority
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Personal sa warehouse operator ang Authority to Operate at hindi puwedeng ilipat o i-assign kahit anong dahilan.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi ito puwedeng ibenta o ipamana. Kapag bagong may-ari, bagong application.

paragraphs.text: Creation or Dissolution of Types of CBW. The Secretary of Finance may, upon the recommendation of the Commissioner, create or dissolve certain types of warehouses subject to consultation with the National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) and the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) based on prevailing economic circumstances.

paragraphs.text: Accreditation of Free Zone Locator/Enterprise as Sub-contractor. A Free Zone Locator/Enterprise may be accredited by the Bureau as a Sub-contractor of a MMBW, GTMBW or of an accredited member of a CCBW.

ai.title: Free Zone Locator bilang Sub-contractor
ai.content:

paragraphs.text: Operation without a CBW Authority. Any person, natural or juridical, found to be operating as a bonded warehouse without a valid customs authority, shall be barred from being granted any warehousing privileges.

paragraphs.text: Misrepresentation of Material Information. Any misrepresentation, false statement or non-disclosure of any material information required in any application shall be a ground for disapproval without prejudice to any administrative/criminal charge as may be deemed proper.

paragraphs.text: Terms and Conditions of Authority to Operate a CBW.

ai.content:

paragraphs.text: Exemption from Duty and Tax of Goods in CBWs. Goods duly entered for warehousing in CBWs shall be exempt from duty and tax within the prescribed period for storage and must be withdrawn from the warehouse either for manufacture into export products; for repacking; for distribution to foreign markets; for sale to MCBW; for transfer to subcontractors or members of CCBWs; or transfer to accredited clients/end user. Goods entered for warehousing shall include imported raw materials, accessories, spare parts, labels, hangers, cartons, packaging materials and the like used in the manufacture of goods. Withdrawals for domestic consumption shall be subject to payment of duties and taxes.

ai.content:

Kasama ang raw materials, accessories, spare parts, labels, hangers, cartons at packaging materials. Ang withdrawal para sa domestic consumption ay may duties at taxes.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Hindi permanenteng exemption ito; kondisyonal.

paragraphs.text: Exclusion from Exemptions. The privilege of exemption from payment of duties and taxes, however, shall not apply to implements, machineries, spare parts and apparatus, supplies and tools to be used to construct, repair or operate any MCBW unless these supplies and spare parts are indispensably needed in the production of finished products for exports subject to presentation of a Certificate of Qualification from BOI and/or the corresponding exemption from the DOF.

paragraphs.text: Period to Liquidate. The importer shall, within a non-extendible period of sixty (60) days from the date of complete and full exportation, submit the complete documents required for the liquidation of the entry. The same period shall likewise be given an importer for the submission of the complete documents required for the liquidation of the warehousing entry even in cases where complete exportation is made before the expiration of the period prescribed. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the maximum period within which to submit complete liquidation documents is thirty (30) days from the expiration of the storage period. Submission of documents after the thirty (30) day period shall be considered as late submission of documents and shall be subject to the penalties prescribed under this CAO.

ai.content:

Pagkatapos ng 30 days, late submission na at may penalty.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Dalawang orasan: 60 days mula export, pero hanggang 30 days lang pagkatapos ng storage period.

paragraphs.text: Validity of Authority to Operate or its Renewal. The Authority to Operate a CBW, including warehouse extensions and additional facilities issued pursuant to this CAO shall be valid for three (3) years counted from the date of the approval of the application for establishment, as stated in the Certificate of Authority to Operate. If the term of the lease contract submitted during the application is less than three (3) years, the validity of the Authority to Operate shall be co-terminus with the lease contract unless a new Contract of Lease with a longer period is submitted. In such case, the Authority to Operate shall be amended to its maximum period of three (3) years counted from its date of original issuance.

ai.title: Validity of Authority to Operate
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Authority to Operate, kasama ang extensions at additional facilities, ay valid ng 3 taon mula sa approval ng application. Kung mas maikli sa 3 taon ang lease contract, co-terminus ito sa lease maliban kung may bagong lease na mas mahaba; sa ganoong kaso, aamyendahan ito hanggang maximum na 3 taon mula original issuance.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Karaniwang 3 taon, pero puwedeng mas maikli kung maikli ang lease.

paragraphs.text: The CBW Operator and an accredited member may introduce structural changes or additional facilities in the CBWs provided that the ingress and egress or the physical security feature of the CBW shall not be altered or compromised;

paragraphs.text: Application for Extension Warehouse.

Extension warehouses of accredited members of CCBW shall be limited to only one.

ai.content:

paragraphs.text: The storage period of goods transferred to extension warehouses for production shall be limited to one (1) month and extendible for another one (1) month subject to approval by the Bureau.

ai.content:

paragraphs.text: In case the proposed extension warehouse is located in a place outside the territorial jurisdiction of the District Collector where the main warehouse is situated, such shall be treated as a new application and shall be filed with the District Collector who has territorial jurisdiction over the area where the new warehouse is located.

paragraphs.text: Application for Relocation. As a general rule, any application for relocation of a CBW shall be approved by the Commissioner as recommended by the District Collector. In cases where the CBW is relocated to another structure or warehouse within the same compound or building, the application shall be approved by the District Collector concerned subject to compliance with Section 5.6.3 of this CAO.

ai.title: Application for Relocation
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: General rule: ang Commissioner ang nag-a-approve ng relocation sa rekomendasyon ng District Collector. Kung lilipat lang sa ibang istruktura o warehouse sa parehong compound o building, ang District Collector na ang aaprub, basta susundin ang Sec. 5.6.3.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Malayong lipat: Commissioner. Lipat sa loob ng compound: Collector.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: May exception sa general rule.

paragraphs.text: Any unauthorized relocation shall be a ground for the suspension or revocation of the Authority to Operate issued to the CBW, its members or sub-contractors, as the case may be.

paragraphs.text: Physical Inspection by the Bureau. In all cases of application for structural changes or additional facilities, extension warehouse or relocation of CBW, physical inspection of the premises must first be conducted prior to approval.

sections.heading: Section 6. Membership in a Customs Common Bonded Warehouse (CCBW)

paragraphs.text: Membership in a CCBW shall be governed by the following rules and regulations:

ai.title: Membership sa CCBW
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Panimula sa mga patakaran sa membership sa CCBW.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Dalawang rules: limitasyon sa duties at taxes, at bilang ng members.

paragraphs.text: A company can apply as member of a CCBW if its projected duties and taxes for bonded goods importations does not exceed Three Hundred Million Pesos (PhP300,000,000.00) for one (1) year.

ai.title: Eligibility ng Member
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Puwedeng mag-apply bilang member ng CCBW ang kumpanya kung ang projected duties at taxes ng bonded goods importations ay hindi lalampas ng PhP300,000,000.00 sa isang (1) taon.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May ceiling ang laki ng kumpanya. Kung mas malaki ang projected duties at taxes, hindi puwedeng member ng CCBW.

🎯 Board Exam Tip: PhP300M ceiling.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 6.1 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa eligibility bilang member ng CCBW. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: CCBW must have a membership of at least three (3) but not more than thirty (30) members.

ai.title: Bilang ng Members
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CCBW ay dapat may hindi bababa sa tatlo (3) at hindi hihigit sa tatlumpu (30) members.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Minimum 3, maximum 30.

paragraphs.text: An applicant whose application to establish or renew a CBW was denied by the Commissioner may file a Motion for Reconsideration on the denial with the Commissioner within fifteen (15) days from receipt of the Notice of Denial, copy furnished the CBWC and the District Collector, stating clearly the grounds why the application should be approved.

ai.title: Motion for Reconsideration
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang applicant na ang application para magtayo o mag-renew ng CBW ay denied ng Commissioner ay puwedeng mag-file ng Motion for Reconsideration sa Commissioner sa loob ng 15 days mula receipt ng Notice of Denial, copy furnished ang CBWC at District Collector, na malinaw ang grounds.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: 15 days para umapela sa Commissioner.

🎯 Board Exam Tip: 15 days para mag-file.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 7.1 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Motion for Reconsideration. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The Commissioner, within twenty (20) days from receipt of the Motion for Reconsideration, shall issue a resolution granting the Motion or affirming his denial of the application.

ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Commissioner, sa loob ng 20 days mula receipt ng Motion for Reconsideration, ay maglalabas ng resolution na nagpapahintulot sa Motion o nagpapatibay ng denial.

paragraphs.text: The applicant whose application was denied by the Commissioner may file a new application once the ground/s for the denial ceased to exist.

ai.title: Bagong Application
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang applicant na denied ng Commissioner ay puwedeng mag-file ng bagong application kapag nawala na ang ground/s ng denial.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi final ang denial. Ayusin ang problema at mag-apply ulit.

paragraphs.text: Goods Declaration for Warehousing. A goods declaration for warehousing shall be filed at the port where the goods for warehouse are discharged. In cases where the goods to be entered for warehousing are under the jurisdiction of another port of entry, a Goods Declaration for Transit must be filed for the transfer of the goods from the port of discharge to the port of entry. The operator shall file the goods declaration for warehousing within five (5) days from date of transfer. The Bureau shall implement an automated tracking system for containerized goods to be transferred to CBWs. Unless likewise covered by an automated tracking system, the transfer of LCL goods from the Customs zone to the warehouse shall be escorted by customs guards until delivery at the warehouse is acknowledged in the covering Transfer Note (boatnote) by the customs personnel assigned thereat or by the duly designated accountable officer of the operator.

ai.title: Goods Declaration for Warehousing
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang goods declaration for warehousing ay ifa-file sa port kung saan na-discharge ang goods. Kung nasa ibang port of entry ang jurisdiction, Goods Declaration for Transit ang ifa-file para sa paglipat mula port of discharge papuntang port of entry. Ang operator ay magfa-file ng warehousing declaration sa loob ng 5 days mula date of transfer. Magpapatupad ang Bureau ng automated tracking system para sa containerized goods. Kung walang tracking, ang LCL goods ay ie-escort ng customs guards hanggang ma-acknowledge ang delivery sa Transfer Note.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Warehousing declaration sa port of discharge; transit declaration kung ibang port. 5 days ang operator pagkatapos ng transfer. Escort sa LCL kung walang tracking.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tingnan ang 3.46 (Transfer Note).

paragraphs.text: Pending implementation of the use of Multi-Purpose Declaration, existing procedures on the filing of goods declaration shall govern the clearance procedures for goods entered under warehousing.

ai.title: Transition sa Multi-Purpose Declaration
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Hangga't hindi pa naipapatupad ang Multi-Purpose Declaration, ang existing procedures sa pag-file ng goods declaration ang masusunod sa clearance ng goods na entered under warehousing.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Gamitin ang kasalukuyang proseso hangga't wala pang MPD (tingnan ang 3.38).

paragraphs.text: Transfers of Goods to CBWs. Goods for transfer to CBWs shall be subject to mandatory non-intrusive inspection at the port of discharge whether covered by a warehousing goods declaration or transit goods declaration. Unless the goods entered for warehousing is placed under Alert Order or selected for physical or non-intrusive examination, the District Collector shall allow immediate transfer of bonded goods to the CBW where the examination shall be conducted.

ai.title: Transfers of Goods to CBWs
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang goods na ililipat sa CBWs ay may mandatory non-intrusive inspection sa port of discharge, warehousing man o transit goods declaration. Maliban kung nasa Alert Order o napiling i-physical o non-intrusive examine, papayagan ng District Collector ang agarang transfer sa CBW kung saan gagawin ang examination.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Scan muna sa port. Kapag walang red flag, diretso sa CBW.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Alert Order ang sagabal (3.6).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 8.2 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Transfers of Goods to CBWs. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: All goods for transfer to CCBWs must first pass through the CCBW operator for recording and stock inventory purposes unless the District Collector allows the direct transfer to the warehouse of the accredited members of CCBWs.

ai.title: Transfer sa CCBW
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Lahat ng goods para sa CCBWs ay dadaan muna sa CCBW operator para sa recording at stock inventory, maliban kung payagan ng District Collector ang direct transfer sa warehouse ng accredited members.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Sa mother warehouse muna, maliban kung may pahintulot ng Collector.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang hindi pagdaan sa CBW nang walang pahintulot ay unauthorized withdrawal (3.49).

paragraphs.text: The Bureau shall establish a mechanism to ensure the integrity of the bonded goods during the transfer of shipment from the port of entry to the CBW.

ai.title: Integrity ng Bonded Goods
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Bureau ay magtatatag ng mekanismo para matiyak ang integrity ng bonded goods habang inililipat mula port of entry papuntang CBW.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Para walang mapalitan o mawala sa biyahe.

paragraphs.text: Provisional Goods Declaration. The Bureau may allow the lodgement of a provisional goods declaration for goods entered under warehousing in accordance with the rules and regulations on the filing of a provisional goods declaration.

ai.title: Provisional Goods Declaration
ai.content:
