paragraphs.text: Posting of Security for Goods Stored in CBWs. For goods declared and entered under the CBW scheme, the District Collector shall require the importer to post a general warehousing bond as security where the assessed duties and taxes shall be charged as a condition for the storage and withdrawal of the bonded goods within the period prescribed by Section 811, Chapter 2, Title VIII of the CMTA.

ai.title: Posting of Security
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Para sa goods na declared at entered sa CBW scheme, hihingin ng District Collector sa importer na mag-post ng general warehousing bond bilang security, kung saan sisingilin ang assessed duties at taxes bilang kondisyon sa storage at withdrawal sa loob ng period ng Sec. 811 ng CMTA.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Bond ang garantiya habang nakaimbak ang goods.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tingnan ang 4.12.9.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 8.4 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Posting of Security for Goods Stored in CBWs. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: A CBW operator shall likewise post a separate GTSB at the port of discharge for goods for transfer via transit goods declaration.

ai.title: Separate GTSB
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CBW operator ay dapat mag-post din ng hiwalay na GTSB sa port of discharge para sa goods na ililipat via transit goods declaration.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hiwalay na bond para sa transit portion.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang talata sa Sec. 8.4 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa separate GTSB. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Bonded to Bonded Transfer. For MCBW operator which sources its raw materials from enterprises in Free Zones or from existing customs manufacturing bonded warehouse, the Bureau shall prescribe the specific form of goods declaration and supporting documents covering the transfer.

ai.title: Bonded to Bonded Transfer
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Para sa MCBW operator na kumukuha ng raw materials sa mga enterprise sa Free Zones o sa existing customs manufacturing bonded warehouse, ang Bureau ang magtatakda ng specific form ng goods declaration at supporting documents.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Bonded-to-bonded ang galaw. May espesyal na form na ilalabas ang Bureau.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 8.5 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Bonded to Bonded Transfer. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Withdrawal of Bonded Goods. The CBW operator shall, within the prescribed storage period, apply for withdrawal of the bonded goods either for production, for transfer to its end-user/client or client-exporter, as the case may be.

ai.title: Withdrawal of Bonded Goods
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CBW operator ay mag-a-apply ng withdrawal ng bonded goods sa loob ng prescribed storage period, para sa production o transfer sa end-user/client o client-exporter.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mag-withdraw habang nasa storage period pa.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang hindi na-withdraw ay deemed abandoned (8.11.2).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 8.6 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Withdrawal of Bonded Goods. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Identification of Bonded Goods Prior to Stuffing for Export. The CBW operator shall notify the District Collector in advance before any actual stuffing into a container shall be made.

ai.title: Identification Prior to Stuffing
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Dapat mag-notify nang maaga ang CBW operator sa District Collector bago ang actual stuffing sa container.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Sabihin muna bago i-stuff.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 8.7 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Identification of Bonded Goods Prior to Stuffing for Export. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: All goods for export by the CBW shall be stuffed only upon prior examination by a Customs Officer (Examiner) from the Warehousing Assessment Division (WAD) or equivalent unit who shall issue the Certificate of Identification (CI).

ai.title: Examination bago Stuffing
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Lahat ng goods para sa export ay ii-stuff lang pagkatapos ng prior examination ng Customs Officer (Examiner) mula WAD o equivalent unit, na mag-iisyu ng Certificate of Identification (CI).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Examiner muna, CI ang resulta, saka stuffing.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tingnan ang 3.13.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang talata sa Sec. 8.7 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa examination at Certificate of Identification bago stuffing. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Exportation of CBW Products. The CBW operator shall lodge an export declaration for finished products which are manufactured in CBWs within the prescribed period.

ai.title: Exportation of CBW Products
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CBW operator ay magla-lodge ng export declaration para sa finished products na gawa sa CBWs sa loob ng prescribed period.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Export declaration sa loob ng prescribed period. Kapag late, may penalty (Sec. 15.7).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 8.8 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Exportation of CBW Products. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: For CBW operators which supplies its raw materials or packaging materials to its client-exporters, client/end-users, Free Zones locators/enterprises, or to another MCBW, the Bureau shall prescribe the specific form of goods declaration and supporting documents to be submitted.

ai.title: Supply sa Client-Exporters at iba pa
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Para sa CBW operators na nagsu-supply ng raw o packaging materials sa client-exporters, client/end-users, Free Zones locators/enterprises o ibang MCBW, ang Bureau ang magtatakda ng specific form ng goods declaration at supporting documents.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May espesyal na form kapag supplier ang CBW.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang talata sa Sec. 8.8 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa supply ng CBW sa clients at locators. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Wastages. Wastages, rejects and by-products in the manufacture of export products shall be properly accounted for and disposed of in accordance with existing rules and regulations.

ai.title: Wastages
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang wastages, rejects at by-products sa paggawa ng export products ay dapat maayos na i-account at i-dispose ayon sa existing rules.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pati tira-tira ay may accounting. Gagamitin ng Bureau ang WVDB sa pag-assess (3.50).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 8.9 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Wastages. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Liquidation of Goods Declaration for Warehousing and Cancellation of Bond. The CBW operator shall cause the liquidation of the goods declaration for warehousing and the cancellation of the bonds related to the finished products.

ai.title: Liquidation at Cancellation of Bond
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CBW operator ang magsasagawa ng liquidation ng goods declaration for warehousing at cancellation ng bonds na kaugnay ng finished products.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pagkatapos ng export, liquidate at cancel ang bond.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 8.10 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Liquidation of Goods Declaration for Warehousing at Cancellation of Bond. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: A Raw Materials Liquidation System (RMLS) shall be adopted and utilized to effectively monitor the liquidation of raw materials used in the manufacture of imported goods and the wastages derived therefrom. Further, a Wastage Valuation Database (WVDB) shall be established for wastages, rejects and by-products.

ai.title: RMLS at WVDB
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Gagamit ng RMLS para i-monitor ang liquidation ng raw materials at wastages, at magtatatag ng WVDB para sa wastages, rejects at by-products.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: RMLS ang sistema ng liquidation, WVDB ang database ng halaga ng tira-tira (3.41 at 3.50).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang talata sa Sec. 8.10 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa RMLS at WVDB. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Cancellation of Bonds. The CBW operator shall cause the liquidation of the Warehousing Goods Declaration and the cancellation of the bonds filed for the bonded goods. An ABMS shall be utilized to assist in the effective cancellation of bonds for the liquidation of raw materials/goods declaration.

ai.title: Cancellation of Bonds
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CBW operator ang magsasagawa ng liquidation ng Warehousing Goods Declaration at cancellation ng bonds. Gagamitin ang ABMS para sa epektibong cancellation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kumpleto ang liquidation, saka lang makakansela ang bond (3.10).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang talata sa Sec. 8.10 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Cancellation of Bonds. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Period of Storage in CBWs.

ai.title: Period of Storage
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Heading ng rules sa storage period ng goods sa CBW.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Karaniwan 1 taon, 3 buwan sa perishable.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 8.11 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Period of Storage in CBWs. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Goods entered for warehousing may remain in a CBW for a maximum period of one (1) year from the time of its arrival at the warehouse, without prejudice to the provisions of Section 8.12.4 of this CAO.

ai.title: Maximum Storage Period
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang goods na entered for warehousing ay puwedeng manatili sa CBW ng maximum na isang (1) taon mula pagdating sa warehouse, nang hindi naaapektuhan ang Sec. 8.12.4 (as printed).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: 1 taon ang karaniwang limit.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: May reference sa 8.12.4 sa orihinal; ang katabing 8.11.4 ay tungkol sa mas mahabang period para sa partikular na goods.

🎯 Board Exam Tip: 1 taon.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 8.11.1 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Maximum Storage Period. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: For perishable goods, the storage period shall be three (3) months from the date of arrival at the warehouse, extendible for valid reasons, and upon written request, for another three (3) months.

ai.title: Storage Period ng Perishable Goods
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Para sa perishable goods, 3 buwan ang storage period mula pagdating sa warehouse, extendible ng isa pang 3 buwan para sa valid reasons at sa written request.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: 3 buwan plus 3 buwan (kung may valid reason at written request).

🎯 Board Exam Tip: 3 + 3 months.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 8.11.2 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Storage Period ng Perishable Goods. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Imported goods shall be withdrawn from the CBWs when the necessary withdrawal permit has been filed, together with any related document as may be required by the Bureau. Goods not withdrawn after the expiration of the prescribed period shall be deemed abandoned, as provided under paragraph (e), Section 1129, Chapter 6, Title XI of the CMTA, unless the CBW operator expressly abandons the goods prior to the expiration of the period to withdraw the same within the prescribed storage period.

ai.title: Withdrawal at Abandonment
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang imported goods ay i-withdraw sa CBW kapag na-file na ang withdrawal permit at iba pang dokumentong hinihingi. Ang goods na hindi na-withdraw pagkatapos ng prescribed period ay deemed abandoned (CMTA Sec. 1129(e)), maliban kung expressly i-abandon ng operator bago mag-expire ang period.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Lampas ng deadline na walang withdrawal, abandoned na.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tingnan ang CMTA Sec. 1129(e).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang talata sa Sec. 8.11.2 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa withdrawal at abandonment ng goods. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Prior to the lapse of the prescribed storage period, the Bureau shall notify the CBW operator to either withdraw the bonded goods for production and reexport, or in the alternative, pay the assessed duties and taxes due thereon.

ai.title: Notice ng Bureau bago ang Lapse
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Bago matapos ang storage period, aabisuhan ng Bureau ang CBW operator na i-withdraw ang bonded goods para sa production at reexport, o magbayad ng assessed duties at taxes.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May paalala mula sa Bureau: dalawa lang ang pagpipilian.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang talata sa Sec. 8.11.2 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa notice ng Bureau bago mag-lapse ang storage period. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Bonded raw materials withdrawn within the prescribed storage period shall be manufactured and exported within one (1) year from the time of arrival at the CBW. Bonded goods not withdrawn either for manufacture or export shall be deemed abandoned.

ai.title: Manufacture at Export sa Loob ng 1 Taon
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang bonded raw materials na na-withdraw sa loob ng prescribed storage period ay dapat i-manufacture at i-export sa loob ng 1 taon mula pagdating sa CBW. Ang bonded goods na hindi na-withdraw para sa manufacture o export ay deemed abandoned.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Isang taon mula arrival para magawa at ma-export.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Abandoned ang hindi ginamit.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 8.11.3 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa manufacture at export sa loob ng isang taon. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: For goods withdrawn for manufacture within the prescribed period of one (1) year but not exported, the CBW operator may request for the exportation of the said finished goods subject to imposition of applicable penalties for late re-exportation and late liquidation or pay the duties and taxes due on the bonded goods provided the request for late exportation or payment of duties and taxes is made before the lapse of the storage period.

ai.title: Late Exportation o Payment
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung na-withdraw para sa manufacture sa loob ng 1 taon pero hindi na-export, puwedeng humiling ang operator ng export ng finished goods (may penalties para sa late re-exportation at late liquidation) o magbayad ng duties at taxes, basta ang request ay bago mag-lapse ang storage period.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May habol pa kung magre-request bago mag-lapse: late export na may penalty, o bayad.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Penalties sa 15.7 at 15.8.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang talata sa Sec. 8.11.3 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa late exportation o payment ng duties at taxes. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The Commissioner shall, in consultation with the Secretary of Trade and Industry, establish a reasonable storage period limit beyond one (1) year for particular bonded goods for manufacturing and intended for export, the processing into finished products of which requires a longer period based on industry standard and practice, subject to the approval of the Secretary of Finance.

ai.title: Mas Mahabang Storage Period
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Commissioner, sa konsultasyon sa Secretary of Trade and Industry, ay magtatakda ng makatwirang storage period na lampas isang taon para sa partikular na bonded goods na gagawin at ie-export na nangangailangan ng mas mahabang processing ayon sa industry standard, subject sa approval ng Secretary of Finance.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Exception sa 1 taon para sa industriyang mas matagal ang production.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tatlong opisyal ang kasali: Commissioner, DTI Secretary (konsulta) at DOF Secretary (approval).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 8.11.4 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa mas mahabang storage period. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The following are the duties and responsibilities of a CBW Operator:

ai.title: Duties ng CBW Operator
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Panimula sa listahan ng mga tungkulin ng CBW Operator, 9.1 hanggang 9.7.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang 'job description' ng operator.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 9 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Responsibilities of CBW Operator. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Comply with all Customs rules and regulations governing the operation of CBW and all other applicable issuances;

ai.title: Comply with Customs Rules
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sundin ang lahat ng customs rules at regulations sa CBW at iba pang applicable issuances.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pangkalahatang tungkulin ng pagsunod sa batas.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 9.1 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa compliance ng CBW Operator. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Present evidence of payment of duties, taxes and other charges to the customs warehouseman or customs storekeeper before making any withdrawal from the warehouse in case of PBWCs or local sales;

ai.title: Evidence of Payment
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Magpakita ng patunay ng bayad ng duties, taxes at charges sa customs warehouseman o storekeeper bago mag-withdraw sa warehouse sa kaso ng PBWCs o local sales.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Bayad muna bago ilabas kung para sa local market.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang 'PBWCs' ay ayon sa orihinal na teksto.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 9.2 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Evidence of Payment bago mag-withdraw. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Implement effective security measures, such as the installation of 24-hour Closed Circuit Television Camera (CCTV) system and similar devices to ensure a safe environment for persons working inside the CBW and to prevent pilferage, unauthorized withdrawal, and loss of goods through fires, floods, and other such occurrences;

ai.title: Security Measures
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Magpatupad ng epektibong security measures tulad ng 24-hour CCTV at katulad na devices para sa ligtas na kapaligiran at para maiwasan ang pilferage, unauthorized withdrawal at pagkawala ng goods dahil sa sunog, baha at iba pa.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: 24-hour CCTV at proteksyon laban sa nakawan at sakuna.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 9.3 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Security Measures. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Indemnify the Bureau of the duties and other charges on the goods entered into the warehouse which were lost or destroyed, damaged, pilfered or stolen while in storage due to the operators' gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The government assumes no legal responsibility over the safekeeping of goods stored in CBW;

ai.title: Indemnification
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Babayaran ng operator ang Bureau ng duties at charges sa goods na nawala, nasira, ninakaw habang nakaimbak dahil sa gross negligence o wilful misconduct ng operator. Walang legal responsibility ang gobyerno sa safekeeping ng goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kasalanan ng operator, babayaran niya ang buwis na nawala sa gobyerno.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Gross negligence o wilful misconduct ang trigger.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 9.4 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Indemnification ng Bureau. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Allow access to the premises and extend assistance to examiners, inspectors, inventory and audit teams, and other authorized customs personnel who may be sent on mission orders to conduct examination and/or physical and records inventory/audit of cargoes stored in the CBW;

ai.title: Access at Assistance
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Payagan ang access sa premises at tulungan ang mga examiner, inspector, inventory at audit teams, at iba pang awtorisadong customs personnel na may mission orders para sa examination at/o physical at records inventory/audit ng cargo.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Huwag harangin ang may mission order.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tingnan ang Sec. 12 (Mission Order).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 9.5 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Access at Assistance sa customs personnel. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Pay to the Collector of Customs at the port concerned such fees as may be fixed by appropriate regulations for the supervision and operation of the CBW;

ai.title: Payment of Fees
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Magbayad sa Collector of Customs ng mga fees na itinakda ng regulasyon para sa supervision at operation ng CBW.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Supervision fee ay binabayaran sa Collector (tingnan ang Sec. 14).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 9.6 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Payment of Fees. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Provide the necessary office space, equipment and supplies to customs personnel assigned to the CBW; and

ai.title: Office Space para sa Customs
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Magbigay ng kinakailangang office space, equipment at supplies sa customs personnel na naka-assign sa CBW.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pareho ng 4.12.2. Ang 'and' sa dulo ay connector.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 9.7 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa pagbibigay ng office space sa customs personnel. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The CBW operator shall be jointly and severally liable with its Accredited Member and/or Subcontractor for any violation committed.

ai.title: Joint and Several Liability
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CBW operator ay jointly and severally liable kasama ang Accredited Member at/o Subcontractor sa anumang violation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Puwedeng habulin ang operator sa buo kahit member o subcontractor ang gumawa ng mali.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kaya kailangang piliing mabuti ang members at subcontractors.

🎯 Board Exam Tip: 'Jointly and severally liable'.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 10 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Liabilities of CBW Operators. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

sections.heading: Section 11. Suspension of the Authority to Operate and Closure of CBW

paragraphs.text: The Bureau shall, without prejudice to the imposition of administrative penalties and filing of criminal cases against the responsible person, initiate suspension or closure proceeding against any CBW in the following instances:

ai.title: Grounds for Suspension o Closure
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Bureau ay magsisimula ng suspension o closure proceeding laban sa anumang CBW sa mga instance sa a. hanggang k., nang hindi naaapektuhan ang administrative penalties at criminal cases.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Labing-isang grounds para sa suspension o closure.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Hiwalay ito sa penalties sa Sec. 15.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.1 ng CAO 01-2022 tungkol sa Grounds for Suspension o Closure ng CBW. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: a.
paragraphs.text: In case of discontinuance requested by the CBW operator or when the conditions warrant pursuant to Section 807, Chapter 2, Title VIII of the CMTA;

ai.title: Discontinuance
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Discontinuance na hiniling ng operator o kapag ang kondisyon ay nagpapahintulot ayon sa CMTA Sec. 807.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Boluntaryong paghinto o paghinto ayon sa batas.

paragraphs.label: b.
paragraphs.text: Filing an application containing false information for establishment or renewal of CBW Authority to Operate;

ai.title: False Information sa Application
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Pag-file ng application para sa establishment o renewal na may maling impormasyon.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Konektado sa 4.10.

paragraphs.label: c.
paragraphs.text: Failure to file application for renewal;

ai.title: Failure to File Renewal
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Hindi pag-file ng renewal application.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Tingnan ang 5.4 at 5.4.2.

paragraphs.label: d.
paragraphs.text: Being inactive for a continuous period of at least one (1) year, i.e. no importation, or if there is one, no corresponding legal withdrawal of imported goods or exportation of finished products;

ai.title: Inactivity
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Pagiging inactive ng hindi bababa sa isang (1) taon na tuloy-tuloy: walang importation, o kung mayroon, walang katugmang legal withdrawal o export ng finished products.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Isang taong walang aktibidad ay puwedeng ma-suspend o ma-close.

paragraphs.label: e.
paragraphs.text: When the operator or any responsible official shall knowingly allow the use of the warehouse for illegal activities;

ai.title: Illegal Activities
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kapag sinadya ng operator o responsableng opisyal na payagan ang paggamit ng warehouse sa illegal na gawain.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kailangan ang 'knowingly'.

paragraphs.label: f.
paragraphs.text: Unauthorized relocation or use of extension warehouse;

ai.title: Unauthorized Relocation o Extension
ai.content:

ai.title: CAO 07-2022: Accreditation of Importers
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang CAO 07-2022 ay ang Customs Administrative Order na nagtatakda ng consolidated guidelines sa accreditation ng Importers sa Bureau of Customs, alinsunod sa Section 204 kaugnay ng Section 1226 ng CMTA. Dito nakalagay kung sino ang kailangang ma-accredit, paano mag-apply at mag-renew, ano ang mga responsibilidad ng accredited importer, at ano ang mga parusa at remedyo.

🔍 Breakdown
• Intro, Sections 1-2: Sakop at objectives
• Section 3: Definitions (CPRS, Declarants, Geotagged Photos, Importer, Indentor, JV, Material Information, Non-regular Importer, Principal at Responsible Officers, Third Party Importer)
• Section 4: General provisions: validity, fee, CPRS, special importers
• Section 5: Application ng bagong applicants
• Section 6: Renewal at automatic renewal
• Section 7: Action sa application (inspection, evaluation, approval o denial, deferment)
• Sections 8-12: Responsibilities ng accredited importer
• Section 13-14: Penalties at mitigating/aggravating circumstances
• Sections 15-17: Blacklisting, treatment ng suspended accreditation at continuous processing
• Sections 18-23: Due process, remedies, monitoring, repeal, separability at effectivity

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hindi ka puwedeng mag-lodge ng goods declaration sa automated system ng BOC kung hindi ka accredited. Ang accreditation ay may bisa ng 1 taon at kailangang i-renew. Para ma-accredit, kailangan ng kumpletong papeles (registration, IDs, proof of office, geotagged photos, atbp.) at dadaan ka sa evaluation ng AMO. Pagkatapos ma-approve, may responsibilidad ka: tapat na impormasyon, ligtas na password, report ng changes, physical office, records, at tamang goods declaration. Kapag lumabag ka, may suspension, revocation o blacklisting.

📦 Halimbawa
Ang XYZ Trading Corp. ay mag-aaplay ng accreditation. Magbubukas sila ng ticket sa Customer Care Portal, mag-a-upload ng documents (kasama ang geotagged photos ng office at proof of lawful occupancy), at magbabayad ng Php2,000 processing fee. Kapag kumpleto, may 7 working days ang AMO para mag-evaluate. Pagka-approve, valid ito ng 1 taon. Kapag lumipat sila ng office, kailangan nilang i-report sa loob ng 10 calendar days. Kapag nag-file sila ng renewal na mas mababa sa 7 working days bago mag-expire, may late renewal fine na Php1,000; kung pagkatapos mag-expire, Php2,000. Kapag naglodge sila ng false documents, grave infraction ito at revocation ang penalty.

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito?
Ang accreditation ang pintuan papasok sa customs system. Mahalaga ito sa importers, brokers at lahat ng nagpoproseso ng importation dahil nakabatay dito kung kailan puwedeng mag-lodge, ano ang mga responsibilidad, at ano ang mga mangyayari kapag may paglabag. Sa exam, maraming deadlines, fees at penalties ang lumalabas.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
• Validity: 1 taon; Processing Fee: Php2,000 (new o renewal)
• Evaluation: 7 working days mula complete documents; discrepancies: 7 calendar days para mag-submit
• Renewal filing: hindi mas maaga sa 30 calendar days; late kapag mas mababa sa 7 working days (Php1,000) o pagkatapos mag-expire (Php2,000)
• Automatic renewal: at least 7 working days bago mag-expire, may clearances (Collection/RCMG, Intelligence Group, Legal Service/RCMG)
• Report ng changes: 10 calendar days; amended certificate: 7 working days
• Seminar: 8 oras sa loob ng 3 buwan pagkatapos ma-approve (extendable ng 3 buwan)
• Records: 3 taon; demand letter: 15 araw para magbayad
• WSD: preliminary suspension 30 araw (+15 araw extension)
• Penalties: Light (hanggang 3 violations), Less Grave (2), Grave (revocation agad)
• Continuous processing: Legal Service 3 araw, reactivation 24 oras, 100% physical exam
• Remedies: MR 10 araw (Commissioner disapproval); appeal 15 calendar days (official disapproval, Php1,000 fee); MR at appeal 15 calendar days (suspension, revocation, blacklisting)
• Effectivity: 15 calendar days pagkatapos ng publication

🎯 Board Exam Tip
Memorize ang mga numero: 1 taon, Php2,000, 7 working days, 30 calendar days, Php1,000/Php2,000 late fines, 10 calendar days, 8 oras/3 buwan, 15 araw, 30+15 araw WSD suspension, 24 oras. Alamin din ang pagkakaiba ng Principal Officers at Responsible Officers, at ang tatlong kategorya ng infractions (Light, Less Grave, Grave).

❓ Madalas Malito ang Students
Tanong: Kapag huli ang renewal, babalik ba ang validity sa dating expiration?
Sagot: Hindi. Para sa late applications, ang validity ay bibilangin mula sa date ng approval (Sec. 6.4.3). Pero kung na-approve ang renewal bago mag-expire at hindi naaksyunan sa prescribed period, ituturing na automatic na extended ang accreditation at ang renewed accreditation ay retroactive sa araw pagkatapos mag-expire ng nakaraan (Sec. 6.4.2).

🔗 Related Topics
CMTA Secs. 102, 108, 118, 119, 204, 1003, 1226 at 1301; CMO 11-2014, CMO 04-2014, CMO 44-2009, CMO 23-2009, CMO 37-2021; CAO 09-2020, CAO 01-2020, CMC 32-2017; RA 11032, RA 11055 at RA 10173.

Bureau — shall refer to the Bureau of Customs.²

paragraphs.text: Client Profile Registration System (CPRS) — shall refer to the system where client information obtained during the accreditation or registration of various clients and stakeholders are captured and recorded. Enrollment in the Bureau's CPRS shall be mandatory for transactions through the Bureau's automated cargo clearance system.

Ang CPRS ay ang sistema kung saan nakukuha at nire-record ang client information sa accreditation o registration ng iba't ibang clients at stakeholders. Mandatory ang enrollment sa CPRS para sa transactions sa automated cargo clearance system ng Bureau.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ito ang 'profile database' mo sa BOC. Kung wala ka dito, hindi ka makaka-transact sa automated system.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan

paragraphs.text:
Geotagged Photos — shall refer to images that undergo the process of adding geographical information to various media in the form of metadata. Metadata are information within the recording file containing any digital identifiers that are captured as part of the actual recording, such as the recording data, time, GPS coordinates (latitude and longitude), and may even include bearing, altitude distance and place names.³

³ cf. Department of Environment and Natural Resources' National Greening Program (DENR-NGP) Geotagging Manual, Series of 2013 & Section 4, Rule 1 of Supreme Court A.M. No. 21-06-08-SC as cited in CMO No. 37-2021.

ai.title: Geotagged Photos
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Geotagged Photos ay mga larawang may dagdag na geographical information sa anyo ng metadata. Ang metadata ay impormasyon sa loob ng recording file, tulad ng petsa, oras at GPS coordinates (latitude at longitude), at puwede ring may bearing, altitude, distance at place names.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Larawan na may 'lokasyon at oras' na nakakabit. Ginagamit ito para patunayan na totoo ang office o warehouse na idineklara.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Required sa application: location address, latitude, longitude at date and time (Sec. 5.3.p).

paragraphs.text:
Importer — shall refer to the person who imports goods into Philippine territory or the consignee, the holder of the bill of lading or air waybill, or other equivalent transport document if duly endorsed by the consignee therein, or, if consigned to order, duly endorsed by the consignor.⁴

⁴ cf. CMTA, Title IV, Chapter 1, Section 404.

ai.title: Importer
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Importer ay ang taong nag-i-import ng goods sa Philippine territory, o ang consignee, ang holder ng bill of lading o air waybill o katumbas na transport document kung duly endorsed ng consignee, o kung consigned to order, duly endorsed ng consignor.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hindi lang ang nakapangalan sa papeles. Kasama ang consignee at ang holder ng transport document na endorsed nang tama.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Reference: Sec. 404 (Title IV, Chapter 1) ng CMTA ayon sa footnote. Endorsement ang susi sa holder ng BL o AWB.

paragraphs.text:
Indentor — shall refer to a person who, for compensation, acts as a middleman in bringing about a purchase and sale of goods between a foreign supplier and a local purchaser. An Indentor is on the same class as commercial broker or commission merchant.⁵

⁵ Schmid v. RJL Martinez Fishing Corp., GR No. 75198, October 18, 1988.

ai.title: Indentor
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Indentor ay taong, kapalit ng compensation, ay nagiging middleman sa pagbili at pagbenta ng goods sa pagitan ng foreign supplier at local purchaser. Kapareho siya ng commercial broker o commission merchant.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Siya ang 'tagapamagitan' sa foreign supplier at local buyer, may komisyon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Kapareho ng commercial broker o commission merchant. Isa sa mga halimbawa ng Third Party Importer (3.12).

paragraphs.text:
Joint Venture (JV) — shall refer to an association of persons or companies jointly undertaking some commercial enterprise, and which generally, all contribute assets and share risks. A JV requires a community of interest in the performance of the subject matter, a right to direct and govern the policy in connection therewith, and a duty, which may be altered by agreement to share both in profit and losses.⁶ It is an organization formed for some temporary purpose.⁷

⁶ Kilosbayan v. Guingona, GR No. 113375, May 5, 1994.
⁷ Aurbach, et. al. v. Sanitary Wares Manufacturing Corporation, GR No. 75875, December 15, 1989.

ai.title: Joint Venture (JV)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Joint Venture ay samahan ng mga tao o kumpanya na magkasamang gumagawa ng commercial enterprise, kung saan karaniwang lahat ay nag-aambag ng assets at nagbabahagi ng risks. Kailangan ng community of interest, karapatang magdirekta ng policy, at tungkuling magbahagi sa kita at lugi. Organization ito na binuo para sa pansamantalang layunin.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Pansamantalang pagsasama ng mga kumpanya para sa isang proyekto, na may sharing sa kita at lugi.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Tatlong elemento: community of interest, right to direct policy, duty to share profit and loss. Ang 'JV' suffix ay required sa pangalan ng accredited importer (Sec. 5.4).

paragraphs.text:
Material Information — shall refer to substantive information compliant to the requirements of the Bureau concerning the identity and circumstances of the applicant Importer, in which the absence or misrepresentation thereof may be the basis for the disapproval of an accreditation application, the suspension or revocation of an existing accreditation, including the blacklisting of Importers, as the case may be.⁸

⁸ cf. Black's Law Dictionary.

ai.title: Material Information
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Material Information ay substantive information, compliant sa requirements ng Bureau, tungkol sa identity at circumstances ng applicant Importer. Kapag wala o mali ang impormasyong ito, puwede itong maging basehan ng disapproval ng application, suspension o revocation ng existing accreditation, at blacklisting ng Importers.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Mahahalagang detalye tungkol sa kung sino ka. Kapag nagsinungaling o nagtago ka, puwedeng maapektuhan ang accreditation mo.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Konsekwensya ng pagkukulang o maling Material Information: disapproval, suspension, revocation, blacklisting.

paragraphs.text:
Non-regular Importer — as distinguished from a regular Importer, shall refer to a person or entity who imports goods and consequently transacts with the Bureau on one occasion only covered by a single bill of lading or air waybill within 365 days to be reckoned from the approval of the application for registration as non-regular importer.⁹

⁹ cf. CMO No. 04-2014; CMO No. 44-2009, Section 2.1.

ai.title: Non-regular Importer
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Non-regular Importer ay tao o entity na nag-i-import ng goods at nakikipag-transact sa Bureau nang isang beses lang, sa iisang bill of lading o air waybill, sa loob ng 365 araw mula sa approval ng registration bilang non-regular importer.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Minsanan lang ang import, isang BL o AWB lang sa loob ng 365 araw.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan

Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Principal Officers — shall refer to the directors and/or officers of the corporation including the President, Vice-President, Treasurer and Corporate Secretary as appearing in the Articles of Incorporation (AOI) or the General Information Sheet (GIS) in case of corporation; Resident Agent or Country Manager in case of foreign corporation; Chairman and Vice-Chairman of the cooperative; Partners in a partnership; Owner of a one-person corporation; or the Sole Proprietor, in case of sole proprietorship. In case of newly established corporation, the incorporators are considered Principal Officers of the corporation. Where the incorporators are juridical persons, the President or chief executive officer of the juridical entity shall be deemed Principal Officers of the applicant company or entity.

ai.title: Principal Officers
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Principal Officers ay mga directors at/o officers ng corporation, kasama ang President, Vice-President, Treasurer at Corporate Secretary ayon sa Articles of Incorporation o GIS; Resident Agent o Country Manager sa foreign corporation; Chairman at Vice-Chairman ng cooperative; Partners sa partnership; Owner ng one-person corporation; o Sole Proprietor. Sa bagong corporation, ang incorporators ang Principal Officers. Kapag juridical persons ang incorporators, ang President o CEO ng entity ang ituturing na Principal Officers.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ito ang mga 'top people' ng kumpanya, depende sa uri ng business entity.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Iba-iba ang Principal Officers depende sa uri ng entity. Hindi pareho sa Responsible Officers (3.11).

paragraphs.text:
Responsible Officers — shall refer to the officers of the Importer who are duly designated and authorized to represent and sign the application for accreditation or registration on behalf of the Importer and to take full responsibility, together with the Principal Officers, in ensuring compliance by the company or organization/agency of its responsibilities as accredited Importer. Such officers shall also act and sign documents, for and on behalf of the Importer, relative to the importation, movement, and clearance of goods.¹⁰

¹⁰ cf. CMO No. 11-2014.

ai.title: Responsible Officers
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Responsible Officers ay mga officers ng Importer na duly designated at authorized na mag-represent at pumirma sa application para sa accreditation o registration, at magkaroon ng buong responsibilidad, kasama ang Principal Officers, sa pagsunod ng kumpanya sa responsibilidad nito bilang accredited Importer. Sila rin ang kikilos at pipirma ng documents para sa Importer kaugnay ng importation, movement at clearance ng goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Sila ang nagsasalita at pumipirma para sa importer, at may pananagutan kasama ng Principal Officers.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Hiwalay sa Principal Officers. Dapat naka-declare sa application at CPRS.

paragraphs.text:
Third Party Importer — shall refer to any person who deals directly with the Bureau, for and on behalf of another person, relating to the importation of goods such as an Indentor, commercial broker and commission merchant.¹¹

¹¹ cf. CMTA, Title I, Chapter 2, Section 102 (uu).

ai.title: Third Party Importer
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Third Party Importer ay sinumang direktang nakikipag-deal sa Bureau, para sa at sa ngalan ng ibang tao, kaugnay ng importation ng goods, tulad ng Indentor, commercial broker at commission merchant.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan

ai.title: Section 4: General Provisions

paragraphs.text: Additional Requirements in Case of Joint Venture. Declaration of Correct Information on the Application. An Importer shall be truthful in the declaration of information required in the application form and in other accreditation documents and papers, and shall ensure the correctness and veracity thereof.¹⁷

¹⁷ cf. CMO No. 11-2014.

ai.title: 8.1 Tamang Impormasyon sa Application
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Importer ay dapat maging totoo sa pagdedeklara ng impormasyon sa application form at iba pang accreditation documents at papers, at titiyakin ang katumpakan at katotohanan nito.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Dapat tapat at tama ang lahat ng isinulat mo sa application.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Truthful, correct at veracity. Ang pagsisinungaling ay may mabigat na parusa (Sec. 13).

paragraphs.text: Declaration of Responsible Officers and Designated Declarants. An Importer shall fully and truthfully declare its officers, declarants, if any, and authorized representatives and shall be equally responsible for the latter's dealings and transactions with the Bureau.

ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Dapat buo at totoong i-declare ng Importer ang kanyang officers, declarants (kung mayroon) at authorized representatives, at siya ay pantay na responsable sa kanilang dealings at transactions sa Bureau.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Responsable ka sa mga taong idineklara mo, parang ikaw na rin ang kumilos.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan

paragraphs.text: Protected and Secured Passwords. An Importer shall assume full responsibility in protecting and securing passwords or codes in whatever form given by the accredited service provider or its equivalent unit as a consequence of the approval of the accreditation application. It shall be personal and exclusive to the Importer.

ai.content:

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag

paragraphs.text: Third Party Importer. A Third Party Importer shall at all times maintain a record of the contract it entered into with the ultimate consignee/s or beneficial owner/s of the goods. The supporting documents of the goods declaration such as but not limited to, bill of lading, invoice, or packing list shall clearly indicate that the importation is for account of another party or ultimate consignee. Otherwise, the importation shall be deemed for the own account and benefit of the Importer.

ai.title: 8.5 Third Party Importer: Contract at Documents
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Third Party Importer ay dapat laging may record ng contract na pinasok niya sa ultimate consignee/s o beneficial owner/s ng goods. Ang supporting documents ng goods declaration, tulad ng bill of lading, invoice o packing list, ay dapat malinaw na nagsasaad na ang importation ay para sa account ng ibang partido o ultimate consignee. Kung hindi, ituturing na para sa sarili niyang account at benepisyo ang importation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kung ikaw ay importer-for-hire, kailangang malinaw sa papeles na para ito sa ibang tao. Kung hindi, ikaw ang ituturing na may-ari.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Dalawang requirements: record ng contract at malinaw na indication sa documents. Kapag wala, deemed own account.

ai.title: Pantay na Pananagutan ng Third Party Importer

sections.heading: Section 9. Responsibilities of the Accredited Importer in Relation to Goods Declaration.

paragraphs.text:
Accuracy of Goods Declaration. The Importer shall be responsible for the accuracy of the goods declaration and for the payment of all duties, taxes and other charges due on the imported goods.²² To ensure the accuracy of the particulars given in the goods declaration, the Importer is allowed to request for the examination of the goods prior to lodgement and draw samples therefrom²³ or after lodgement when there are issues and controversies surrounding the goods declaration and import process.²⁴

²² cf. CMTA, Title I, Chapter 2, Section 107.
²³ cf. RKC, General Annex, Chapter 3, Standards 3.8 and 3.9.
²⁴ cf. CAO 9-2020, Section 6.4.2.

ai.title: 9.1 Accuracy ng Goods Declaration
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan

Para matiyak ang accuracy, puwede siyang humiling na ma-examine ang goods bago ang lodgement at kumuha ng samples, o pagkatapos ng lodgement kapag may issues at controversies sa goods declaration at import process.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ikaw ang may pananagutan sa tamang declaration at sa buwis. Puwede kang humiling ng examination para makatiyak.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Examination: bago ang lodgement (may samples) o pagkatapos kung may issues. Reference: Sec. 107 ng CMTA, RKC Standards 3.8 at 3.9, CAO 9-2020 Sec. 6.4.2.

Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text:
Inadvertent errors shall be subject to imposition of penalties as provided under Section 108 of the CMTA and its implementing rules and regulations.²⁵

²⁵ cf. CAO 1-2020, Section 4.1.

sections.heading: Section 12. Responsibilities of the Accredited Importer to Cooperate in the Enforcement of the CMTA.

paragraphs.text: Cooperation in Customs Investigations. During any investigation conducted by the Bureau, an Importer shall fully cooperate when directed to submit pertinent papers and documents, as well as issue statements, affidavits and attestations.

ai.title: 12.1 Cooperation sa Customs Investigations
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Sa anumang investigation ng Bureau, dapat buong makipagtulungan ang Importer kapag inutusang magsumite ng pertinent papers at documents, at mag-issue ng statements, affidavits at attestations.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Makipagtulungan sa imbestigasyon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Failure to cooperate: Light Infraction (Sec. 13).

paragraphs.text:
False Information. An Importer shall not file or procure or assist in the filing of any claim, or of any document, affidavit, or other paper known by him to be false and fraudulent;³⁰ nor shall he/she knowingly give or solicit or procure the giving of any false or misleading information or testimony in any matter pending before the Bureau or official representative thereof.

³⁰ cf. CMTA, Title XIV, Chapter 1, 1403.

ai.title: 12.2 Bawal ang False Information
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Hindi dapat mag-file, magpa-file o tumulong sa pag-file ang Importer ng anumang claim o dokumento, affidavit o papel na alam niyang false at fraudulent; at hindi rin siya dapat sadyang magbigay, mag-solicit o magpa-give ng false o misleading na impormasyon o testimony sa anumang usaping nakabinbin sa Bureau o sa opisyal na kinatawan nito.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Bawal ang pagsisinungaling at pagtulong sa pagsisinungaling sa Bureau.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Reference: Sec. 1403 ng CMTA (ayon sa footnote). Penalty: Grave Infraction, Revocation.

paragraphs.text: Importation of Prohibited, Restricted or Regulated Goods. The Importer shall not import Prohibited Goods nor shall it import restricted or regulated goods without permit or clearance from the appropriate regulatory agency.

ai.title: 12.3 Prohibited, Restricted at Regulated Goods
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Hindi dapat mag-import ang Importer ng Prohibited Goods, at hindi rin siya dapat mag-import ng restricted o regulated goods nang walang permit o clearance mula sa kaukulang regulatory agency.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Bawal ang prohibited. Ang restricted at regulated ay kailangan ng permit.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Prohibited = bawal. Restricted/regulated = kailangan ng permit o clearance. May magkakaibang penalties depende kung belated lang o wala talaga (Sec. 13).

ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Tatlong kategorya: Light (hanggang 3 violations), Less Grave (2 violations o suspension hanggang bayad) at Grave (revocation agad).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Progressive ang penalties. Mas mabigat ang paglabag, mas kaunti ang pagkakataon bago revocation.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Grave = isang violation lang bago revocation. Ang table cross-references ay maaaring hindi tugma sa aktwal na section numbers.

paragraphs.text:
Light Infractions:
Nature of Violation | 1st Violation | 2nd Violation | 3rd Violation
a. Failure to cooperate in any customs investigation (Section 11.1) | Warning to suspension up to thirty (30) days | Suspension from one (1) month and 1 day to six (6) months | Revocation
b. Failure to keep and maintain a signage of its business name and/or identity (Section 8.7) | Warning to suspension up to thirty (30) days | Suspension from one (1) month and 1 day to six (6) months | Revocation
c. Failure to report changes in business information (Section 8.4) | Warning to suspension up to thirty (30) days | Suspension from one (1) month and one (1) day to six (6) months | Revocation
d. Failure to strictly abide by the rules and regulations on the full description of goods or lodging or filing of inaccurate goods declaration, misclassification, misdeclaration, undervaluation (Section 9.1) | Warning to suspension from one (1) month to six (6) months | Suspension from six (6) months and one (1) day to one (1) year | Revocation
e. Importation of regulated goods with belated submission of import permit/clearance issued by government agency concerned for its shipment (Section 11.3) | Warning to suspension from one (1) month to six (6) months | Suspension from six (6) months and one (1) day to one (1) year | Revocation

ai.title: Light Infractions
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Light Infractions ay may tatlong antas: 1st, 2nd at 3rd violation. Para sa (a) failure to cooperate sa investigation, (b) failure sa business name signage at (c) failure na mag-report ng changes: 1st = warning hanggang suspension up to 30 days; 2nd = suspension mula 1 buwan at 1 araw hanggang 6 na buwan; 3rd = revocation. Para sa (d) paglabag sa full description o inaccurate goods declaration, misclassification, misdeclaration, undervaluation, at (e) belated submission ng import permit sa regulated goods: 1st = warning hanggang suspension mula 1 hanggang 6 na buwan; 2nd = suspension mula 6 na buwan at 1 araw hanggang 1 taon; 3rd = revocation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Magaan na paglabag, pero sa pangatlong beses, revocation na. Mas mabigat ang parusa para sa (d) at (e).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Hanggang 3 violations bago revocation. (a-c): 30 days, 1 month+1 day hanggang 6 months. (d-e): 1-6 months, 6 months+1 day hanggang 1 year. Pansinin: ang cross-reference sa table (hal. 'Section 11.1', 'Section 11.3') ay mukhang hindi tugma sa aktwal na section numbers (12.1 at 12.3). Basahin ang original.

paragraphs.text:
Less Grave Infractions:
Nature of Violation | 1st Violation | 2nd Violation | 3rd Violation
a. Denying an authorized customs officer full and free access to such records, books of accounts, business and computer systems, and all customs commercial data including payment records (Section 11.2) | Suspension from six (6) months and one (1) day to 12 months | Revocation
b. Failure to inform the Bureau of the change in the location of offices, facilities, premises and warehouse/storage facility, if available (Section 8.4) | Suspension from six (6) months and one (1) day to 12 months | Revocation
c. Failure to keep all the records of importations, books of accounts, business and computer systems and all customs commercial data in the manner prescribed under the CMTA (Section 11) | Suspension from one (1) month and one (1) day to six (6) months | Revocation
d. Failure to keep and maintain a physical office including office operations thereat (Section 8.6) | Suspension from six (6) months and one (1) day to 12 months | Revocation
e. Failure to pay within fifteen (15) days upon receipt of the demand letter by the Commissioner, unless the Importer has filed an appropriate action questioning the validity of the assessment (Section 10) | Suspension of accreditation until the liability has been paid, provided that the amount shall be at least five thousand pesos (Php 5,000.00)
f. Importation of regulated goods without permit or clearance from the appropriate regulatory agency (Section 12.3) | Suspension from six (6) months and one (1) day to one (1) year | Revocation
g. Importation of restricted goods under Section 119 of the CMTA with belated submission of import permit/clearance issued by government agency concerned for its shipment (Section 12.3) | Suspension from six (6) months and one (1) day to one (1) year | Revocation

ai.title: Less Grave Infractions
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Less Grave Infractions ay: (a) pagtanggi sa customs officer ng full at free access sa records; (b) failure na ipaalam ang pagbabago ng location ng offices at facilities; (d) failure na mag-maintain ng physical office; (f) importation ng regulated goods nang walang permit; at (g) importation ng restricted goods sa ilalim ng Sec. 119 ng CMTA na may belated submission ng permit: 1st = suspension mula 6 na buwan at 1 araw hanggang 12 buwan (o 1 taon para sa f at g); 2nd = revocation. Ang (c) failure na mag-keep ng records: 1st = suspension mula 1 buwan at 1 araw hanggang 6 na buwan; 2nd = revocation. Ang (e) failure na magbayad sa loob ng 15 araw mula demand letter ng Commissioner, maliban kung may aksyon na kinukuwestyon ang assessment: suspension hanggang mabayaran ang liability, na hindi bababa sa Php5,000.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Mas mabigat na paglabag: pangalawang beses, revocation na. Para sa hindi pagbabayad ng demand letter, suspended hanggang mabayaran.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Dalawang antas lang (1st suspension, 2nd revocation). (e) Non-payment ng demand letter: suspension hanggang mabayaran, minimum Php5,000. Excepted kung may filed action na kumukuwestyon sa assessment.

paragraphs.text:
Grave Infractions:
Nature of Violation | 1st Violation
a. Failure to strictly abide by the rules and regulations on the full description of goods or lodging or filing of inaccurate goods declaration, misclassification, misdeclaration, undervaluation or intentional over-quantity of shipments where entire shipment is forfeited in favor of the government. Provided, that the forfeiture is due to willful misdeclaration or undervaluation of imported or exported articles that resulted or would have resulted in the loss of government revenues. (Section 9.1) | Revocation
b. Filing, procuring, or assisting in the filing of any claim, or of any document, affidavit, or other paper known by him to be false and fraudulent, or knowingly giving, soliciting, or procuring the giving of any false or misleading information or testimony in any matter pending before the Bureau or official representative thereof (Section 12.2) | Revocation
c. Fraudulent or willful use of the company as Third Party Importer (Section 8.5) | Revocation
d. Importation of prohibited goods under Section 118 of the CMTA (Section 12.3) | Revocation
e. Importation of restricted goods under Section 119 of the CMTA without permit or clearance from the appropriate regulatory agency (Section 12.3) | Revocation
f. Intentional or fraudulent misrepresentation of Material Information or submission of false information or document in relation to its application for accreditation (Section 8.1) | Revocation
g. Intentional or fraudulent misrepresentation or submission of false names of officers, declarants, or authorized representatives (Section 8.2) | Revocation
h. Lodgement of goods declaration by the Importer other than those approved by the Commissioner to be processed in accordance with Section 17 of this CAO | Revocation
i. Submission of false information or documents to support its goods declaration (Section 9.2) | Revocation
j. Willfully concealing or destroying any invoice, book, or document relating to any goods liable to duty after an inspection thereof has been demanded by the District Collector, or at any time concealing or destroying any such invoice, book, or document for the purpose of suppressing any evidence of fraud therein contained (Section 11.2) | Revocation

ai.title: Grave Infractions
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Grave Infractions ay may isang antas lang: revocation sa unang violation. Kasama rito: (a) willful misdeclaration o undervaluation na nagresulta sa forfeiture ng buong shipment at loss ng government revenues; (b) pag-file o pagtulong sa pag-file ng false at fraudulent na dokumento o pagbibigay ng false testimony; (c) fraudulent o willful use ng company bilang Third Party Importer; (d) importation ng prohibited goods (Sec. 118 ng CMTA); (e) importation ng restricted goods (Sec. 119 ng CMTA) nang walang permit; (f) intentional misrepresentation ng Material Information sa application; (g) false names ng officers, declarants o representatives; (h) lodgement ng goods declaration ng ibang Importer maliban sa approved ng Commissioner ayon sa Sec. 17; (i) false information o dokumento sa goods declaration; at (j) willful concealment o destruction ng invoice, book o dokumento.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Pinakamabigat na paglabag. Isang beses lang, revocation na agad.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Revocation sa first violation. Sampung grounds (a hanggang j). Kasama ang fraud, false documents, prohibited goods at unauthorized lodgement habang suspended.

title: Clearance of Goods Under the Informal Entry Process
subject: Patakaran sa clearance ng goods sa ilalim ng Informal Entry Process ng Bureau of Customs
date_issued: MAY 04 2021 (Commissioner); approved by the Secretary of Finance MAY 18 2021
effectivity: Thirty (30) days after its complete publication in the Official Gazette or a newspaper of general circulation

ai.title: CAO 02-2021: Clearance of Goods Under the Informal Entry Process
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang CAO 02-2021 ay ang Customs Administrative Order na nagtatakda ng policies at procedures sa clearance ng goods sa ilalim ng Informal Entry Process ng Bureau of Customs. Ipinapatupad nito ang Section 402 (Title IV) at Section 800 (Title VIII) ng CMTA. Para ito sa goods na may FOB o FCA value na mas mababa sa P50,000, at sa personal at household effects na hindi commercial quantity.

🔍 Breakdown
• Intro, Sections 1-2: Legal basis, sakop (may exceptions) at objectives
• Section 3: Definitions (Informal Entry Process, Provisional Goods Declaration, TEI, Prohibited, Restricted at Regulated Goods)
• Section 4: Mga shipments na dadaan sa informal entry, kasama ang Sec. 800 importations; motor vehicles = formal entry
• Section 5: Operational provisions: lodgement sa E2M, documents, 15-day period, PGD, examination, risk management, payment at release
• Section 6-8: Fees, adjustment ng threshold at ICT system
• Sections 9-13: Penal provision, repeal, separability, review at effectivity

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hindi lahat ng importation ay kailangang dumaan sa mabigat na formal entry. Kapag maliit ang halaga (below P50,000) o personal at household effects mo lang, informal entry ang daan: mas simple ang proseso. Pero may rules pa rin: ilo-lodge sa E2M sa loob ng 15 araw, may required documents, may examination (x-ray o physical), at babayaran ang duties at taxes bago ma-release. Kung kulang pa ang papeles o permit, puwedeng gumamit ng Provisional Goods Declaration para hindi ma-abandon ang goods.

📦 Halimbawa
May nag-order ng electronic items na P30,000 ang FOB value. Dahil mas mababa sa P50,000, informal entry ito. Pagdating ng shipment, may 15 calendar days siya para i-lodge ang goods declaration sa E2M. Wala pa ang permit ng regulatory agency pero nag-apply na siya bago dumating ang goods, kaya puwede siyang mag-file ng Provisional Goods Declaration at mag-submit ng notarized undertaking na ipapasa ang kulang sa loob ng 45 araw. Pero kung motorsiklo ang inimport, formal entry ito kahit gaano kababa ang halaga (Sec. 4.2).

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito?
Maraming maliliit na importation ang dumadaan dito, kasama ang personal na gamit at balikbayan boxes. Mahalaga ito sa importers, brokers at customs personnel dahil dito nakabase kung informal o formal ang entry, ano ang documents, at ano ang mangyayari kung may kulang. Sa exam, maraming numbers at deadlines ang lumalabas.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
• Informal entry: FOB o FCA value na mas mababa sa P50,000; at personal/household effects na hindi commercial quantity
• Hindi sakop: accompanied baggage, De Minimis importations at relief consignments
• Motor vehicles, motorcycles at motor scooters: formal entry
• Lodgement: 15 calendar days mula discharge ng huling package; extension ng 15 araw (request bago mag-expire; 3 working days ang aksyon, deemed approved; walang karagdagang extension)
• PGD: undertaking na magsumite ng kulang sa loob ng 45 araw; extension ng 45 araw
• Kapag hindi nakapagsumite: regulated goods = seizure; security o undertaking = forfeiture (may due notice)
• X-ray: mandatory sa containerized cargo at sa goods para sa airport at composite warehouses; physical exam kapag suspicious o walang x-ray machine
• Payment: cash sa AAB, in-house bank o Collection Division
• Review: kada 3 taon. Effectivity: 30 araw pagkatapos ng kumpletong publication

🎯 Board Exam Tip
Memorize ang P50,000 threshold at ang pagkakaiba ng informal at formal entry. Alamin din ang mga numero ng PGD (45 + 45 araw), lodgement (15 + 15 araw) at ang 3 working days na deemed approved. At huwag mong paghaluin ang Prohibited, Restricted at Regulated Goods, at ang dalawang uri ng exemption: Sec. 4.1.3 (automatic na informal entry) at Sec. 4.1.4 (informal lang kung below P50,000).

❓ Madalas Malito ang Students
Tanong: Kapag extension ang request, pareho ba ito sa Provisional Goods Declaration?
Sagot: Hindi. Ang extension ay dagdag na 15 araw para i-lodge ang buong goods declaration. Ang PGD ay pag-lodge na ngayon ng declaration na kulang pa sa dokumento o permit, na may notarized undertaking na magsusumite sa loob ng 45 araw. Puwede mong piliin ang PGD kahit may karapatan kang mag-request ng extension.

🔗 Related Topics
CMTA Secs. 402, 403, 407, 414, 420, 800, 1401 at Chapter 6, Title XI (Abandonment); CAO 01-2018 (Balikbayan Boxes), CAO 02-2016, CAO 06-2016 (Returning Residents at OFWs); RA 11032 Sec. 9(b)(1).

paragraphs.text: For purposes of this CAO, the following terms shall be defined as follows:

ai.title: Panimula sa Definitions
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Intro clause ng Definition of Terms. Para sa CAO na ito lang ang mga kahulugan.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Maraming terms dito ang paulit-ulit sa ibang customs orders, pero ang meaning sa CAO na ito ang gamitin sa exam.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Pinakamahalagang definition: Informal Entry Process (3.16), Provisional Goods Declaration (3.22) at TEI (3.25).

paragraphs.text: Air Waybill (AWB) — shall refer to a transport document for airfreight used by airlines and international freight forwarders which specify the holder or consignee of the bill who has the right to claim delivery of the goods when they arrive at the port of destination. It is a contract of carriage that includes carrier conditions, such as limits of liability and claims procedures. In addition, it contains transport instructions to airlines and carriers, a description of the goods, and applicable transportation charges.

ai.title: Air Waybill (AWB)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang AWB ay transport document para sa airfreight na ginagamit ng airlines at international freight forwarders. Nakasaad dito ang holder o consignee na may karapatang kumuha ng goods pagdating sa port of destination. Contract of carriage ito na may carrier conditions tulad ng limits of liability at claims procedures, at may transport instructions, description ng goods at applicable transportation charges.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ito ang 'resibo at kontrata' ng padala by air. Dito makikita kung sino ang puwedeng kumuha ng goods.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Air = AWB. Sea = Bill of Lading. Parehong requirement sa documentary requirements (5.2.1).

paragraphs.text: Bill of Lading (BL) — shall refer to a transport document issued by shipping lines, carriers and international freight forwarders or non-vessel operating common carrier for water-borne freight. The holder or consignee of the bill has the right to claim delivery of the goods at the port of destination. It is a contract of carriage that includes carrier conditions, such as limits of liability and claims procedures. In addition, it contains transport instructions to shipping lines and carriers, a description of the goods, and applicable transportation charges.

ai.title: Bill of Lading (BL)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang BL ay transport document na ini-issue ng shipping lines, carriers at international freight forwarders o non-vessel operating common carrier para sa water-borne freight. Ang holder o consignee ay may karapatang kumuha ng goods sa port of destination. Contract of carriage ito na may carrier conditions at may transport instructions, description ng goods at applicable transportation charges.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ito ang katumbas ng AWB para sa padala by sea.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Sea = BL. Kaugnay ng HBL (3.15).

Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Bureau — shall refer to the Bureau of Customs.

ai.title: Bureau
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Bureau ay ang Bureau of Customs.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Simple definition: BOC.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Maikling definition, madalas hindi itinatanong.

paragraphs.text: Clearance — shall refer to the completion of customs and other government formalities necessary to allow goods to enter for consumption, warehousing, transit or transshipment, or to be exported or placed under another customs procedure.

ai.title: Clearance
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Clearance ay ang pagkumpleto ng customs at iba pang government formalities na kailangan para makapasok ang goods for consumption, warehousing, transit o transshipment, o ma-export o mailagay sa ibang customs procedure.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hindi lang 'nabayaran na'. Kasama ang lahat ng formalities para makapasok o makalabas ang goods.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Apat na regimes na binanggit: consumption, warehousing, transit, transshipment.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Clearance sa CAO 02-2021 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.4.). Ipaliwanag ang konsepto ng customs clearance. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Commercial Quantity — shall refer to the quantity for a given kind or class of articles, which are in excess of what is compatible with and commensurate to the person's normal requirements for personal use.

ai.title: Commercial Quantity
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Commercial Quantity ay ang dami ng isang uri ng articles na lampas sa normal na pangangailangan ng tao para sa personal use.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kapag mas marami na kaysa sa kailangan mo para sa sarili, commercial quantity na ito.

📦 Halimbawa
Isang pares ng sapatos para sa sarili ay personal use. Dalawampung pares ng parehong klase ay malamang lampas na sa normal na personal use.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Test: lampas sa 'normal requirements for personal use'. Mahalaga sa informal entry para sa personal at household effects ('not in commercial quantity').
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Commercial Quantity sa CAO 02-2021 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.5.). Ipaliwanag kung paano natutukoy ang commercial quantity. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Conditionally Tax and/or Duty-Exempt Importation — shall refer to goods exempt from the payment of import duties and/or taxes upon compliance with certain formalities prescribed under pertinent customs issuances.

ai.title: Conditionally Tax and/or Duty-Exempt Importation
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Conditionally Tax and/or Duty-Exempt Importation ay goods na exempt sa import duties at/o taxes basta nasunod ang ilang formalities na itinakda sa pertinent customs issuances.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Exempt sa bayad, pero may kondisyon. Hindi automatic ang exemption.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Basehan: Sec. 800 ng CMTA. Ang procedure ay depende sa partikular na issuance.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Conditionally Tax and/or Duty-Exempt Importation sa CAO 02-2021 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.6.). Ipaliwanag ang conditionally tax and/or duty-exempt importation. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Formal Entry Process — shall refer to the cargo clearance process for imported shipments considered to be of commercial nature which are those in excess of FOB or FCA value limitation for informal entry and those for which the informal entry process may not be used, subject to the exceptions provided under the CMTA.

ai.title: Formal Entry Process
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Formal Entry Process ay cargo clearance process para sa imported shipments na commercial ang nature, na lampas sa FOB o FCA value limitation ng informal entry, at sa mga hindi puwedeng gamitan ng informal entry, subject sa exceptions ng CMTA.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ito ang 'regular na daan' ng commercial importation. Kapag lampas sa limit o hindi puwede sa informal, formal entry ito.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Kabaligtaran ng Informal Entry Process (3.16). Halimbawa: motor vehicles ay formal entry (Sec. 4.2).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Formal Entry Process sa CAO 02-2021 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.7.). Ipaliwanag ang pagkakaiba ng formal at informal entry process. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Free Carrier (FCA) — shall mean that the seller delivers the goods to the carrier or another person nominated by the buyer at the seller's premises or another named place. The parties are well advised to specify clearly as possible the point within the named place of delivery, as the risk passes to the buyer at that point.

ai.title: Free Carrier (FCA)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang FCA ay nangangahulugang inihahatid ng seller ang goods sa carrier o ibang taong itinalaga ng buyer sa premises ng seller o ibang named place. Dapat malinaw na tukuyin ang point sa loob ng named place, dahil doon lumilipat ang risk sa buyer.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Sa FCA, hanggang sa carrier lang ang seller. Pagkabigay ng goods, buyer na ang may risk.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang FOB o FCA value ang basehan ng Php50,000 threshold ng informal entry.

Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Free on Board (FOB) — shall mean that the seller delivers the goods on board the vessel nominated by the buyer at the named port of shipments or procures the goods already delivered. The risk of loss of or damage to the goods passes when the goods are on board the vessel, and the buyer bears all costs from that moment onwards.

ai.title: Free on Board (FOB)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang FOB ay nangangahulugang inihahatid ng seller ang goods sa vessel na itinalaga ng buyer sa named port of shipment, o kumukuha ng goods na naihatid na. Lumilipat ang risk of loss o damage kapag nasa board na ang goods, at ang buyer na ang magbabayad ng lahat ng gastos mula noon.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Sa FOB, hanggang pagsakay sa barko ang responsibilidad ng seller.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Kasama ang FCA sa basehan ng threshold na Php50,000.

Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Goods — shall refer to articles, wares, merchandise and any other items which are subject of importation or exportation.

ai.title: Goods
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Goods ay articles, wares, merchandise at iba pang items na subject ng importation o exportation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kahit anong bagay na iniimport o ine-export.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Malawak ang definition.

paragraphs.text: Goods Declaration — shall refer to a statement made in a manner prescribed by customs laws, rules and regulations for the entry or admission of imported goods.

ai.title: Goods Declaration
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Goods Declaration ay statement na ginawa ayon sa paraang itinakda ng customs laws, rules at regulations para sa entry o admission ng imported goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ito ang opisyal na deklarasyon mo sa customs tungkol sa goods na papasok.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Sa informal entry, ito ay nilo-lodge sa E2M system (Sec. 5.1).

paragraphs.text: Goods of Commercial Nature — shall refer to goods that are intended to be used solely for commercial purpose, including but not limited to, sale, lease, hire or barter.

ai.title: Goods of Commercial Nature
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Goods of Commercial Nature ay goods na nilalayong gamitin lamang para sa commercial purpose, kasama pero hindi limitado sa sale, lease, hire o barter.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Goods na pang-negosyo: ibebenta, ipapaupa, ipapa-hire o ipapalit.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Hindi limitado sa apat na halimbawa. Kapag sa informal entry, kailangang mas mababa sa Php50,000 ang FOB o FCA value (4.1.1).

paragraphs.text: Household Effects — shall refer to furniture, dishes, linens, libraries and similar household furnishing for personal or family use.

ai.title: Household Effects
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Household Effects ay furniture, dishes, linens, libraries at katulad na household furnishing para sa personal o family use.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Mga gamit sa bahay na para sa sarili o pamilya.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Para sa personal o family use lang. Kasama sa informal entry kung hindi commercial quantity (4.1.2).

paragraphs.text: House Airway Bill (HAWB) — shall refer to an airway bill covering a single, individual shipment or consignment issued by the freight forwarder or consolidator to the consignor or sender containing the names and addresses, respectively, of both the consignor or sender and the consignee or receiver and the detailed, specific description of the goods shipped through air.

ai.title: House Air Waybill (HAWB)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang HAWB ay air waybill para sa isang individual shipment o consignment na ini-issue ng freight forwarder o consolidator sa consignor o sender, na may pangalan at address ng consignor at consignee, at detalyadong description ng goods na ipinadala by air.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ito ang waybill ng bawat individual na padala by air.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Kasama sa documentary requirements (5.2.1): AWB o HAWB.

Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: House Bill of Lading (HBL) — shall refer to a bill of lading covering a single, individual shipment or consignment issued by the freight forwarder to the consignor or containing the names and addresses, respectively, of both the consignor or sender and the consignee or receiver and the detailed, specific description of the goods shipped through sea.

ai.title: House Bill of Lading (HBL)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang HBL ay bill of lading para sa isang individual shipment o consignment na ini-issue ng freight forwarder sa consignor, na may pangalan at address ng consignor at consignee, at detalyadong description ng goods na ipinadala by sea.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ito ang waybill ng bawat individual na padala by sea.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Kasama sa documentary requirements (5.2.1): BL o HBL.
