title: Post Clearance Audit and Prior Disclosure Program
subject: Implementing rules on the Post Clearance Audit (PCA) functions of the Bureau of Customs and the Prior Disclosure Program (PDP) under the CMTA
date_issued: NOV 29 2018 (signed by the Commissioner); JAN 09 2019 (approved by the Secretary of Finance)
effectivity: Thirty (30) calendar days after its publication at the Official Gazette or a newspaper of national circulation.
related: CMTA Title XI, Chapter 8, Sections 1132 to 1134

ai.title: CAO 01-2019: Post Clearance Audit at Prior Disclosure Program
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang CAO 01-2019 ay ang Customs Administrative Order na nagpapatupad ng post clearance audit (PCA) functions ng Bureau of Customs sa ilalim ng Sections 1000 to 1006, Title X ng CMTA, kasama ang Prior Disclosure Program (PDP): ang paraan para kusang i-disclose ng importer ang mali sa goods declaration niya.

🔍 Breakdown
• Introduction, Sections 1-2: Ano ang sakop at ano ang objectives
• Section 3: Definitions (Fraud, Negligence, Inadvertent Error, Misdeclaration, Misclassification, Undervaluation, Importer, etc.)
• Section 4: Recordkeeping: sino, bakit, saan, gaano katagal, at anong records
• Section 5: Post Clearance Audit: PCAG, ANL, audit proper, FAR/CRF, Demand Letter, access sa records, summons
• Section 6-7: Prior Disclosure Program at 20% interest
• Section 8-9: Remedies ng Importer (CTA) at ng Bureau (distraint, levy, kaso)
• Section 10: Administrative at criminal offenses at penalties
• Section 11-17: Database ng Bureau, monitoring, periodic review, turn-over, repealing, separability at effectivity

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kahit released na ang cargo at bayad na ang duties and taxes, hindi pa 'closed case' ang transaction. Sa loob ng 3 taon, puwedeng balikan ng Bureau ang records mo para i-check kung tama ang goods declaration. Kaya kailangan maayos ang recordkeeping mo. At kung may nakita kang mali, puwede kang kusang mag-disclose sa ilalim ng PDP para mas magaan ang magiging parusa, basta hindi Fraud.

📦 Halimbawa
Ang ABC Trading ay nag-import ng electronic parts. Napansin ng finance team nila na maling tariff heading ang nagamit sa ilang entries, kaya kulang ang nabayarang duties. Kung nag-file sila ng PDP application at nagbayad bago pa dumating ang ANL, deficiency plus legal interest lang ang babayaran nila (Sec. 6.3.1). Kung natanggap na nila ang ANL at nag-PDP sila sa loob ng 90 calendar days, may dagdag na 10% penalty ng basic deficiency (Sec. 6.3.2). Pero kung lumabas na sinadya pala ang maling declaration, Fraud na iyon, at hindi na qualified sa PDP (Sec. 6.2.3).

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito?
Ito ang rulebook ng audit sa likod ng border. Importante ito sa Importers, Customs Brokers, Locators at maging sa beneficial owners, kasi lahat sila puwedeng sakop ng recordkeeping at audit. Sa board exam, madalas itong lumabas dahil maraming numbers, deadlines at penalties na kailangang tama.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
• 3 taon: audit window at recordkeeping period
• ANL: valid ng 30 calendar days, puwedeng i-revalidate ng Assistant Commissioner ng another 30 days bago mag-expire
• Audit proper: magsisimula hindi lalampas ng 60 calendar days mula service ng ANL
• Audit completion: 120 calendar days per year of audit period mula receipt ng ANL
• Demand Letter: ise-serve ng PCAG sa loob ng 5 calendar days, bayad sa loob ng 15 calendar days mula receipt
• Reconsideration/reinvestigation: 15 days mula receipt ng Demand Letter; appeal sa CTA: 30 days
• PDP pagkatapos ng ANL: sa loob ng 90 calendar days; 6.3.2 = +10% ng basic deficiency
• Interest: 20% per annum mula date ng final assessment (Sec. 429 CMTA)
• Records: 20% surcharge sa dutiable value, 3 years and 1 day hanggang 6 years at/o PhP1,000,000
• Negligence 125%, Inadvertent Error 25%, Fraud 6x ng revenue loss at/o 2 hanggang 8 taon
• Distraint at levy: bawal kapag hindi hihigit sa PhP10,000 ang duties at taxes (walang interest at penalties)

🎯 Board Exam Tip
Memorize ang timeline at numbers: 3 taon, 30+30, 60, 120, 5/15 (Demand Letter), 15 (reconsideration/reinvestigation), 30 (CTA), 90 (PDP), 10% (PDP penalty), 20% (interest at surcharge), 125/25/6x (penalties). Alamin din ang pagkakaiba ng PCAG-TIRAO (risk profiling at analysis) at PCAG-CAO (actual audit), at ng Reconsideration (existing records) vs Reinvestigation (bagong ebidensiya).

❓ Madalas Malito ang Students
Tanong: Puwede pa ba mag-PDP kapag may ANL na?
Sagot: Oo, puwede pa, sa loob ng 90 calendar days mula receipt ng ANL (Sec. 6.1.2). Pero mas mabigat ang bayad: deficiency plus 10% ng basic deficiency plus legal interest. Hindi rin puwede ang PDP sa goods declarations na may Fraud, o may pending cases sa Customs office o sa courts.

🔗 Related Topics
CMTA Title X (Sections 1000-1006), CMTA Sec. 104, 108, 429, 701(c) at 1005, E.O. 46 s. 2017, E.O. 160 s. 2003, CMO 1-2002, CMO 2-2002, CAO 4-2004, CAO 5-2007, CMO 11-2014.

paragraphs.label: Introduction.
paragraphs.text: This Order implements (a) the post clearance audit functions of the Bureau, found in Sections 1000 to 1006, Title X; and (b) other related provisions of Republic Act No. 10863, otherwise known as the Customs Modernization and Tariff Act (CMTA).

ai.title: Intro: Ano ang Ipinapatupad ng CAO 01-2019
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Sinasabi ng intro na dalawa ang ipinapatupad ng Order na ito: (a) ang post clearance audit functions ng Bureau sa Sections 1000 to 1006, Title X; at (b) ang iba pang related provisions ng RA 10863 o CMTA.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Simple lang: ang CMTA ang batas, ang CAO ang 'how-to'. Kung gusto mong malaman kung paano talaga ginagawa ang audit at paano gumagana ang PDP sa praktika, dito ka titingin. Ang intro paragraph na ito ang nagsasabi kung saang batas nakakabit ang buong Order.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan

paragraphs.text: The post clearance audit of all records required to be kept by all Importers, beneficial or true owners of imported goods, Customs Brokers, agents and Locators as provided for in Section 1003 (a), (b), and (c), Title X of the CMTA; and

ai.title: Sakop: Post Clearance Audit ng Records
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Sakop ng PCA ang lahat ng records na kailangang i-keep ng Importers, beneficial o true owners ng imported goods, Customs Brokers, agents at Locators, ayon sa Section 1003 (a), (b) at (c), Title X ng CMTA.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hindi lang ang importer-of-record ang puwedeng balikan. Pati ang tunay na may-ari ng goods, ang broker, ang agent, at ang locator sa free zone ay may obligasyong magtago ng records, kaya puwede silang ma-audit.

📦 Halimbawa
Ang isang kumpanya ang nag-oorder sa local supplier, at ang supplier ang naka-declare bilang importer-of-record. Kung ang kumpanya ay 'beneficial owner' (tingnan ang Sec. 3.5.2), puwede pa rin siyang sakop ng records requirement.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Tatlong bagay dito: (1) principles at methodology ng PCA, (2) recordkeeping requirement, (3) period of audit. Pang-enumeration na tanong ito sa exam.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Objective: Prinsipyo at Methodology ng PCA sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 2. Objectives, item 2.1.). Ipaliwanag ang tatlong bahagi ng objective na ito. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: To provide guidance for record-keeping, document retention and other legal obligations of Importers and other customs stakeholders and the adverse consequences of non-compliance with customs rules and regulations;

ai.title: Objective: Guidance sa Recordkeeping at Consequences
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Layunin nitong magbigay ng guidance sa record-keeping, document retention at iba pang legal obligations ng Importers at customs stakeholders, kasama ang adverse consequences kapag hindi sumunod.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Sinasabi nito sa stakeholders: 'ito ang dapat ninyong gawin, at ito ang mangyayari kapag pumalya kayo.' Hindi lang importer ang tinutukoy, kasama ang ibang customs stakeholders.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Dalawa ang pinagsama: obligations (recordkeeping, retention) at consequences ng non-compliance. Ang mga parusa ay nasa Section 10.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Objective: Guidance sa Recordkeeping at Consequences sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 2. Objectives, item 2.2.). Ipaliwanag kung bakit kailangang nakasaad ang consequences sa isang compliance order. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: To facilitate trade by strengthening customs controls from the border to the back-end of the cargo clearance process under a regime of informed compliance;

ai.title: Objective: Informed Compliance at Trade Facilitation
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Layunin nitong i-facilitate ang trade sa pamamagitan ng mas matibay na customs controls mula border hanggang sa back-end ng cargo clearance process, sa ilalim ng regime ng informed compliance.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hindi na lang sa border ang control: puwede pa ring i-check ang transaction pagkatapos ma-release ang cargo. So may accountability pa rin sa back-end. Ang 'informed compliance' ay ang idea na alam ng trader ang rules at responsable siya sa pagsunod.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Keyword: 'border to back-end' at 'informed compliance'. Kapag trade facilitation ang tanong, ito ang sagot.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Objective: Informed Compliance at Trade Facilitation sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 2. Objectives, item 2.3.). Ipaliwanag ang konsepto ng informed compliance at kung paano ito konektado sa post clearance audit. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: To promote compliance with customs laws and regulations by providing a non-punitive facility for Importers to voluntarily disclose or report to customs authorities the errors in goods declarations and in the payment of duties, taxes and other charges;

ai.title: Objective: Non-Punitive Facility (PDP)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Layunin nitong i-promote ang compliance sa pamamagitan ng non-punitive facility para sa Importers na kusang mag-disclose ng errors sa goods declarations at sa payment ng duties, taxes at other charges.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ito ang puso ng PDP: kung ikaw mismo ang umamin ng mali bago ka mahuli, hindi ka tratuhing parang violator na hinuli. Hinihikayat ka ng sistema na ayusin ang pagkakamali.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang salitang dapat tandaan ay 'non-punitive' at 'voluntarily disclose'. Pero hindi ito automatic na waiver ng lahat; may bayad pa rin at may exclusions (tingnan ang Sec. 6).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Objective: Non-Punitive Facility (PDP) sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 2. Objectives, item 2.4.). Ipaliwanag kung bakit 'non-punitive' ang PDP pero may binabayaran pa rin. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: To provide a clear set of policies and guidelines in the application and availment of the PDP; and

ai.title: Objective: Malinaw na Policies para sa PDP
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Layunin nitong magbigay ng malinaw na set of policies at guidelines sa application at availment ng PDP.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Para hindi hula-hula ang importer kung paano mag-apply sa PDP, may nakasulat na steps, deadlines, exclusions at penalties. Nasa Section 6 ang lahat ng 'yan.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Kapag may tanong na 'saan nakalatag ang proseso ng PDP?', ang sagot ay Section 6 ng CAO na ito.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Objective: Malinaw na Policies para sa PDP sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 2. Objectives, item 2.5.). Ipaliwanag kung bakit kailangan ng malinaw na policies sa PDP application. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: To generate additional customs revenues with least administrative cost to both the government and the Importer.

ai.title: Objective: Dagdag na Revenue sa Mababang Gastos
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Layunin nitong makabuo ng karagdagang customs revenues na pinakamababa ang administrative cost sa gobyerno at sa Importer.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Mas mura ang magpa-audit nang buo kaysa maghabol ng kaso at litigation. Kapag kusang nag-disclose ang importer, nakukuha ng gobyerno ang kulang na bayad nang hindi kailangan ng mahabang proseso.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Dalawang panig ang binabanggit: ang gobyerno at ang Importer. Pareho dapat 'least administrative cost'.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Objective: Dagdag na Revenue sa Mababang Gastos sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 2. Objectives, item 2.6.). Ipaliwanag kung paano nakakabawas ng administrative cost ang PDP at audit system. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

ai.title: Section 3: Definition of Terms
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Dito nakalagay ang mga termino na ginagamit sa buong CAO: Customs Broker, Customs Clearance, Fraud, Free Zones, Importer, Inadvertent Error, Locators, Misclassification, Misdeclaration, Negligence, PDP, PCAG, at iba pa.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Pinakamahalagang bahagi ito para sa exam. Karamihan ng tanong ay galing sa differences ng Fraud, Negligence, Misdeclaration, Misclassification at Undervaluation.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Gawa ng comparison table sa notes mo: intent, effect, at penalty ng bawat isa.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Section 3: Definition of Terms sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms). Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: For purposes of this CAO, the following terms are defined as follows:

ai.title: Panimula sa Definitions
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Intro clause ito ng Definition of Terms. Ang mga kahulugan na nasa ibaba ay para sa CAO na ito lang ('for purposes of this CAO').

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang mga termino tulad ng Fraud, Negligence at Importer ay may specific na meaning dito. Kapag sinagot mo ang exam, gamitin ang definition ng CAO, hindi lang ang layman's meaning.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang scope ng definitions ay 'for purposes of this CAO'. Dapat sundin ang eksaktong wording kapag may definition question.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Panimula sa Definitions sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms (unnumbered paragraph)). Ipaliwanag kung bakit mahalaga ang definition clause at paano ito binabasa. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Customs Broker – shall refer to any person who is a bona fide holder of a valid Certificate of Registration or Professional Identification Card issued by the Professional Regulatory Board and Professional Regulation Commission pursuant to Republic Act No. 9280, as amended, otherwise known as the "Customs Brokers Act of 2004".

ai.title: Customs Broker
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Customs Broker ay taong bona fide holder ng valid Certificate of Registration o Professional Identification Card na galing sa Professional Regulatory Board at Professional Regulation Commission, ayon sa RA 9280 o Customs Brokers Act of 2004.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Lisensyado lang ang puwedeng tawaging Customs Broker. Hindi sapat na marunong ka lang mag-asikaso ng papeles; kailangan may valid registration o PIC mula sa PRC.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
RA 9280 ang batas. PRC at Professional Regulatory Board ang nag-i-issue. Nasa PCA ang mga broker dahil sakop sila ng recordkeeping at puwede silang i-audit.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Customs Broker sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.1.). Ipaliwanag kung bakit kasama ang Customs Broker sa recordkeeping at audit. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Customs Clearance – shall refer to the completion of customs and other government formalities necessary to allow goods to enter for consumption, warehousing, transit or transshipment, or to be exported or placed under another customs procedure under the following Customs regimes:

ai.title: Customs Clearance (Intro)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Customs Clearance ay ang pagkumpleto ng customs at ibang government formalities na kailangan para makapasok ang goods for consumption, warehousing, transit o transshipment, o ma-export o mailagay sa ibang customs procedure, sa ilalim ng mga regimes na nakalista sa baba.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hindi lang ito 'lumabas na ang cargo.' Ang clearance ay depende sa regime ng entry. Apat ang nakalista: consumption, warehousing, transit at transshipment.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Mahalaga ang definition na ito dahil ang Customs Clearance ay ginagamit na reference point sa 3-year audit at recordkeeping period (tingnan ang Sec. 4.1.1 at 4.4).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Customs Clearance (Intro) sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.2.). Ipaliwanag ang konsepto ng Customs Clearance at kung bakit ito ang starting point ng 3-year period. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Customs Clearance for Consumption Entries – shall refer to the procedure of making the final payment of duties and taxes and other charges at the port of entry and the legal permit for withdrawal has been granted.

ai.title: Clearance: Consumption Entries
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Sa consumption entries, ang customs clearance ay ang procedure ng final payment ng duties, taxes at other charges sa port of entry, at napagkalooban na ng legal permit for withdrawal.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kapag bayad na lahat at may permit to withdraw ka na, tapos na ang clearance ng consumption entry mo.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Dalawang requirements: (1) final payment ng duties, taxes at charges, at (2) legal permit for withdrawal.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Clearance: Consumption Entries sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.2.1.). Ipaliwanag kung kailan masasabing cleared ang consumption entry. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Customs Clearance for Warehousing Entries – shall refer to the procedure of filing of goods declaration and the duties and taxes has been secured to be paid at the point of entry and the legal permit for withdrawal has been granted.

ai.title: Clearance: Warehousing Entries
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Sa warehousing entries, ang customs clearance ay ang pag-file ng goods declaration at nai-secure na ang pagbabayad ng duties at taxes sa point of entry, at napagkalooban na ng legal permit for withdrawal.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Iba ito sa consumption: hindi pa bayad, pero 'secured' na ang bayad. Pwede nang i-withdraw papasok sa warehouse.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang susi ay ang salitang 'secured to be paid'. Hindi final payment ang requirement dito, kundi ang security at ang permit for withdrawal.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Clearance: Warehousing Entries sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.2.2.). Ipaliwanag ang pagkakaiba ng clearance ng consumption at warehousing entries. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Customs Clearance for Transit Entries – shall refer to the customs procedure under which goods, in its original form, are given permit to be transported under customs control from one customs office to another, or to a free zone.

ai.title: Clearance: Transit Entries
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Sa transit entries, ang customs clearance ay ang customs procedure kung saan ang goods, sa original form nito, ay binibigyan ng permit na ma-transport sa ilalim ng customs control mula isang customs office papunta sa iba, o papunta sa free zone.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Parang 'under escort' ang cargo: lilipat lang ng lugar pero nasa customs control pa rin. Hindi ito pinoproseso o binabago.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Keywords: 'original form', 'customs control', 'from one customs office to another, or to a free zone'.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Clearance: Transit Entries sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.2.3.). Ipaliwanag ang transit entry at kung paano ito naiiba sa consumption. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Customs Clearance for Transshipment Entries – shall refer to the customs procedure under which goods are given permit to be transferred under customs control from the importing means of transport to the exporting means of transport within the area of one customs office, which is the office of both importation and exportation.

ai.title: Clearance: Transshipment Entries
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Sa transshipment entries, ang customs clearance ay ang procedure kung saan ang goods ay binibigyan ng permit na ilipat, under customs control, mula sa importing means of transport papunta sa exporting means of transport, sa loob ng area ng isang customs office na siyang office ng importation at exportation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Halimbawa, bababa ang cargo sa isang barko at ililipat sa ibang barko sa iisang port. Hindi ito papasok sa commerce ng bansa; dadaan lang.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Dapat iisang customs office ang importation at exportation office. Hindi ito tulad ng transit na nagpapalipat ng customs office.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Clearance: Transshipment Entries sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.2.4.). Ipaliwanag ang pagkakaiba ng transit at transshipment. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Fraud – shall refer to the commission or omission of any act resulting in material false statements such as, but not limited to, the submission of false or altered documents in connection with any importation knowingly, voluntarily and intentionally done to reduce the taxes and duties paid or to avoid compliance with government regulations related to the entry of Regulated, Prohibited or Restricted goods into Philippine customs territory through Misdeclaration, Misclassification or Undervaluation.

ai.title: Fraud
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Fraud ay ang commission o omission ng act na nagreresulta sa material false statements, tulad ng pag-submit ng false o altered documents sa isang importation, na ginawa nang knowingly, voluntarily at intentionally, para bawasan ang taxes at duties o iwasan ang compliance sa regulasyon para sa Regulated, Prohibited o Restricted goods, sa pamamagitan ng Misdeclaration, Misclassification o Undervaluation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang pinaka-differentiator ng Fraud ay ang intent. Hindi ito simpleng pagkakamali; sinadya ito. At ang paraan ay Misdeclaration, Misclassification o Undervaluation.

📦 Halimbawa
Nag-submit ang importer ng pekeng invoice na mas mababa ang presyo para mabawasan ang duties. Sinadya ito, kaya Fraud, hindi lang Negligence.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Tatlong elements na dapat magkasabay: knowingly, voluntarily at intentionally. Walang PDP para sa goods declarations na may Fraud (Sec. 6.2.3). Ang parusa ay nasa Sec. 10.3.2.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Fraud sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.3.). Ipaliwanag kung paano naiiba ang Fraud sa Negligence at Inadvertent Error. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Free Zones – shall refer to special economic zones registered with the Philippine Economic Zone Authority (PEZA) under Republic Act No. 7916, as amended, duly chartered or legislated special economic zones and freeports such as Clark Freeport Zone; Poro Point Freeport Zone; John Hay Special Economic Zone and Subic Bay Freeport Zone under Republic Act No. 7227, as amended by Republic Act No. 9400; the Aurora Special Economic Zone under Republic Act No. 9490, as amended; the Cagayan Special Economic Zone and Freeport under Republic Act No. 7922; the Zamboanga City Special Economic Zone under Republic Act No. 7903; the Freeport Area of Bataan under Republic Act No. 9728; and such other freeports as established or may be created by law.

ai.title: Free Zones
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Free Zones ay special economic zones na rehistrado sa PEZA sa ilalim ng RA 7916, at iba pang chartered o legislated special economic zones at freeports tulad ng Clark, Poro Point, John Hay, Subic Bay, Aurora, Cagayan, Zamboanga City, at Freeport Area of Bataan, pati ang iba pang freeports na itinatag o itatatag ng batas.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Mahaba ang listahan, pero ang point ay: kung rehistrado ka bilang special economic zone o freeport ayon sa batas, kasama ka sa 'Free Zones.' Ito ang basehan kung sino ang puwedeng maging Locator.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Hindi kailangang kabisaduhin lahat ng RA numbers, pero alamin ang pangunahing batas: RA 7916 (PEZA) at RA 7227 as amended (Subic, Clark, etc.). Open-ended ang listahan dahil may 'such other freeports as established by law.'
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Free Zones sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.4.). Ipaliwanag ang konsepto ng Free Zones at kung paano sila konektado sa recordkeeping ng Locators. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Importer – shall refer to the following:

ai.title: Importer (Intro)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang 'Importer' ay hindi lang isang tao. Nakalista sa Sec. 3.5.1 hanggang 3.5.4 kung sino-sino ang kasama sa definition.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Malawak ang definition: hindi lang ang nakapangalan sa goods declaration, kundi pati ang iba pang taong may kontrol o benepisyo sa importation.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Apat na kategorya: (3.5.1) importer-of-record o consignee/owner/declarant, (3.5.2) taong nag-oorder sa local supplier sa ilalim ng ilang conditions, (3.5.3) taong may activity na kailangan ng goods declaration, at (3.5.4) agent.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Importer (Intro) sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.5.). Ipaliwanag kung bakit malawak ang definition ng Importer sa CAO na ito. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Importer-of-record or consignee, owner or declarant, or a party who:

ai.title: Importer: Importer-of-Record, Consignee, Owner, Declarant
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang una sa definition ay ang importer-of-record o consignee, owner o declarant, o party na gumagawa ng mga acts na nakalista sa a at b.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ito ang 'tradisyunal' na importer: ang taong nasa papeles ng importation. Pero hindi lang siya, dahil may mga 'party who...' na kasama rin.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Basahin kasama ang a at b sa ibaba. Ang unang kategoryang ito ay madalas ang pinakamadaling matukoy sa exam.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Importer: Importer-of-Record, Consignee, Owner, Declarant sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.5.1.). Ipaliwanag kung sino ang importer-of-record at kung sino ang puwedeng ituring na kapareho niya. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.label: a.
paragraphs.text: imports goods into the Philippines or withdraws admitted goods from the Free Zones into the customs territory for consumption or warehousing; files a claim for refund or drawback; or transports or stores such goods carried or held under security; or

ai.title: Importer: Mga Gawain ng Importer (a)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Kasama ang party na nag-iimport ng goods sa Pilipinas, o nagwi-withdraw ng admitted goods mula sa Free Zones papasok sa customs territory for consumption o warehousing, nagfa-file ng claim for refund o drawback, o nagta-transport o nag-iimbak ng goods na dala o hawak sa ilalim ng security.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hindi lang pag-import mismo ang counted. Pati ang pag-withdraw mula sa free zone papunta sa local market, pag-claim ng refund o drawback, at transport o storage under security ay gawain ng isang 'Importer.'

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Apat na activities: import, withdraw mula sa Free Zone, file ng refund/drawback claim, at transport/store ng goods under security.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Importer: Mga Gawain ng Importer (a) sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item a.). Ipaliwanag kung bakit ang withdrawal mula sa Free Zone papasok sa customs territory ay itinuturing na gawain ng importer. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.label: b.
paragraphs.text: knowingly causes the importation or transportation or storage of imported goods referred to above, or the filing of refund or drawback claim.

ai.title: Importer: Knowingly Causes the Importation (b)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Kasama rin ang party na knowingly na nagdudulot ng importation, transportation o storage ng imported goods na nabanggit, o ng pag-file ng refund o drawback claim.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kahit hindi ikaw ang pumirma sa papeles, kung alam mo at ikaw ang dahilan kung bakit nangyari ang importation, puwede kang ituring na Importer.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang susi ay 'knowingly causes'. Mahalaga ang knowledge at ang pagiging sanhi.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Importer: Knowingly Causes the Importation (b) sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item b.). Ipaliwanag kung paano nasasakop ang taong nasa likod ng importation kahit hindi siya ang nakapangalan sa documents. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: A person ordering imported goods from a local importer or supplier in a domestic transaction if:

ai.title: Importer: Taong Nag-order sa Local Importer o Supplier
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Kasama sa definition ang taong nag-oorder ng imported goods mula sa local importer o supplier sa isang domestic transaction, kung natutugunan ang mga conditions sa a, b o c.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ito ang anti-'pasaway' provision. Hindi ka makakaiwas sa audit sa pamamagitan ng pag-order sa local supplier kung ikaw pala ang totoong nasa likod ng importation.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Tatlong conditions (a, b, c). Kasama ito sa dahilan kung bakit may konsepto ng 'beneficial or true owner.'
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Importer: Taong Nag-order sa Local Importer o Supplier sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.5.2.). Ipaliwanag ang concept ng beneficial o true owner sa domestic order ng imported goods. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.label: a.
paragraphs.text: the person placing the order controls the material terms and conditions of the importation;

ai.title: Condition (a): Controls the Material Terms
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Una, ang taong nag-oorder ay may control sa material terms and conditions ng importation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kung ikaw ang nagdidikta ng specs, presyo, delivery at iba pang pangunahing terms, malinaw na ikaw ang tunay na nagpapatakbo ng importation kahit iba ang nakapangalan.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang pokus ay ang 'control' sa material terms and conditions.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Condition (a): Controls the Material Terms sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item a.). Magbigay ng example ng taong may control sa material terms ng isang importation. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.label: b.
paragraphs.text: the person placing the order and the Importer or supplier are related in such a way that the former may be considered as the beneficial or true owner of the imported goods, as may be exemplified by the following circumstances:

ai.title: Condition (b): Relationship sa Importer-of-Record
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Pangalawa, ang taong nag-oorder at ang Importer o supplier ay related sa paraang puwedeng ituring na beneficial o true owner ang una, gaya ng mga halimbawa sa i, ii at iii.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Tinitingnan dito ang relasyon. Kung masyadong magkakaugnay ang dalawang panig, puwedeng ituring na ang nag-order ang totoong may-ari.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang i, ii at iii ay 'exemplified', ibig sabihin halimbawa lang, hindi eksklusibong listahan.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Condition (b): Relationship sa Importer-of-Record sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item b.). Ipaliwanag kung paano natutukoy ang beneficial o true owner base sa relasyon ng dalawang kumpanya. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.label: i.
paragraphs.text: the person placing the order is the sole buyer of the goods imported by the Importer-of-record;

ai.title: (b)(i): Sole Buyer
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Halimbawa ng relasyon: ang taong nag-oorder ay ang nag-iisang buyer ng goods na ini-import ng Importer-of-record.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kung isang kumpanya lang ang bumibili ng lahat ng ini-import, parang extension na lang siya ng importer.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Keyword: 'sole buyer'.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang (b)(i): Sole Buyer sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item i.). Magbigay ng practical example ng sole buyer arrangement. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.label: ii.
paragraphs.text: the Importer-of-record is an affiliate of the juridical entity which placed the order; or

ai.title: (b)(ii): Affiliate
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Halimbawa ng relasyon: ang Importer-of-record ay affiliate ng juridical entity na nag-order.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Magkapatid na kumpanya o magkaugnay na grupo ang dalawa. Kaya puwedeng ituring na isa lang ang tunay na interes.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Keyword: 'affiliate' ng juridical entity na nag-order.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang (b)(ii): Affiliate sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item ii.). Ipaliwanag ang kahulugan ng affiliate sa konteksto ng importer definition. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.label: iii.
paragraphs.text: the Importer-of-record and the entity which placed the order are owned by the same set of majority stockholders, whether nominal or beneficial, in both corporations;

ai.title: (b)(iii): Same Majority Stockholders
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Halimbawa ng relasyon: ang Importer-of-record at ang entity na nag-order ay pag-aari ng parehong set ng majority stockholders, nominal man o beneficial, sa dalawang korporasyon.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kahit magkaiba ang pangalan ng kumpanya, kung iisang grupo ang majority owners, magkaugnay sila sa mata ng CAO.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Kasama ang 'nominal or beneficial' stockholders. Hindi sapat na nominal owner lang ang tingnan.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang (b)(iii): Same Majority Stockholders sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item iii.). Ipaliwanag kung bakit mahalaga ang common ownership sa pag-determine ng beneficial owner. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.label: c.
paragraphs.text: the person or entity placing the order furnished the Importer or the exporter with technical data, molds, equipment, other production assistance, material, components, or parts with knowledge that these will be used in the manufacture or production of imported goods or the goods to be imported.

ai.title: Condition (c): Nagbigay ng Technical Data, Molds at Iba pa
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Pangatlo, ang taong nag-oorder ay nagbigay sa Importer o exporter ng technical data, molds, equipment, production assistance, materials, components o parts, na may alam na gagamitin ito sa paggawa ng imported goods o goods na ii-import.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kung ikaw ang nagbibigay ng molds, specs o materials para magawa ang goods na ii-import, at alam mo ito, kasali ka sa tinuturing na Importer.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Keyword: 'with knowledge' na gagamitin sa manufacture o production. Kailangan ang knowledge ng nag-order para pumasok sa definition.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Condition (c): Nagbigay ng Technical Data, Molds at Iba pa sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item c.). Ipaliwanag kung bakit kasama sa Importer ang nagbibigay ng molds, technical data at materials. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: A person whose activities require the filing of a goods declaration; or

ai.title: Importer: Person Whose Activities Require a Goods Declaration
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Kasama rin sa Importer ang taong ang mga activities ay nangangailangan ng pag-file ng goods declaration.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kung ang negosyo o gawain mo ay kailangang mag-file ng goods declaration, ituturing kang Importer para sa CAO na ito.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Pangatlong kategorya (3.5.3). Maikli pero malawak ang saklaw.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Importer: Person Whose Activities Require a Goods Declaration sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.5.3.). Magbigay ng mga halimbawa ng activities na nangangailangan ng goods declaration. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: An agent of the Importer as described in Section 3.5.1. of this CAO.

ai.title: Importer: Agent ng Importer
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Kasama rin ang agent ng Importer na inilarawan sa Section 3.5.1.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kung may kumilos para sa importer, gaya ng broker o authorized representative, puwede siyang ituring na Importer para sa layuning ito.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Pang-apat na kategorya (3.5.4). Ang reference ay Sec. 3.5.1, hindi 3.5.2 o 3.5.3.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Importer: Agent ng Importer sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.5.4.). Ipaliwanag ang papel ng agent ng importer sa audit at recordkeeping. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Inadvertent Error – shall refer to a mechanical, electronic or clerical error committed unintentionally by the Importer and occurred notwithstanding the maintenance of internal controls necessary to avoid such errors. Inadvertent Error as used in this CAO amounts to simple Negligence.

ai.title: Inadvertent Error
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Inadvertent Error ay mechanical, electronic o clerical error na hindi sinasadya ng Importer at nangyari kahit may internal controls para maiwasan ito. Para sa CAO na ito, katumbas ito ng simple Negligence.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Typo ito, system glitch o clerical slip, hindi 'katamaran' o 'kapabayaan'. Importante na may internal controls ka na at nagkamali pa rin.

📦 Halimbawa
Nagkamali ang encoder sa pag-type ng quantity kahit may maker-checker system ang kumpanya. Maaaring Inadvertent Error ito kung napatunayan ang elements.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Elements: unintentional, mechanical/electronic/clerical, at may internal controls pa rin. Ang penalty ay 25% ng revenue loss (Sec. 10.3.1), subject to Sec. 108 ng CMTA.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Inadvertent Error sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.6.). Ipaliwanag ang pagkakaiba ng Inadvertent Error at Negligence. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Locators – shall refer to persons authorized to bring imported goods into Free Zones, such as the special economic zones and free ports.

ai.title: Locators
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Locators ay mga taong authorized na magdala ng imported goods sa Free Zones, tulad ng special economic zones at freeports.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Sila ang mga locator na nag-ooperate sa loob ng free zones. May sarili silang recordkeeping duty para sa admission at withdrawal ng goods.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Basahin kasama ang Sec. 4.2.3 (recordkeeping ng Locators) at Sec. 4.4 (3 years mula filing ng goods declaration).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Locators sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.7.). Ipaliwanag ang papel ng Locators at bakit sakop sila ng PCA. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Misclassification – shall refer to the use of insufficient or wrong description of the goods or the use of erroneous tariff headings resulting in deficiency between the duty and tax that should have been paid and the duty and tax actually paid and/or to avoid compliance with government regulations related to the entry of Regulated, Prohibited or Restricted goods into Philippine Customs territory.

ai.title: Misclassification
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Misclassification ay ang paggamit ng kulang o maling description ng goods, o maling tariff headings, na nagreresulta sa kakulangan sa duty at tax na dapat bayaran, at/o para iwasan ang compliance sa regulations sa Regulated, Prohibited o Restricted goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Maling description o maling tariff heading ang problema. Ang resulta: kulang ang binayaran, o nakalusot ang regulated goods.

📦 Halimbawa
Na-declare ang goods sa heading na mas mababa ang duty rate, kahit mas tama ang ibang heading.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Isa ito sa tatlong paraan ng Fraud kapag intentional (kasama ang Misdeclaration at Undervaluation). Kung hindi intentional, puwedeng Negligence.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Misclassification sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.8.). Ipaliwanag ang pagkakaiba ng Misclassification, Misdeclaration at Undervaluation. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Misdeclaration – shall refer to a false, untruthful, erroneous or inaccurate declaration as to quantity, quality, description, weight or measurement of the goods resulting in deficiency between the duty and tax that should have been paid and the duty and tax actually paid and/or to avoid compliance with government regulations related to the entry of Regulated, Prohibited or Restricted goods into Philippine customs territory.

ai.title: Misdeclaration
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Misdeclaration ay false, untruthful, erroneous o inaccurate na declaration tungkol sa quantity, quality, description, weight o measurement ng goods, na nagreresulta sa kakulangan sa duty at tax, at/o para iwasan ang compliance sa regulations para sa Regulated, Prohibited o Restricted goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Mali ang sinabi tungkol sa dami, klase, weight, sukat o description ng goods. Kulang ang bayad o nalusutan ang regulasyon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Limang aspeto: quantity, quality, description, weight, measurement. Hindi ito tungkol sa maling tariff heading o presyo; iyon ay Misclassification at Undervaluation.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Misdeclaration sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.9.). Ipaliwanag ang pagkakaiba ng Misdeclaration at Misclassification gamit ang examples. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Negligence – shall refer to failure to exercise reasonable care and competence, through act or acts of omission or commission, in ensuring that a statement made is correct resulting in a deficiency in taxes and duties paid.

ai.title: Negligence
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Negligence ay failure na mag-exercise ng reasonable care and competence, sa pamamagitan ng acts of omission o commission, para tiyaking tama ang statement na ginawa, na nagreresulta sa deficiency sa taxes at duties.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hindi sinadya, pero pabaya ka o hindi ka nag-ingat. Kulang ang due diligence mo kaya nagkamali at kulang ang nabayaran.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Susi: 'reasonable care and competence'. Ang penalty ay 125% ng revenue loss (Sec. 10.3.1). Ang Inadvertent Error ay simple Negligence at 25% lang.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Negligence sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.10.). Ipaliwanag kung ano ang 'reasonable care and competence' sa customs setting. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Principal Place of Business – shall refer to the headquarters that holds the senior executive of a firm and is usually the center from where other locations are controlled. It likewise refers to the place where a corporation's officers direct, control and coordinate the corporation's activities and where the books and records are kept.

ai.title: Principal Place of Business
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Principal Place of Business ay ang headquarters na nandoon ang senior executive ng firm at karaniwang sentro ng control sa ibang locations. Ito rin ang lugar kung saan dini-direct, kino-control at kino-coordinate ng officers ang activities ng korporasyon at kung saan itinatago ang books at records.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ito ang 'home base' ng kumpanya. Dito dapat nakatago ang records, at dito rin puwedeng i-serve ang ANL at Demand Letter.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Gagamitin ito sa Sec. 4.4 (lugar ng recordkeeping) at Sec. 5.5.1 (personal service ng ANL at Demand Letter).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Principal Place of Business sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.11.). Ipaliwanag kung bakit mahalaga ang Principal Place of Business sa recordkeeping at service of notices. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Prior Disclosure Program – shall refer to a program based on international best customs practice, authorizing the Commissioner of Customs to accept, as a potential mitigating factor, prior disclosure by Importers of errors and omissions in goods declaration resulting in deficiency in duties and taxes on past importations. It may also include disclosures on royalties and other proceeds of any subsequent resale, disposal or use of the imported goods that accrues directly or indirectly to the seller.

ai.title: Prior Disclosure Program
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang PDP ay program na base sa international best customs practice, na nagbibigay-pahintulot sa Commissioner na tanggapin, bilang potential mitigating factor, ang prior disclosure ng Importers sa mga errors at omissions sa goods declaration na nagresulta sa deficiency sa duties at taxes sa past importations. Maaari rin itong sumaklaw sa disclosures tungkol sa royalties at iba pang proceeds ng subsequent resale, disposal o use ng goods na napupunta, direkta o hindi, sa seller.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kusang pag-amin ng mali bago ka mahuli, at bilang kapalit, may 'mitigating factor' na tinatanggap ang Commissioner. Hindi ito automatic na amnestiya.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Keyword: 'potential mitigating factor' at 'past importations'. Kasama rin ang disclosure ng royalties at proceeds ng subsequent resale. Ang proseso ay nasa Section 6.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Prior Disclosure Program sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.12.). Ipaliwanag ang PDP bilang mitigating factor at hindi bilang amnestiya. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Post Clearance Audit Group (PCAG) – shall refer to an office created under Executive Order No. 160 s. 2003, as amended by Executive Order No. 46, s. 2017, mandated to conduct audit of importers, locators, and all parties engaged in customs clearance and processing.

ai.title: Post Clearance Audit Group (PCAG)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang PCAG ay office na nilikha sa ilalim ng E.O. 160 s. 2003, as amended ng E.O. 46 s. 2017, na may mandato na mag-audit ng importers, locators at lahat ng party na kasama sa customs clearance at processing.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Sila ang audit arm ng Bureau. Hindi lang importers ang puwede nilang i-audit; pati locators at iba pang parties sa clearance.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Dalawang legal basis: E.O. 160 (2003) at E.O. 46 (2017). Ang composition ay nasa Sec. 5.1.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Post Clearance Audit Group (PCAG) sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.13.). Ipaliwanag ang papel ng PCAG at ang history ng pagkakatatag nito. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Reconsideration of Audit Findings – shall refer to a plea for the re-evaluation of the audit findings on the basis of existing records without need of additional evidence. It may involve both a question of fact or of law or both.

ai.title: Reconsideration of Audit Findings
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Reconsideration ay plea para sa re-evaluation ng audit findings batay sa existing records, nang walang kailangang additional evidence. Maaari itong tungkol sa question of fact, law, o pareho.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Sinasabi mo: 'basahin ninyo ulit ang mga na-submit na namin, mali ang conclusion.' Walang bagong ebidensiya.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Existing records lang. Kontra dito ang Reinvestigation na may bagong ebidensiya. Filing period: 15 days mula receipt ng Demand Letter (Sec. 5.5.1.f).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Reconsideration of Audit Findings sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.14.). Ipaliwanag ang pagkakaiba ng Reconsideration at Reinvestigation sa exam. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Reinvestigation of Audit Findings – shall refer to a plea for the re-evaluation of the audit findings on the basis of newly discovered or additional evidence intended to be presented in the reinvestigation. It may also involve a question of fact or of law or both.

ai.title: Reinvestigation of Audit Findings
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Reinvestigation ay plea para sa re-evaluation ng audit findings batay sa newly discovered o additional evidence na ipepresenta. Maaari rin itong tungkol sa question of fact, law, o pareho.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Dito, may bago kang ebidensiya o dagdag na dokumento na hindi pa nakikita ng auditors.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Susi: 'newly discovered or additional evidence'. Ang requirements ay nasa Sec. 5.5.1.f (30 days para i-submit ang documents; 60 days para sa Bureau na magdesisyon).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Reinvestigation of Audit Findings sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.15.). Ipaliwanag kung kailan dapat Reinvestigation ang piliin at hindi Reconsideration. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Undervaluation – shall refer to situation when the declared value fails to disclose in full the price actually paid or payable or any dutiable adjustment to the price actually paid or payable, or when an incorrect valuation method is used or the valuation rules are not properly observed, resulting in a discrepancy in duty and tax to be paid between what is legally determined as the correct value against the declared value.

ai.title: Undervaluation
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Undervaluation ay kapag ang declared value ay hindi buong nagpapakita ng price actually paid or payable o ng dutiable adjustment, o kapag mali ang valuation method na ginamit o hindi nasunod nang tama ang valuation rules, na nagreresulta sa discrepancy sa duty at tax sa pagitan ng tamang value at declared value.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Mas mababa ang idineklarang halaga kaysa dapat. Puwedeng dahil kulang ang presyong inilagay, nakalimutan ang adjustments, o mali ang paraan ng valuation.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Tatlong paraan: (1) hindi buo ang price paid/payable o adjustments, (2) maling valuation method, (3) hindi nasunod nang tama ang valuation rules. Ang resulta ay discrepancy sa duty at tax.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Undervaluation sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 3. Definition of Terms, item 3.16.). Ipaliwanag ang Undervaluation at ang relasyon nito sa price actually paid or payable. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

ai.title: Section 4: Requirement to Keep Records
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Sakop ng Section 4 ang audit window (3 years), sino ang dapat mag-keep ng records, bakit, saan at gaano katagal, at anong records ang required.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Pinaka-practical na bahagi ito para sa importers at brokers: ito ang compliance checklist mo. Kapag kulang ang records, malaki ang penalty (Sec. 10).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Tatandaan: 3 taon, Principal Place of Business, pitong kategorya ng records, at ang pagkakaiba ng starting point para sa Importers (whichever is later) at Brokers/Locators (mula filing ng goods declaration).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Section 4: Requirement to Keep Records sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 4. Requirement to Keep Records). Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Audit and Examination of Records.

ai.title: 4.1 Audit at Examination of Records (Heading)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ito ang heading ng Section 4.1 na tumatalakay sa karapatan ng Bureau na mag-audit at mag-examine ng records. Ang laman ay nasa 4.1.1 at 4.1.2.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Dito nagsisimula ang 'bakit kailangan mong mag-ingat ng records': dahil puwedeng balikan ng Bureau ang transaction mo kahit nakalabas na ang cargo.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Dalawang bahagi: 4.1.1 (3-year audit window) at 4.1.2 (period of limitation).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang 4.1 Audit at Examination of Records (Heading) sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 4. Requirement to Keep Records, item 4.1.). Ipaliwanag kung paano nag-uugnay ang audit authority at recordkeeping duty. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Within three (3) years from the date of final payment of duties and taxes or Customs Clearance, as the case may be, the Bureau may conduct an audit examination, inspection, verification, and investigation of records pertaining to any goods declaration, which shall include statements, declarations, documents and electronically generated or machine readable data, for the purpose of ascertaining the correctness of the goods declaration and determining the liability of the Importer for duties, taxes and other charges, including any fine or penalty.

ai.title: 3-Year Audit Window
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Sa loob ng tatlong (3) taon mula sa date ng final payment ng duties at taxes o Customs Clearance, puwedeng mag-audit, mag-inspect, mag-verify at mag-investigate ang Bureau ng records ng kahit anong goods declaration, kasama ang statements, declarations, documents at electronic o machine-readable data, para ma-check kung tama ang goods declaration at matukoy ang liability ng Importer sa duties, taxes, other charges, fine o penalty.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag

📦 Halimbawa
Nag-clear ang shipment noong Marso ng isang taon. Hanggang sa loob ng 3 taon mula sa final payment o clearance, puwede itong i-audit.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
3 taon ang window. Ang simula ay depende: final payment ng duties and taxes, o Customs Clearance, 'as the case may be'. Saklaw ang electronic at machine-readable data.

paragraphs.text: Period of Limitation. In the absence of fraud and when the goods have been finally assessed and released, the assessment shall be conclusive upon all parties three (3) years from the date of final payment of duties and taxes, or upon completion of the post clearance audit.

ai.title: Period of Limitation
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Kung walang fraud at ang goods ay final nang na-assess at na-release, ang assessment ay magiging conclusive sa lahat ng partido tatlong (3) taon mula sa final payment ng duties at taxes, o kapag natapos na ang post clearance audit.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Pagkatapos ng 3 taon (o pagkatapos ng audit), 'final' na ang assessment, basta walang fraud. Sa text, ang conclusiveness ay para lang sa kaso na 'in the absence of fraud'.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan

paragraphs.text: Customs Brokers and Other Parties – All Customs Brokers and other parties engaged in Customs Clearance and processing are required to keep manual and/or electronic copies of the records covering transactions that they handle. Puwede kang maging paperless, pero dapat legal ang paraan ng pag-iingat mo ng electronic records. Hindi ka puwedeng basta mag-save sa kahit anong paraan.

paragraphs.text: Authority of the Commissioner to Reorganize PCAG. The Commissioner, with the approval of the Secretary of Finance, is hereby authorized to determine the number of personnel requirements of PCAG and issue the necessary order to reassign the required organic personnel of BOC to the Group.

ai.content:

Ang Commissioner, kasama ang approval ng Secretary of Finance, ay may authority na magdesisyon sa bilang ng personnel ng PCAG at mag-issue ng orders para i-reassign ang organic personnel ng BOC sa Group.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hindi puwedeng mag-isa ang Commissioner. Kailangan ng approval ng Secretary of Finance sa pagtakda ng bilang ng tauhan at pag-reassign ng staff.

Dalawang opisyal: Commissioner at Secretary of Finance. Ang reassignment ay para sa organic personnel ng BOC.

paragraphs.text: Subject to the principles of economy, efficiency and effectiveness, the Commissioner is likewise authorized to recommend necessary changes to the personnel and staffing pattern of the PCAG and, with the approval of the Secretary of Finance, submit the same for evaluation of the Department of Budget and Management (DBM).

paragraphs.text: Functions of PCAG. The PCAG is mandated to conduct, within three (3) years from the date of final payment of duties and taxes or customs clearance, an audit examination, inspection, verification, and investigation of records pertaining to any goods declaration, which shall include statements, declarations, documents and electronically generated or machine readable data, for the purpose of ascertaining the correctness of the goods declaration and determining the liability of the importer for duties, taxes and other charges, including any fine or penalty.

ai.title: 5.3 Functions ng PCAG
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mandato ng PCAG na mag-audit, mag-examine, mag-inspect, mag-verify at mag-investigate ng records ng kahit anong goods declaration sa loob ng 3 taon mula final payment ng duties at taxes o customs clearance, para ma-check ang correctness ng goods declaration at matukoy ang liability ng importer sa duties, taxes, other charges, fine o penalty.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ito ang core job ng PCAG. Kung ano ang sinabi sa Sec. 4.1.1, dito inaatasan ang PCAG na gawin ito.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang 3-year period ay pareho sa 4.1.1. Kasama ang electronically generated o machine-readable data.
