Ipaliwanag ang remedyo ng importer sa CTA at ang 30-day period. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

ai.title: Section 9: Remedies of the Bureau
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Tatlong remedies ng Bureau sa pagkolekta: distraint, levy at civil o criminal action.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Distraint para sa personal property, levy para sa real property, kaso para sa civil o criminal na paraan.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
PhP10,000 threshold: bawal ang distraint at levy kapag hindi hihigit sa PhP10,000 ang duties at taxes (walang interest at penalties).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Section 9: Remedies of the Bureau sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 9. Remedies of the Bureau). Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: The remedies of the Bureau for the collection of import duties, fees, or charges resulting from the conduct of a post clearance audit shall be obtained by:

ai.title: Section 9: Remedies ng Bureau
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang mga remedy ng Bureau para sa koleksyon ng import duties, fees o charges mula sa post clearance audit ay: distraint, levy at civil o criminal action.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kapag hindi ka nagbayad pagkatapos ng audit, may tatlong paraan ang Bureau para makolekta.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Tatlo: distraint (personal property), levy (real property), civil/criminal action.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Section 9: Remedies ng Bureau sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 9. Remedies of the Bureau (unnumbered paragraph)). Ipaliwanag ang tatlong remedies ng Bureau sa pagkolekta. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Distraint of goods, chattels or effects and other personal property of whatever character, including stocks and other securities, debts, credits, bank accounts and interest in and rights to personal property.

ai.title: 9.1 Distraint
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Distraint ng goods, chattels o effects at iba pang personal property ng kahit anong karakter, kasama ang stocks at securities, debts, credits, bank accounts at interest sa personal property.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Personal properties ang puwedeng kunin: goods, stocks, bank accounts at iba pa.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang distraint ay para sa personal property. Ang real property ay levy (9.2).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang 9.1 Distraint sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 9. Remedies of the Bureau, item 9.1.). Ipaliwanag ang distraint at ano ang puwedeng i-distrain. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Upon the failure of the person owing any delinquent duty, tax and other charges to pay at the time required, the Commissioner shall seize and distraint the goods, chattels or effects and the personal property, including stocks and other securities, debts, credits, bank accounts and interests in and rights to personal property of such persons, in sufficient quantity to satisfy the duty, tax or other charge and the expenses of the distraint and the cost of the subsequent sale.

ai.title: Distraint: Kapag Hindi Nagbayad
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Kapag hindi nagbayad ang taong may delinquent duty, tax at other charges sa required time, ang Commissioner ay magsi-seize at mag-di-distraint ng goods, chattels o effects at personal property ng taong iyon, sa sapat na dami para bayaran ang duty, tax o charge at ang expenses ng distraint at ang cost ng subsequent sale.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kukunin lang ang sapat para bayaran ang utang plus gastos.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Sapat na dami lang, kasama ang expenses at cost of sale.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Distraint: Kapag Hindi Nagbayad sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 9. Remedies of the Bureau (unnumbered paragraph)). Ipaliwanag kung gaano karami ang puwedeng i-distrain. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: To safeguard the interest of the government, the Commissioner may place under constructive distraint the property of a delinquent Importer who, in the opinion of the Commissioner, is retiring from any business subject to duty and tax, or is intending to leave the Philippines, or to remove the property therefrom, or to hide or conceal the property, or to perform any act tending to obstruct the proceedings for collecting the duty and tax due or which may be due.

ai.title: Constructive Distraint
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Para pangalagaan ang interes ng gobyerno, puwedeng ilagay ng Commissioner sa constructive distraint ang property ng delinquent Importer na, sa opinyon ng Commissioner, ay nagreretiro sa business na subject sa duty at tax, o aalis ng Pilipinas o ilalabas ang property, o itatago ang property, o gagawa ng act na makakahadlang sa koleksyon.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Pre-emptive ito: kapag may senyales na tatakbo o magtatago ang importer, puwedeng i-lock agad ang property niya.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Mga trigger: retiring, leaving the Philippines, removing property, hiding property, o obstruction. Nakabase sa opinyon ng Commissioner.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang Constructive Distraint sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 9. Remedies of the Bureau (unnumbered paragraph)). Ipaliwanag ang constructive distraint at ang mga trigger nito. Magbigay ng practical customs examples, ipaliwanag kung bakit may ganitong provision, banggitin ang related provisions ng CMTA at ng ibang orders, at i-clarify ang mga common misconceptions ng students.

paragraphs.text: Levy upon real property and interest in rights to real property.

ai.title: 9.2 Levy sa Real Property
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Levy sa real property at interest sa rights sa real property.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Lupa at gusali ang tinutukoy dito.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Real property = levy. Personal property = distraint.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag mo in simple Taglish, parang cool na customs review mentor, ang 9.2 Levy sa Real Property sa CAO 01-2019 (Section 9. Remedies of the Bureau, item 9.2.).
